title: Design Verification Lead, Nitro Team
description:
Annapurna Labs is the team behind AWS Nitro, the purpose-built system that powers the security, performance, and innovation of every EC2 instance. We operate like a start-up with the scale of the world's largest cloud provider.

We're looking for a Design Verification Team Lead - a design verification technical lead that is responsible for complex SoC sub-system, with cutting edge technology for Nitro system SoC, the foundation of AWS's virtualization, networking, and storage offload infrastructure.

It starts at product definition - we engage from day one, shaping requirements and translating product intent into verification strategies before a single line of RTL is written

It extends into software - we work side-by-side with SW teams, verifying hardware-software interfaces and ensuring seamless integration across the stack, with particular emphasis on networking workloads such as ENA and EFA

It reaches into physical design - we verify physical design aspects within functional verification, bridging the gap between logical correctness and silicon reality

It closes the loop - from spec to silicon, our verification touches every team and every stage of chip development

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and execute verification plans for IO sub-systems - covering interconnect protocols, peripheral interfaces, and system-level integration with a strong connection to networking flows (ENA/EFA)

- Verify IO sub-system features, including interconnect protocols and various accelerator engines

- Develop and debug C embedded SW as part of hardware-software integration verification

- Build and maintain UVM-based verification environments for various clusters and sub-systems

- Verify ARM advanced interconnect protocols (AMBA CHI/ACE/AXI) ensuring correct coherency transactions, performance verification, and protocol compliance

- Verify the IO virtualization SMMU/TLB operations, page table walks, translation granules, and memory attributes (cache-ability, share-ability)

- Develop constrained-random and directed test strategies targeting corner cases in IO protocol hazards, coherency races, and system boundary conditions

- Drive coverage closure using functional coverage models, assertion-based verification, and formal methods where applicable

- Contribute to performance verification - ensuring micro-architectural implementations meet performance targets alongside correctness

A day in the life
As a Design Verification Team Lead on the Nitro team, you will be responsible for leading the verification of complex SoC sub-systems, driving industry-leading verification methodologies, and ensuring our next-generation Nitro system SoC meets the highest quality bar before reaching silicon.

About the team
What Sets Us Apart?

Full system ownership - our verification leaders gain deep understanding of all system flows and the full SW stack, truly owning the technical scope from product definition through post-tapeout activities. This end-to-end ownership is what defines verification at Annapurna Labs

Agentic AI is embedded in our workflow - not as an experiment, but as a core part of how we design and verify chips

Cutting edge methodologies drive every stage of our verification process

Relentless innovation - we don't settle; we actively seek new approaches that raise the bar on silicon quality

We do classic functional verification (SV/UVM/TLM), but beyond that, we touch physical design aspects, to ensure that the quality of our silicon is beyond logical functionality

Performance optimization at all levels is at the heart of our targets on top of logical correctness verification

Our verification underpins the infrastructure that runs millions of active workloads across AWS, where networking performance and security are non-negotiable

title: Senior Consultant – Data Engineer | Melbourne

Build modern data solutions and take greater ownership of client delivery.

What you’ll do

You’ll work alongside clients and Altis teams to understand business challenges, shape the right technical approach and deliver high-quality data and analytics solutions.

You’ll:

  • Deliver Data & Analytics solutions from discovery and requirements through to implementation and support
  • Work directly with clients to understand business needs and translate them into practical technical solutions
  • Contribute to workshops, solution design sessions and technical reviews
  • Design and build data pipelines, data models, database structures and data stores
  • Integrate and analyse data from multiple sources to support reporting, analytics and decision-making
  • Develop reports, dashboards, visualisations and actionable insights
  • Apply strong SQL, data modelling and engineering practices across client projects
  • Support testing, deployment, User Acceptance Testing and post-production activities
  • Contribute to project planning, estimation and delivery scheduling
  • Take ownership of your work while supporting and sharing knowledge with others
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Help clients successfully adopt the solutions we deliver through training and knowledge transfer

The experience you’ll bring

We’re looking for someone with strong Data & Analytics foundations, hands-on delivery experience, and the confidence to contribute meaningfully in a client environment.

Your experience may include:

  • Data & Analytics solution delivery
  • Strong SQL capability
  • Data modelling and database design
  • Data integration and modern ETL/ELT approaches
  • Data pipeline development
  • Experience with cloud technologies, such as Snowflake, Databricks and/or Google Cloud
  • Reporting, analytics and visualisation solutions
  • Translating business requirements into technical solutions
  • Working directly with clients or business stakeholders
  • Testing, implementation and production support

You don’t need to have worked with every technology we use. We’re more interested in strong technical foundations, sound judgement and your ability to learn and adapt across different client environments.

Why Altis?

For more than 25 years, Altis has focused on one thing: helping organisations create better outcomes through data.

We're Australian-owned and technology-agnostic, which means our consultants can focus on solving the right problem rather than selling a particular platform.

At Altis you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Work across varied and challenging Data & AI engagements
  • Learn from experienced specialists across consulting, engineering, analytics and AI
  • Build your capability through ongoing learning and career development
  • Work in a collaborative environment where you're encouraged to challenge ideas and contribute your own
  • Work flexibly through our hybrid model
  • Access health and wellbeing support for you and your family

  • Access paid parental leave and our reward and recognition program

Our values — Be Curious, Own It, Lead with Heart and Discover a Way — shape how we work with our clients and with each other.

Your next move doesn't need to tick every box

If the role sounds like the direction you want your career to take but you don't meet every requirement listed, we'd still encourage you to apply.

Different experiences and perspectives make our teams stronger.

If you need adjustments or support at any stage of our recruitment process, let our Talent Acquisition team know and we'll work with you.

Ready to see your career differently? We'd love to hear from you.

title: Associate Consultant - Financial Advisory

  • Presenting findings clearly in client / court reports
  • Producing high quality deliverables within planned timescales
  • Supporting and contributing to client presentations and wider advisory work
  • Conducting industry and business research as required

Requirements

  • Business proficiency in English is essential and Chinese (Cantonese and/or Mandarin) proficiency is preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree in a business or finance-related subject

  • Financial analysis skills with ability to analyse financial statements and extract useful information from large sets of unorganised or incomplete data
  • Possess strong skills in the Microsoft Office suite

  • Excellent communication, report writing and project management skills
  • Flexibility to meet peak demands when required and prioritise workload
  • Act with discretion, integrity and professionalism at all times

About Teneo

Teneo is the global CEO advisory firm. We partner with our clients globally to do great things for a better future.

Drawing upon our global team and expansive network of senior advisors, we provide advisory services across our five business segments on a stand-alone or fully integrated basis to help our clients solve complex business challenges. Our clients include a significant number of the Fortune 100 and FTSE 100, as well as other corporations, financial institutions, and organizations.

Our full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial transactions and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organizational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs, corporate governance, ESG and DE&I.

The firm has more than 1,800 employees located in 50+ markets around the world.

Our education team, part of Faculty’s Public Services Business Unit, works with the organisations that shape education — from governments and school groups, to publishers, education companies, and assessment organisations — to design, build and assure AI systems in high-stakes settings where safety, accuracy and efficacy genuinely matter.

Recent work includes national education infrastructure, AI tutoring, assessment and content-quality systems, and the safety and evaluation of AI used by children. The market we serve is shifting from “can AI do it?” to “can you prove impact?”. Our clients increasingly want help building AI solutions that are engineered to improve learning outcomes, teacher time, and quality, and that are safe by design - and that is precisely why this role exists.

About the role

As Lead Learning Scientist, you will ensure that our clients’ AI-powered education solutions are grounded in learning science, measurably effective, and set a global standard for what trustworthy AI in education looks like. You will define and lead the learning science discipline at Faculty: setting the strategy for learning design and evaluation, creating and owning our Learning Science Playbook, and ensuring the systems we build genuinely improve how people learn.

Working closely with senior leadership and multidisciplinary delivery teams, you will shape the design of scalable, data-rich learning systems in close partnership with product, engineering and data science, and guide colleagues to embed best-in-class learning science into everything we design and build for clients.

This is a founding leadership mandate, and the variety and stakes are unusual: in a single year you might shape national curriculum-grounded infrastructure, the evaluation architecture for a high-stakes assessment product, and the safety case for an AI system used by children — in an organisation that treats evidence, evaluation and safety as the product, not a compliance afterthought.

What you’ll be doing

  • Leading the design of learning goals, skill models, adaptivity logic and feedback systems across flagship client engagements — from national education infrastructure to tutoring, assessment and content-quality systems.

  • Creating and owning Faculty’s Learning Science Playbook — defining best practice for scaffolding, feedback loops, measurement rubrics and data instrumentation (how we track learning progress through user interactions), applied across every build.

  • Designing and overseeing rigorous evaluations — formative, summative and quasi-experimental — that give clients credible evidence their systems improve learning, not just plausible outputs.

  • Partnering with product, data science and engineering leads within delivery squads to ensure learning systems are technically robust and pedagogically sound — translating learning science into requirements engineers can build and test against.

  • Contributing learning science expertise to Faculty’s safety and assurance work, helping evidence that AI systems used in education are safe, effective and fit for purpose.

  • Coaching and mentoring colleagues across product, UX and data science to apply learning science principles in day-to-day design and delivery decisions.

  • Acting as the internal and external subject-matter expert on learning science, representing Faculty in strategic conversations with senior client stakeholders.

Who we’re looking for

ESSENTIAL

  • Expert-level knowledge of the learning sciences, instructional design, and cognitive or behavioural science.

  • The ability to translate learning science into clear, specific requirements that technical teams can build against — you make pedagogy build-able.

  • Strong working practice in evaluating and measuring learning impact (for example mastery, retention and transfer), including designing studies and deciding what data to capture.

  • Experience working with technical teams — engineers, data scientists or product developers — to shape what gets built. You need not have written the code yourself, but you have influenced how real systems were designed and can hold credibility with the people who build them.

  • Technical literacy in how AI systems are built, with a genuine appetite to deepen that knowledge quickly.

  • Excellent communication skills: able to influence senior stakeholders — internally and client-side — and to represent the discipline externally.

DESIRABLE (NOT REQUIRED)

  • Hands-on experience building AI-driven or adaptive learning systems.

  • Familiarity with LLM architectures, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation harnesses or learning analytics pipelines.

  • Experience across multiple client or product contexts — for example consulting, agency or platform settings serving many institutions.

Our Interview Process

  • Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  • Project Deep Dive with the Head of Education (60 minutes) — you will walk us through one project you have led from conception to delivery

  • Case Study and Technical Interview (60 minutes) — we will send you the brief 72 hours ahead

  • Cultural and Leadership Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Data Engineer - Video & Multimodal Training Data (World Models)
description:
Our client builds world model systems that learn how the world actually behaves over time and generate it back, interactively, in real time. Seven model releases since December 2024, including the first real-time synchronised audio-and-video world model and a four-player shared world.

Data is fast becoming one of the biggest bottlenecks in building world models. Models are only as good as the data behind them, and getting that data right is one of the hardest and most important problems any research lab has.

What you'd own

  • Curating large-scale multimodal datasets across video, robotics and audio to train flagship models
  • The selection logic: filtering, deduplication, quality scoring, captioning and shot detection. The decisions that set the ceiling on model quality
  • Platforms processing millions of hours of content, reliably and at a cost that isn't embarrassing
  • Dataset versioning, lineage and reproducibility, which show which data was used and whether you can rebuild itWorking directly with researchers on caption quality and data mix, and closing the loop on which data moved which eval

Some days you're tuning infrastructure. Some days you're sitting with a researcher, working out why the model learned the wrong thing.

What we're looking for

  • You've built training corpora for visual or multimodal ML at a scale where you had to write code to judge quality because you couldn't review them yourself
  • Hands-on with video and/or audio — codecs, decoding, frame-level work, keeping modalities in sync. Not media as opaque blobs in object storage
  • Python, Kubernetes in production, Ray, Flyte or equivalent, petabyte-scale object storage, sharded dataset formats
  • You've deliberately discarded data and can explain exactly how you decided

We care more about how you think about data than about your years of experience or your publication record. Data engineering or research background — both work.

Also worth a conversation if:

you've never touched video, but you've run petabyte-to-exabyte data infrastructure where selection, layout, throughput and cost were the whole problem. That skill transfers. They've hired against it before.

Why this seat:

You'd define versioning, lineage and the quality bar rather than inherit someone else's from three years ago. The scope doesn't usually fit in one role: video, audio, robotics, synthetic data from our adversarial RL work, and licensed corpora. At a larger lab, that's five teams. You'd own a slice of one. And we name every contributor on our model release pages, including infrastructure and data people.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Do you have experience in quality assurance and are you interested in the Aerospace Industry?

Become part of our unique growth story!

Airborne is a technology leader in advanced composites, specialized in the industrialization of engineering and manufacturing of durable fiber reinforced composites for Space, Aeronautics, Transport and Marine industries. With our 20 years heritage in composites, we provide our clients with high-end composite solutions, either directly through advanced manufacturing of components or by developing industrialization packages which we implement at manufacturers of choice. Airborne’s focus is on high-end composite components, at high production rates at radically low conversion costs. We work in The Hague, Ypenburg (NL) and Lambourn (UK). Together we are a dynamic group of 160 employees. Airborne is growing very fast, around the 50% a year.

What is your new job?
Are you passionate about quality, precision, and innovation? Do you want to ensure that aerospace components meet the highest standards before they venture into space? At Airborne Aerospace, we develop and manufacture advanced composite structures for the aerospace industry. As a Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in defining and optimizing quality processes to ensure our products consistently meet customer and regulatory requirements.

You are responsible for:

As part of our growing QA team (currently 2 members, with planned expansion), you will be responsible for establishing and improving quality processes within Airborne Aerospace. Your key tasks include:

  • Developing and implementing quality assurance plans within projects to ensure compliance with customer requirements.

  • Defining and implementing inspection plans to determine the necessary quality control steps.

  • Ensuring supply chain compliance, working closely with suppliers to uphold quality standards.

  • Reviewing and writing Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), ensuring proper documentation and resolution of quality issues.

  • Leading root cause analyses and implementing corrective and preventive actions for continuous improvement.

  • Improving and maintaining the Quality Management System (QMS) by reviewing and optimizing procedures and work instructions.

  • Acting as the key quality liaison between customers, suppliers, and internal project teams.

  • Performing and supporting internal and external audits, ensuring compliance with industry standards (e.g., AS9100).

We are searching for a strategic thinker who can maintain a high-level overview while diving into the details when necessary. Our ideal candidate has:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent work experience.

  • Experience: At least 3 years of experience in quality assurance within a manufacturing or engineering environment.

  • Industry Knowledge: Experience in aerospace or composite production is an advantage.

  • Auditing Experience: Familiarity with internal and external quality audits.

  • Analytical & Decision-Making Skills: Ability to assess complex quality issues, propose solutions, and implement changes.

  • Process-Oriented Mindset: Strong ability to set up and refine quality processes to meet both customer and regulatory requirements.

  • Technical Competence: Understanding of inspection techniques and ability to determine which inspections are required.

  • Communication & Stakeholder Management: Ability to interact with customers, suppliers, and internal teams, ensuring seamless quality integration.

  • Languages: Proficient in English (spoken and written) to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. (Dutch is a plus)

  • Preferred Knowledge: Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing principles is a plus.


What’s in it for you?

At Airborne Aerospace, you will work on projects that push the boundaries of aerospace technology. We offer:

  • A dynamic work environment driven by innovation and precision.

  • Opportunities for personal and professional growth, including training, on-the-job learning, and coaching.

  • A hybrid work environment with the possibility to work from home.

  • 32 vacation days to ensure a great work-life balance.

  • A salary between € 4.122,- and € 6.342,- gross/month depending on education, knowledge and relevant experience.

  • A solid retirement pension plan.


Interested?

If you are an analytical and detail-oriented professional eager to make a real impact in aerospace, we would love to hear from you! Apply today and help us taking quality to the next level at Airborne Aerospace. Only candidates already living in the Netherlands will be taken into process.

title: Data Engineer
description:
About The Team

Warwickshire County Council is looking for a Data Engineer to help shape how data supports services, communities and decision-making at a time of major change for local government. As Warwickshire prepares for the creation of two new unitary authorities in April 2028, reliable, well-designed data pipelines, integrations and analytical platforms will be essential. This role sits at the heart of that work: maintaining the systems services rely on today while helping us modernise how we manage, join, share and use data for the future.

Warwickshire County Council,

About The Team

Warwickshire County Council is looking for a Data Engineer to help shape how data supports services, communities and decision-making at a time of major change for local government. As Warwickshire prepares for the creation of two new unitary authorities in April 2028, reliable, well-designed data pipelines, integrations and analytical platforms will be essential. This role sits at the heart of that work: maintaining the systems services rely on today while helping us modernise how we manage, join, share and use data for the future.

At the same time, the role of a data engineer is evolving. Alongside maintaining and improving the data pipelines, databases and integrations on which our services rely, we are beginning to explore new ways of working. These include preparing for a future migration to Microsoft Fabric, making greater use of cloud-based data services, strengthening our use of Git, source control and modern development practices, and exploring how AI-assisted development can help us work more effectively.

You will join a friendly and experienced multidisciplinary team working across data engineering, property information and GIS. Our work ranges from supporting operational and statutory services to developing innovative projects such as new web maps and dashboards to help people find, understand and use information about Warwickshire.

About The Role

You may already be working in data engineering, but you could also be a recent graduate, an apprentice completing your training, or someone looking to move into data engineering from software development, analytics, GIS or another technical field.

We do not expect you to have experience of every technology we use. If you have practical experience of using a scripting or programming language, building or orchestrating data pipelines, or cleaning and transforming complex data, we encourage you to apply. Your experience may have been gained through employment, education, a placement, an apprenticeship or substantial project work. What matters most is that you can demonstrate sound technical foundations, an aptitude for solving data problems, a willingness to learn and the potential to develop quickly. In your application, please give us an example of a data or automation problem you have tackled, explain the approach and tools you used, and describe your own contribution. You will have flexibility in how and where you work, and the support of a friendly multidisciplinary team working across data engineering, property information and GIS.

Key Requirements

  • The ability to extract, transform and query data using SQL, Python or other ETL (Extract, Transform and Load) tools
  • The technical capacity to design and build M and DAX queries within Microsoft Power BI
  • Experience of managing complex datasets within a recognised database environment (preferably PostgreSQL/PostGIS) and/or a cloud storage facility (such as a Lakehouse, Delta Lake or Data Lake solution)
  • Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities
  • Experience of using GIS systems, such as ArcGIS, ArcGIS Online, or QGIS
  • Experience of using Git or another version-control system

For further information please see the Job Description and Person Specification.

Working for Warwickshire – This is the difference you make

Warwickshire County Council is a place where everyone feelsvalued, included, safe, supported,andwelcome. Our people are at the heart of this vision, could you be one of them!

At Warwickshire County Council we are committed to ensuring Warwickshire’s economy is vibrant and supported by the right jobs, training, skills and infrastructure. Our people vision for Warwickshire County Council is a great place to work where diverse and talented people are enabled to be their best.

Your future matters to us, we provide a generous pension scheme which includes an employer contribution rate of typically around 19 percent per month, to help support your financial security during retirement. The scheme also offers a valuable package of benefits for members and their dependants. To find out more please visit: Warwickshire Pension Fund homepage – Warwickshire Pension Fund

The benefits we offer include agile working, a valuable part of the pay and reward package for employees working in local government, generous annual leave entitlement, plus bank holidays and an additional day at Christmas, and access to Vivup benefits and discounts platform.

Additional Information

To discuss the role please contact Paul Larcombe, Data Engineering & GIS Manager at paullarcombe@warwickshire.gov.uk

Interview date: 28Th September 2026

title: Lead DevOps Engineer (AWS + PHP)
description:
We create premium play experiences that get families outside and spark imagination. We are expanding into new regions and launching bold products.

The Opportunity

As part of our growing KL hub, we are seeking a Lead DevOps Engineer to serve as the primary technical owner of our AWS-centric cloud ecosystem and deployment pipelines for a custom PHP monolith and some sister Laravel applications. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer (CTO) and working closely with our Tech Lead, this is a hands-on, high-impact technical role.

We need a dedicated specialist who knows how to achieve operational security and infrastructure resilience. As the primary domain owner, you will be responsible for building secure CI/CD pipelines, optimising AWS infrastructure, driving cost efficiencies, and establishing robust incident readiness to keep our global digital platforms performing seamlessly.

What You Will Do

CI/CD & Deployment Management: Build, test, release, rollback, and deployment workflows across Docker and AWS Elastic Beanstalk.

Cloud Infrastructure Administration: Manage AWS infrastructure including Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, load balancers, auto scaling, RDS, S3, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, EventBridge, IAM, Route 53, Certificate Manager, VPC, and related services.

Environment Configuration & Parity: Oversee development, staging, testing, UAT, and production environments to ensure configuration consistency, environment parity, and production readiness.

Secure Configuration Management: Manage application configurations, environment variables, secrets, credentials, API keys, service accounts, and certificates securely.

Monitoring & Observability: Own the system’s health visibility by managing monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, alerts, and uptime checks.

Incident Readiness & Outage Recovery: Develop and maintain incident response plans, runbooks, outage recovery procedures, rollback strategies, and conduct post-incident reviews.

Business Continuity & High Availability: Oversee backup, restore, disaster recovery, failover, high availability, and business continuity processes.

Security & Vulnerability Management: Execute security patching, vulnerability scans, access control management, IAM reviews, MFA/SSO configurations, and enforce minimum-access permissions.

Network & Domain Operations: Manage domains, registrars, Route 53, DNS configurations, subdomains, redirects, and certificate validations.

Cloud Cost Optimisation: Control cloud spend through budget alerts, regular usage reviews, right-sizing resources, scaling rules, and infrastructure waste reduction.

Performance & Capacity Planning: Improve reliability and resilience through autoscaling optimisation, capacity planning, load testing, and removing performance bottlenecks.

Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Implement infrastructure as code and version-controlled infrastructure changes to reduce configuration drift.

Developer Tooling & Workflow Support: Support developer velocity by maintaining local Docker setups, automating manual tasks, writing internal scripts, and assisting with onboarding.

Third-Party & Compliance Support: Manage vendor platform access, track service health, maintain deployment/access logs, and provide evidence for compliance audits and security reviews.

Non-Negotiables (Must Haves)

5+ Years of Senior AWS & DevOps Experience: A proven track record as a hands-on engineer managing production cloud infrastructure across core services (EC2, Elastic Beanstalk, RDS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, Route 53, VPC).

E-Commerce & High-Traffic Infrastructure Experience: Experience supporting high-availability cloud environments for high-traffic e-commerce platforms, particularly during peak promotional events.

CI/CD & Containerisation Mastery: Deep hands-on experience building, maintaining, and automating secure CI/CD pipelines and release workflows using Docker and version control.

Daily Operational Security Focus: Strong practical expertise in managing IAM access controls, handling secrets/certificates, automating vulnerability patching, and auditing system logs.

Incident Readiness & Reliability: Demonstrated experience setting up uptime monitoring, disaster recovery failovers, tested backups, and actionable runbooks to prevent outages.

Disciplined Escalation & Documentation: Exceptional technical communication with a proven ability to work under senior engineering sign-off (CTO), strictly adhering to decision rights, maintaining audit records, and writing clear system documentation.

Clear Communication & Plain-Language Technical Writing: A knack for breaking down complex infrastructure issues, translating technical security risks into clear business impacts, and writing actionable runbooks.

Presence: This is an office-based role in KLCC, Monday to Friday.

Great If You Also Have

Compliance & Audit Readiness: Prior experience collecting deployment records, access logs, and incident tracking data to support compliance audits and formal security reviews.

Cost Governance Frameworks: Experience establishing automated cloud budget tracking alerts and utilising optimisation platforms to systematically uncover infrastructure waste.

Formal Qualifications: AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, AWS Certified Security, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Docker Certified Associate (DCA), Tertiary Degree in Technology.

Why Vuly?

Opportunity to personally drive the modernisation and architectural evolution of our cloud hosting infrastructure.

Your contributions will directly power our production systems, driving real-time performance, security, and reliability for our global customers and internal engineering teams.

You will partner with a pragmatic, high-performing engineering team that prioritises straight talk and real outcomes.

title: Finance Stagiair
description:
Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende en afwisselende meewerkstage? Een stage in een dynamische omgeving waarin je jezelf echt kan ontwikkelen tot professional? Dat komt goed uit, want wij zijn op zoek naar een gemotiveerde stagiair(e) voor onze administratieve afdeling!

  • een stagevergoeding;

  • een werkplek in hartje Utrecht;

  • volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen;

  • de beste koffie van heel Utrecht.

Tijdens je stage ga je ons team ondersteunen met diverse administratie taken voor meerdere mooie horecazaken. Denk hierbij aan verschillende werkzaamheden, zoals het bijhouden van verschillende (financiële) dagboeken, crediteuren- en debiteuren beheer, assisteren bij de maandafsluiting en belastingaangifte.

  • Je volgt een relevante mbo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in de richting van bedrijfsadministratie en zit in het 3e of 4e jaar;

  • Je bent minimaal vier maanden beschikbaar voor 28 uur of meer;

  • Je bent nauwkeurig en kan goed omgaan met verschillende computerprogramma’s;

  • Je hoeft nog niet alles te kunnen. We vinden jouw enthousiasme, inzet en wil om te leren belangrijker dan dat je al overal ervaring mee hebt;

  • Je hebt affiniteit met cijfers en boekhouden en vindt het leuk om jezelf hierin verder te ontwikkelen;

  • Je vindt het leuk om met mensen in contact te zijn en hebt geen drempel om de telefoon te pakken;

  • Je bent niet bang om zelf contact te leggen en houdt van een persoonlijke benadering.

Waar kom je te werken?

Welkom bij Axivate Horeca Group, de organisatie achter enkele van de mooiste horecazaken in de Randstad en Utrecht. Denk aan iconische locaties zoals PK Bar & Kitchen, Stadskasteel Oudaen, Brouwerij Oudaen, Restaurant Rust Wat en Buitenplaats Slangevegt. Iedere zaak heeft zijn eigen unieke identiteit, maar wat ze verbindt, is onze passie voor kwaliteit, gastvrijheid en het creëren van oprechte belevingen. Dit vind je ook terug in ons DNA. Bij Axivate horeca draait alles om een bijzondere ervaring, niet alleen voor onze gasten, maar ook voor jou als medewerker. We willen dat iedereen het beste uit zichzelf en anderen haalt – elke dag weer. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat onze gasten graag terugkomen, dankzij de unieke sfeer, de heerlijke gerechten en onze persoonlijke, authentieke aanpak. Want bij Axivate horeca geloven we dat succes begint met jezelf zijn. Met meer dan 800 collega’s maken wij dagelijks het verschil.

Ready to revolutionize global logistics?


Join Reelables and help us transform how the world tracks packages. We’re pioneering paper-thin smart shipping labels using Bluetooth and 5G to track millions of packages globally — and we’re building the software platform that makes that data usable at scale.


This isn’t a narrow product or UI-only role. You’ll work across the full stack, building customer-facing features end-to-end — from intuitive interfaces through to the APIs, data models, and services that power them. You’ll be hands‑on in the day-to-day, while also helping shape how our platform evolves as we scale.


Who we are:


Reelables is a rapidly scaling tech company based in North London (near Angel), developing the world’s most advanced smart shipping labels. Our technology is already transforming how companies track and manage shipments globally, and we’re still early in that journey.


Product Engineering & Customer Impact


  • Own the end-to-end delivery of customer-facing features, from definition through to production

  • Work hands‑on across the stack to turn complex IoT data into reliable, usable product capabilities

  • Build and evolve APIs, services, and data models that support real-time tracking at scale

  • Design and implement user interfaces where clarity and usability are critical, without being limited to front-end concerns

  • Collaborate directly with customers to understand operational pain points and translate them into practical technical solutions

Technical Ownership & Quality


  • Contribute across frontend, backend, and data layers to keep the platform robust, scalable, and maintainable

  • Make pragmatic backend changes where needed — improving performance, data access, or service design

  • Write production-ready code with strong testing, monitoring, and error handling

  • Participate in architectural decisions, balancing speed of delivery with long-term maintainability

Rapid, Hands‑On Environment


  • Ship code regularly in a lean, fast-moving team where work reaches production quickly

  • Take ownership of features beyond initial delivery, iterating based on real usage and feedback

  • Help shape development practices as the product and team scale

  • Mentor others and contribute to a thoughtful engineering culture

Experience:


Core Technical Skills


  • Strong full‑stack experience, with confidence working across frontend and backend codebases

  • Frontend: Solid experience with TypeScript and modern frameworks (React / Vue)

  • Backend: Experience building and modifying APIs and services (Node.js or similar)

  • Data & Infrastructure: Comfortable working with databases, data models, and cloud-hosted systems (AWS)

  • Engineering Foundations: Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, testing, and operational best practices

Product-Led Engineering


  • Experience building and evolving customer-facing products, not just isolated features

  • Comfortable working close to users and understanding how technical decisions affect real operations

  • Ability to move between product thinking and hands‑on implementation

  • Background in B2B SaaS, logistics, IoT, or data-heavy systems is a bonus

Mindset


  • Enjoys working in an environment where engineers have real ownership and autonomy

  • Pragmatic problem-solver willing to dive wherever needed across the stack

  • Clear communicator who can work effectively with engineers, product, and customers

Platform Administration and Governance

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
AeroCloud: Revolutionizing Airport Operations

AeroCloud is the new-age operating system for airports aiming to grow. Our suite includes Airport Operating Systems (AOS), PPS, and Passenger Flow Management solutions, empowering airports to gain deep insights into the movement of passengers and aircraft around the world.

Job Description

AeroCloud is the new-age operating system for airports aiming to grow. Our suite includes Airport Operating Systems (AOS), PPS, and Passenger Flow Management solutions, empowering airports to gain deep insights into the movement of passengers and aircraft around the world.

We achieve this by becoming the airport’s first call for technology. Whether in times of need or growth, we stand alongside our clients, offering support through innovative software that drives their success.

Our Commitment to Excellence

At AeroCloud, being the airport’s first call means exceeding expectations at every customer interaction. This is not just a goal; it’s our standard. We prioritize detail, diligence, and a proactive approach in everything we do. If there’s a task to be completed, we see it through. If a customer needs an answer we don’t yet have, we respond promptly to let them know we’re on it. We believe in keeping our team informed, being transparent, and maintaining accountability at every step.

About The Role

AeroCloud builds the operating systems airports run on. Our products cover Optic (computer vision for passenger flow), AOS (airport operations and flight management), and PPS (passenger processing and boarding).

We’re hiring a full stack developer into one of our product teams. If you’re a junior developer who’s already operating close to this level, apply anyway — we’ll assess on evidence, not job title.

The pace here is faster and the structure lighter than most established engineering orgs.

We’re agile in practice, not ceremony - progress is what’s running in production, not what’s moved across a board. Our platform team builds the infrastructure and CI/CD that makes it safe for you to ship, not a gate you wait behind.

Responsibilities

You’ll sit inside a cross-functional team and own features end-to-end: design, build, ship, support. Concretely, that means things like:

  • Building and extending React interfaces used daily by airport operations staff
  • Writing TypeScript backend services that talk to MongoDB Atlas and integrate with AWS (ECS, Lambda, EventBridge, SQS)
  • Building event-based, not request-chained — most of our systems are, and that’s the default to design for
  • Building things so they’re observable from the start, and using the tooling to find the actual cause of a production issue
  • Writing infrastructure as code (AWS CDK) rather than clicking around a console
  • Leaving the codebase and its documentation better than you found it

This is production airport infrastructure — real airports, real passenger flow, running today.

What We’re Looking For

For experienced developers – you can already:

  • Write strong TypeScript across frontend or backend, ideally both
  • Ship production React apps or TypeScript services with minimal hand-holding
  • Think in events by default — you reach for an event-driven design when the problem calls for it
  • Build for observability from the start, and use the tooling to find the actual cause of a production issue
  • Communicate a design decision clearly, in writing or a diagram, without needing to be chased for it
  • Avoid over-engineering — you build what the problem needs, not what’s interesting to build

For Junior Developers – We’re Looking For

  • A side project you’re proud of, whatever it is. We’re not interested in candidates coming in cold — show us something you’ve actually built. If it’s live, tell us: that’s production, and we want to hear how it’s held up
  • Solid TypeScript fundamentals and comfort modifying existing code to a pattern
  • Some hands‑on time with React or Node, commercial or otherwise
  • An understanding of what "production-ready" actually means, even if you’re still learning to get there unsupervised
  • A habit of debugging methodically rather than guessing, and asking for help before you’re stuck for hours
  • A genuine interest in what happens to your code after it ships

We value ownership over ambiguity. You take responsibility for the thing in front of you, not just the ticket. We'd rather you flag a problem early than sit on it hoping it resolves itself.

We’re a small team inside a company disrupting a slow-moving industry, so you’ll wear more than one hat - that’s the trade for real ownership this early in a company’s life.

Our Stack

TypeScript (frontend and backend), React, Storybook, MongoDB Atlas, AWS (ECS, Lambda, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, Cognito, Greengrass), AWS CDK. Event-driven by default across the platform. Testing, observability, and CI/CD are built into how we work, not bolted on afterwards

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary
  • Best in Class Share Options scheme
  • 25 days PTO + statutory holidays
  • Take your birthday off work on us as well
  • Extensive upskilling and training
  • Digital Nomad Scheme

Our Ethos

AeroCloud recognises Diversity, Equality, and Inclusion at the heart of our business. They represent the mutual trust, respect and understanding we strive for. They are integral to our brand, reputation, success, business sustainability and employee relations impact.

Our vision is to have a diverse, equal and inclusive organisational culture. We want everyone who comes into contact with us, both face to face and virtually, to feel valued and respected. We want our workplace both in the office and at home to foster belonging to all colleagues to feel seen, connected, supported and proud. We will draw on the rich diversity of our workforce and harness the diverse contributions and considerable talents of our staff to achieve our vision in line with our organisational values and DE&I principles.

AeroCloud is an equal opportunities employer so if you have any specific work or access requirements as a result of a condition or disability then AeroCloud would be committed to working with you on the best way to support this at work.

AI Trainer - Dutch (Task-Based, Remote, Flexible)

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.

The Opportunity

We are looking for fluent Dutch speakers to help train the next generation of AI models - through real conversation. You'll join live video calls with other Dutch-speaking participants, chatting naturally about everyday topics while your conversation is used to help AI models better understand how people actually speak.

This is a genuinely interesting way to shape how AI understands human conversation, one call at a time - your natural way of speaking directly helps these models learn to communicate more like a real person.

This is a task based AI Training job that allows participants to choose their schedule and how much they work - there's no fixed schedule and no minimum hours requirement. Once you have joined the talent pool, you may be asked to complete a short assessment on your language skills. Passing this assessment also opens the door to similar paid projects in future.

Tasks

  • Video Conversations: Have live, natural conversations in Dutch with other participants over video call.
  • Natural Dialogue: Discuss everyday topics and let the conversation flow as it would with anyone else - no scripts, no performance.
  • Data Contribution: Your conversations are recorded and used to help AI models learn natural speech patterns, tone, and cultural nuance.

Tasks are posted individually - you'll see task details, time estimate and pay before deciding whether to take one on.

What You’ll Bring

  • Fluency in Dutch: you must be a fully fluent Dutch speaker.
  • Communication: fluent English for instructions and reporting.
  • A natural conversationalist: comfortable chatting easily and holding a flowing conversation over video call with someone new.
  • Technical Setup: a quiet environment and good-quality headphones/microphone, essential for clear audio and accurate data collection.
  • Soft Skills: friendly, easygoing, and comfortable talking with new people; backgrounds in teaching, interpreting, customer service, or linguistics are a plus.

Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant

Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using your language expertise. description:
REKRYTOIJA / TALOTEKNIIKAN OSAAJA Espooseen

Lavonia on suomalainen henkilöstöpalveluyritys, joka toimittaa talotekniikan ja rakennusalan ammattilaisia vaativiin teollisuus- ja infrahankkeisiin. Asiakkaamme ovat kotimaisia ja kansainvälisiä urakoitsijoita, joiden työmailla aikataulut ovat tiukkoja ja laatuvaatimukset korkeat. Olemme kovaa vauhtia kasvava talo, jossa päätökset tehdään nopeasti ja jokaisen työllä on näkyvä vaikutus.

Kun asiakas tilaa neljäkymmentä sähköasentajaa ja viisi sähkötöiden vastuuhenkilöä muutaman viikon varoitusajalla, jonkun pitää käydä läpi sata hakemusta ja tietää, mitkä niistä kestävät asiakkaan tarkistuksen. Sitä ihmistä haemme.

Lavonia toimittaa talotekniikan ammattilaisia kansainvälisille urakoitsijoille vaativiin hankkeisiin. Haemme rekrytointitiimiimme ihmistä, joka ymmärtää alaa oikeasti — ei vain nimikkeitä CV:n yläreunassa.

Mitä teet

Etsit, haastattelet ja valitset tekijöitä erityisesti sähkö-, LVI- ja automaatiopuolen työmaille. Luet CV:n ja osaat sanoa, vastaako osaaminen sitä mitä asiakas on tilannut.

Vastaat hauistasi alusta loppuun: ilmoitukset, suorahaku, haastattelut, pätevyyksien tarkistus ja ehdokasesittelyt asiakkaalle. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä rekrytointipäällikön, asiakasvastaavien ja työmaiden kanssa.

Ketä etsimme?

Sinua, jolla on kokemusta talotekniikan alalta — asentajana, työnjohdossa, projekteissa tai alan rekrytoinnissa. Tärkeintä on, että alan sanasto, pätevyydet ja työmaan arki ovat tuttuja.

* Sähkö-, LVI- tai automaatioalan tuntemus
* Ymmärrys alan pätevyyksistä ja korteista, kuten SFS 6002 ja sähköpätevyydet
* Kyky pitää monta hakua auki yhtä aikaa ja tehdä päätöksiä nopeasti
* Sujuva suomi ja englanti
* Rehellinen ote: kerrot asiakkaalle myös sen, mitä ehdokkaan CV:stä puuttuu

Eduksi katsomme kokemusta teollisuus-, energia- tai datakeskushankkeista, henkilöstövuokrauksesta sekä kansainvälisten tekijöiden rekrytoinnista ja työlupa-asioista.

Mitä tarjoamme

Rekrytointia, jolla on suora vaikutus: näet oman työsi tuloksen viikoissa. Lyhyt päätöksentekoketju ja vapaus tehdä työtä omalla tavallasi. Kehitämme aktiivisesti omia järjestelmiämme ja tekoälyavusteisia työkaluja rekrytoinnin tueksi, ja pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miltä ne näyttävät.

Kokoaikainen ja vakituinen työsuhde.

Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivan tekijän löydyttyä.

Etsimme energisiä BLOKKAREITA kaupungin iltaravintoloihin ja yökerhoihin!

Keräät ja tiskaat juomalaseja, täytät jääastioita ja varastoja sekä varmistat, että tiskillä riittää kaikkea tarvittavaa – aina oikeaan aikaan.

Työ on nopeatempoista ja sijoittuu pääasiassa iltoihin, öihin ja viikonloppuihin. Tästä syystä edellytämme vähintään 18 vuoden ikää.

Blokkarin rooli on yksi yökerhon tärkeimmistä: ilman sinua illan rytmi pysähtyisi. Olet perusta, jolle koko yö rakentuu – ja mahdollinen tulevaisuuden baarimestari!

Aiempi kokemus ei ole välttämätöntä, sillä perehdytämme sinut huolellisesti tehtävään. Tärkeintä on ahkera, oma-aloitteinen ja toimeen tarttuva asenne. Aikaisempi kokemus ravintola-alalta katsotaan eduksi.

Toivomme hakijalta sujuvaa suomen kielen osaamista, jotta yhteistyö tiimin ja asiakkaiden kanssa sujuu vaivattomasti.

Worker on kotimainen henkilöstöpalvelualan konkari, joka yhdistää työnhakijat ja työpaikat tehokkaasti. Workerin kautta löydät työ- ja koulutusmahdollisuuksia nopeasti ja vaivattomasti. Me etsimme jatkuvasti uusia osaajia ympäri Suomea!

title: Terveyskeskuslääkäri, Martinlaakson terveysasema
description:
Terveydenhuollon palvelujen toimiala, Terveysasemapalvelut
Martinlaakson terveysasema
Laajaniityntie 3, 01620 Vantaa

Me VAKEssa rakennamme yhdessä rohkeasti hyvinvointialuetta, johon asukkaamme voivat luottaa. Haluamme olla vakaa edelläkävijä, joka uudistaa toimintaa avoimesti ja ihmislähtöisesti. Arvomme oikeudenmukaisuus, vastuullisuus ja rohkeus ohjaavat arjen työtämme. Tunnistatko näistä myös omat arvosi?

Tule sinäkin Hyvantekijät-joukkueeseemme!

Haemme Martinlaakson terveysasemalle terveyskeskuslääkäriä vakituiseen virkaan. Etsimme lääkäriä, joka on sitoutunut perusterveydenhuollon kehittämiseen oman kliinisen työnsä ohella. Työ alkaa 1.1.2027 tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Hyvinvointialueemme on varsin tuore ja pääset suunnittelemaan ja kehittämään monia potilasprosesseja. Terveyskeskuslääkärin työ on monipuolista ja antoisaa sisältäen sektorityötä oman kiinnostuksen mukaan. Omalääkärimallimme takaa hoidon jatkuvuuden omien potilaiden osalta yhdessä tiimin kanssa. Koulutuksia järjestämme viikoittain ja kannustamme osallistumaan myös ulkopuolisiin koulutuksiin.

Arvostamme työkokemusta terveysasematyöstä, potilasystävällistä työotetta sekä hyviä tiimityötaitoja. Toivomme kokemusta Apotin käytöstä potilastyössä.

Edellytämme kielivaatimuksena erinomaista suomen kielen kirjallista ja ja suullista osaamista. Arvostamme myös kiinnostusta yleislääketieteeseen erikoistumiseen nyt tai tulevaisuudessa.

Martinlaakson terveysasemalla on 14 terveyskeskuslääkärin, 1 apulaisylilääkärin ja 1 ylilääkärin virkaa. Yksi lääkäreistämme on myös kouluttajalääkäri. Olemme pidetty työpaikka nuorien lääkärien keskuudessa; olemme saaneet NLY:n koulutuspaikkakyselyssä täydet viisi tähteä viime vuosina. Mottomme on, ettei ketään jätetä yksin, vaan kaikkia autetaan. Yhteishenki asemallamme on ollut jo vuosia erinomainen ja meille yleensä jäädäänkin pidemmäksi aikaa kuin alussa oli tarkoitus.

Miksi Vantaan ja Keravan hyvinvointialue?

Meillä hyvinvointi ja arjen sujuvuus ovat aidosti tärkeitä. Tarjoamme lounasedun sekä 400 euron Epassi-edun liikuntaan, kulttuuriin, hyvinvointiin tai työmatkoihin. Lisäksi hyvinvointiasi tukevat lakisääteiset työterveyspalvelumme.

Olemme ihmisläheinen organisaatio, jossa kehitämme toimintaa rohkeasti ja yhdessä. Meillä johtaminen on lupaus selkeistä tavoitteista, arvostavasta kohtaamisesta ja rohkeasta yhdessä uudistamisesta.

Saat selkeän näkymän omaan työhösi sekä mahdollisuuksia kokeilla ja kehittää uusia tapoja tehdä työtä. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia myös oman osaamisesi vahvistamiseen ja urasi kehittämiseen. Teemme merkityksellistä työtä joka päivä: autamme, hoidamme ja pelastamme.

title: Full Stack Developer - Vice President
description:

title: GCP Data Engineer
description:

6-Month Contract Hybrid - 2 Days Onsite in Isleworth

83zero are working with a leading media and broadcasting organisation who are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to join their engineering team on an initial 6-month contract.

We are looking for someone with a strong software engineering mindset who is comfortable developing production‑grade applications, working with large‑scale data platforms and automating cloud infrastructure.

title: Eerste Servicemonteur Elektrotechniek
description:
Je bent technisch sterk, gaat altijd voor kwaliteit én bent toe aan een volgende stap. Als eerste servicemonteur bij TES Groep krijg je de ruimte om jouw technische kennis volledig in te zetten én verder uit te bouwen. Je werkt zelfstandig aan uiteenlopende elektrotechnische installaties: van onderhoud en inbedrijfstellingen tot complexe storingen en kwaliteitscontroles. Word onderdeel van TES!


Als Eerste Servicemonteur Elektrotechniek krijg je bij TES Groep:

Voorwaarden volgens de CAO voor het technische installatiebedrijf én een salaris dat bij jouw kennis en ervaring past.

En verder:

• Bovenop je normale salaris € 285 bruto stand-by-vergoeding;

• Een auto van de zaak;

• Elektrisch gereedschap van Hilti;

• Gereedschapsgeld (positief afwijkend van de cao);

• Laptop, telefoon en tablet via TES (ook privé te gebruiken);

• Pensioen via PMT;

• Een consumptievergoeding;

• Zelf je eigen spullen bestellen;

• Mogelijkheden m.b.t. opleiding/specialisatie (bijv. BMI, MBV, TBV, KNX);

• Behalen van certificaten (bijv. NEN3140, NEN1010, VCA);

• Doorgroeimogelijkheden richting inspecteur, leidinggevende of andere posities binnen TES;

• Personeelsactiviteiten, Sinterklaasviering, (sport-)evenementen, etc.

Als Eerste Servicemonteur Elektrotechniek:

Werk je aan uiteenlopende elektrotechnische installaties in de regio Tilburg-Breda, doorgaans binnen circa 45 minuten van huis. Je gaat zelfstandig op pad voor onderhoud, inbedrijfstellingen en het oplossen van complexere storingen.

Daarbij bewaak je de kwaliteit van installaties en ondersteun je collega’s met jouw technische kennis. Andersom kun jij ook op hen terugvallen: binnen het serviceteam helpen collega’s elkaar en delen ze kennis. Sta je voor een lastige storing? Dan is er altijd iemand die met je meedenkt!

Jouw werkzaamheden:

• Inbedrijfstellen van installaties;

• Uitvoeren van onderhoud;

• Opsporen en oplossen van complexe elektrotechnische storingen;

• Uitvoeren van kwaliteitscontroles;

• Controleren en testen van installaties;

• Technisch ondersteunen van collega’s;

• Je werkzaamheden en bevindingen administratief bijhouden.

Jij past bij TES als je:

• In bezit bent van een mbo-diploma Elektrotechniek;

• Minimaal twee jaar hebt als zelfstandig werkend servicemonteur;

• In bezit bent van een specialisatie (BMI, KNX, etc.);

• Goed communiceert met klanten en collega’s;

• Kwaliteit belangrijk vindt.


Wij zijn TES Groep:

Een full-service installatiebedrijf met ongeveer 170 medewerkers. Vanuit verschillende disciplines werken wij aan elektrotechnische totaaloplossingen voor uiteenlopende opdrachtgevers. Van ontwerp en realisatie tot service, onderhoud en inspectie: TES is betrokken bij de volledige levenscyclus van installaties.

Wij werken onder andere voor overheden, onderwijsinstellingen, gemeenten, retail, bouwbedrijven en zorginstellingen. TES besteedt veel aandacht aan de mens én diens individuele ontwikkeling: opleidingen, ontwikkeling, doorgroei en het delen van kennis. Samen brengen we techniek tot leven!


Klaar voor je volgende stap?

Bij TES werk je niet alleen aan installaties, maar ook aan je eigen ontwikkeling. Zo kun je bijvoorbeeld doorgroeien naar inspecteur, leidinggevende of andere posities binnen TES.

Met volop mogelijkheden voor technische opleidingen en specialistische certificeringen zoals SCIOS Scope, KNX, brandmeld- en beveiligingstechniek (MBV/TBV), NEN 3140 en NEN 1010 blijf jij bouwen aan je toekomst!

Zie jij dit helemaal zitten? Solliciteer dan direct of neem contact op met Sanne Becht van Forp, via 06 58 88 46 48 of sanne@forp.nl. Twijfel je of deze functie bij je past? Bel of app Sanne gerust even, een cv is niet direct nodig.

title: Research & Development Software Engineer: Innovation
description:
We Are Innovators & Category Creators

Clickatell , founded in Cape Town in 2000 , was the first company to connect businesses with consumers via SMS using just four lines of code. Today, it powers AI-driven chat commerce for leading global brands across industries like banking, retail, telecoms, and healthcare . Over 25 years , Clickatell has led multiple industry firsts through its award-winning AI Chat Commerce Platform , enabling brands to connect, interact, and transact with customers seamlessly.

The Role

As a Research and Development Engineer: Innovation (Intermediate), you are a key driver of our R&D initiatives, responsible for taking ownership of complex features and technical challenges. You will collaborate with engineers and researchers to design and implement innovative solutions that enhance our SaaS platform. This role marks a transition into an "Independent Solver," where you are expected to navigate ambiguity and lead small "Tactical Pods" or projects from ideation to execution. You play a vital role in mentoring junior talent and graduates, ensuring our innovation efforts are modular, scalable, and aligned with the "Big Picture" of our systems architecture.

We Do The Right Things

Responsibilities of the Role

  • Research and Analysis: Conduct in-depth research on industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitor products to identify opportunities for innovation.
  • Idea Generation: Brainstorm, conceptualize, and propose innovative ideas and solutions that can improve our SaaS products.
  • Prototyping: Develop proof-of-concept prototypes to test and validate new ideas, leveraging your technical skills.
  • Collaborative Innovation: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including software developers, designers, and product managers, to bring innovation projects to life.
  • Documentation: Document research findings, design concepts, and development processes to maintain a clear and organized record of innovation efforts.
  • Testing and Validation: Assist in testing and validation of new features, ensuring they meet the highest quality standards.
  • Continuous Learning: Stay up-to-date with the latest technologies and best practices to contribute to a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.
  • Independent Solutioning: Take ownership of complex "Stories" and navigate ambiguity by figuring out how to build a solution from high-level requirements with minimal oversight.
  • Feature Ownership & Integration: Manage the end-to-end development of specific features, ensuring that code is not only functional but modular, data-driven, and seamlessly integrates into the broader SaaS architecture.
  • Technical Quality Assurance: Perform rigorous peer reviews and self-testing to ensure all delivered code is "Day 2" ready- meaning it is extendable, secure, and maintains system performance as it moves toward production readiness.
  • Active Mentorship: Support the growth of Junior Engineers and Graduates by providing technical guidance on their tasks, performing constructive code reviews, and helping them navigate the department's "Way of Work".

We Are On A Learning Journey

Requirements of the Role

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 4 years of experience with a track record of "figuring out how to build it" and working alone.
  • Strong programming skills in languages such as Python, Java, or C++.
  • A passion for innovation and a keen interest in emerging technologies.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a team.
  • Demonstrates Eagerness to learn, adapt, and take on new challenges.
  • Knowledge of SaaS and cloud computing is essential.
  • Experience taking ownership of a full "Story" from initial requirement to a functional, integrated feature.
  • Ability to provide constructive code reviews and technical support to Junior engineers and Graduates.
  • Good AI understanding and daily use in a responsible way.

A Bit About You

Behavioral competency requirements of a Highflyer:

  • Team Player : Self-directed and dedicated team player who positively engages with the team to solve.
  • Optimizing Processes : Optimally utilizes the tools and resources available to maximizes output. Conducts day-to-day operations using best practice to achieve effectiveness and accuracy. Continuously reviews and makes recommendations for process improvements.
  • Expert Thinker : Equipped with specialist knowledge and makes recommendations that are practical, smart and ready to implement. Remains up-to-date in the industry and offers technical advice, and support to own team and others.
  • Effective Problem-Solver : Resourceful, persistent, and creative when solving problems. Able to be analytical and follow a logical process to make decisions. Finds the balance between a good and quick decision through experience and knowledge. Able to present and explain thinking and the resulting decision.
  • Connecting Collaboratively : Actively connects to bring cohesion and deliver excellence. Sees the value in working closely with different specialities and teams to ensure all operations are aligned to meet the required objectives.
  • Maximizing Awareness : Recognizes emotions and how it affects behavior and relationships. Self-aware and picks up on emotional cues in situations. Self-manages and empowered to show initiative, follow through on commitments, and work well in a team. Listens, reflects, and responds effectively to constructive criticism.
  • Enabling Strategy : Implements the action plans in order to produce practical outputs while considering the implication, and consequences for the organization and our customers.
  • Action Orientated Mindset : Know-how to skilfully approach technical activities to deliver value. Eager to deliver new or improved solutions to drive the organization forward. Focused on what needs to be done and ensures follow-through on all commitments.
  • Embracing Change : Invites change and stays focused and resilient, and chooses responses that are positive when feeling uncertain. Remains flexible, adaptable, and open to opportunities to be innovative. Uses failure as an opportunity to learn and grows. Thinks ahead, anticipates, and acts.
  • Driving Delivery : Goal-oriented and monitors processes and systems to ensure tracking towards goals despite challenging and stressful situations. Sets high standards for quality and performance and provides metrics to show improvements as well as real-time variance for effective tracking.

Why You Should Join

Perks of the Role

  • Medical Aid contribution
  • Pension fund contribution
  • Quarterly performance incentive bonus
  • Risk benefit company contributions
  • Reimbursable communications allowance for internet and mobile phone bills
  • Half-day off on your birthday
  • 5 personal days leave a year, over and above your annual leave
  • Remote Working (our offices are currently open for essential use only due to COVID-19)
  • Home office set-up with laptop, monitor and other related items.

Stronger Together

At Clickatell, Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of who we are - from how we build our product platforms to how we build our workforce. We believe that we are stronger together and by leveraging the power of diversity and inclusion, we are able to generate innovative ideas to revolutionize the way the world uses chat technology. We create common ground - Our platform is for all, and so is our workplace. Everyone is welcome at Clickatell and our employees feel psychologically safe and empowered to show up with their authentic selves at work.

title: Lead Data Engineer

title: Design Manager, EMEA Portfolio, Design, Sustainability & Engineering
description:
The Global Design team is looking for a creative, innovative, results-oriented designer based in Luxembourg, Madrid or London who will be responsible for the design of select new buildings or expansion projects post-occupancy tenant improvement in Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA) portfolio. This role will join the Global Design team, reporting to the EMEA Design Manager, and will work closely with the EMEA Design & Construction (D&C) teams, the Workplace Guidelines & Standards team and the Global Transformation & Insights team.

This role will be responsible for the oversight of the design of “post-occupancy” tenant improvement projects, which means updating, revising and evolving the design of a space where Amazonians are currently working, and small/medium new site projects (new sites) or expansions. The project scope ranges from the design of several floors of a building to suit the needs and behaviors of a new team, to the design of smaller specialty spaces, to developing an overall design solution that can improve the workplace that can be applied to multiple projects (for example, an improvement to acoustics, lighting, or furniture). Over time, this role should gain familiarity with Amazon’s EMEA corporate workplace portfolio in order to pro-actively identify and recommend design solutions for certain buildings or spaces. This role will work closely with the EMEA D&C team and sub-consultants/vendors on project delivery.

The successful candidate is an experienced, and engaging professional who can communicate clearly at all levels, and yet is not afraid to dive deep into details. This role works autonomously and creatively in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment, and will be working on multiple projects and initiatives, most of which have very tight delivery timelines. Attention to detail and ability to inspect issues and processes brings simplified solutions to complex problems is paramount. They should also understand the nuance of being approachable, while at the same time consultative. The candidate must be able to balance frugality with creativity in offering solutions and approach problem-solving with an emphasis on root cause.

This is a Regional role focused on the EMEA region, so requires regional travel approximately 20-30% of the time. At Amazon, we also believe that in-person collaboration is essential to our culture and innovation. While we allow flexibility for personal circumstances, we generally expect employees to work from our offices five days a week. This approach has consistently shown that spontaneous interactions, rapid problem-solving, and the energy of in-person teamwork lead to better results for our customers. In particular, our data shows that teams working together in person are more effective at making complex decisions, onboarding new team members, and fostering the kind of creative collaboration that has driven Amazon's success. The serendipitous hallway conversations and impromptu whiteboarding sessions that happen naturally in an office environment have proven invaluable to our invention process and maintaining our high bar for excellence.

Key job responsibilities
- Oversee and manage the design of post-occupancy tenant improvement projects and small/medium new site projects and expansions, to include (1) leading the design of the space based on customer needs and technical requirements; (2) on some projects of a certain size/scale/priority, collaborate with an external/vendor design team (the Architect of Record) (3) align the design of each project to the overall concept for Corporate Workplace, as developed by the Global Design team; and (4) inform Guidelines and Standards team on design elements needed to translate into global functional Guidelines..
- Identify and implement continuous design refinement, leveraging operational data, customer insights, and success metrics to drive change.
- Work cross functionally with regional peers to ensure a consistent experience for customers, whilst respecting local/cultural nuance.
- Collaborate with GREF partner teams, including Regional Portfolio Management, Sustainability and Environmental Health and Safety, and Travel and Events, to elevate program deliverables and improve the quality of Amazon workspace with a focus on resiliency, efficiency, health, and safety.
- Routinely connect to external industry, professional bodies and communities, ensuring new industry standards, best practices, technology, and innovations are adopted into the program.


A day in the life
Day-to-day, this role will mainly collaborate with the EMEA Constrution team responsible for construction and delivery of projects. Also collaborate with external vendors as local project managers and design team (Architect of Record). Once projects are delivered, this role will work with the Workplace Guidelines & Standards team to indicate what design elements need to be integrated, including producing visuals and narratives that can be translated and published as Guidelines. The role will need also to be able to work in conjunction with other stakeholders to develop any process improvement initiatives or programs related to workplace design.

About the team
The Global Real Estate and Facilities (GREF) team manages Amazon's real estate and facilities globally. It's organized into Regional Portfolio Management, Global Centers of Enablement, and Global Centers of Expertise. Design, Sustainability and Engineering includes Global Design, Workplace Guidelines, Sustainability, and Engineering teams. These teams develop design concepts, implement workplace standards, and deliver various spaces across Amazon's portfolio. GREF emphasizes inclusive team culture, work-life balance, and career growth. The team values diversity and promotes knowledge sharing and mentorship. GREF strives to create spaces that support Amazonians' work while enhancing employee well-being and aligning with the company's strategic vision.

title: Dierenarts Interne Geneeskunde
description:
Dierenkliniek Orion in Herentals is op zoek naar een gedreven Dierenarts interne geneeskunde om ons team te versterken. Dierenkliniek Orion is een gerenommeerd veterinair verwijscentrum in Herentals, onderdeel van Nesto. We bouwen aan een centrum waar diergeneeskunde op het hoogste niveau samengaat met een warme, betrokken teamsfeer. Onze afdeling interne geneeskunde wordt gedragen door drie gecertificeerde dierenartsen (CSAVM/internal medicine) met ondersteuning van onze andere diensten en van onze ervaren dierverpleegkundigen.
Samen zorgen zij voor een stevige basis van kennis, ervaring, begeleiding en samenwerking.
Ter versterking van dit team zoeken we een voltijdse dierenarts interne geneeskunde die mee wil bouwen aan de verdere groei van Orion, met oog voor de lange termijn. Als dierenarts Interne Geneeskunde krijg je een centrale en gevarieerde rol binnen onze dienst. Je behandelt het volledige spectrum van internistische aandoeningen.
Wat houdt de functie in?
  • Je staat in voor de diagnostiek, behandeling en opvolging van patiënten met uiteenlopende internistische aandoeningen.
  • Je krijgt de ruimte om zelf aanvullende onderzoeken uit te voeren (zoals bijvoorbeeld endoscopieën), dit afhankelijk van je ervaring en interessegebieden.
  • Je kan altijd rekenen op je ervaren en goed opgeleide collega's.
  • Je blijft nauw betrokken bij je patiënten tijdens hun hospitalisatie en volgt hun evolutie mee op. Hiervoor neem je dagelijks deel aan de patiëntenronde met de interns en hospitalisatie-dierverpleegkundigen.
  • Je kan rekenen op de expertise en ondersteuning van je collega’s (oa. ECVN en ECVS diplomates) binnen de verschillende diensten en kan rekenen op uitgebreide onderzoeks- en behandelingsmogelijkheden (chirurgie, endoscopie, CT, high-field MRI, ICU, ...)
Zo combineren we een persoonlijke opvolging van de patiënt met een sterke multidisciplinaire aanpak, waarbij we elkaar versterken in de diagnostiek en behandeling. We zoeken een gemotiveerde teamspeler. Je neemt graag initiatief, maar zoekt evengoed actief het overleg en de samenwerking met collega's op. Je staat open voor een samenwerking met interns, studenten en dierverpleegkundigen.
Daarnaast breng je mee:
  • Een ESAVS-certificate interne geneeskunde of een gelijkwaardig diploma
  • Zin om te leren en te groeien, of net om je kennis en ervaring door te geven aan collega's

Heb je de minimale opleiding nog niet maar wel de motivatie en interesse om je hierin te verdiepen? Wij kunnen een opleidingstraject aanbieden. Wij willen geen potentieel missen!
  • Een voltijdse functie in een gerenommeerd verwijscentrum, met alle faciliteiten om interne geneeskunde op het hoogste niveau te beoefenen
  • Volledige begeleidings- en doorgroeimogelijkheden onder de hoede van onze ESAVS-trained dierenartsen, met steun van onze andere diensten en onze ervaren dierverpleegkundigen indien nodig
  • Een sterke teamspirit en ruimte voor overleg met collega's
  • Een correcte verloning en opleidingsbudget.
Herken je jezelf in dit profiel en wil je mee bouwen aan de toekomst van Dierenkliniek Orion? Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via ​onderstaande link.

Je kijkt wat er in een woning moet gebeuren, pakt het probleem aan en zorgt dat alles netjes en veilig wordt achtergelaten. Daarbij heb je regelmatig contact met bewoners.

Je werkt zelfstandig, maar kunt altijd terugvallen op je collega’s. Binnen het serviceteam helpen jullie elkaar en delen jullie kennis. Sta je voor een lastige storing? Dan is er altijd iemand die met je meedenkt!

Jouw werkzaamheden:
