• Aanleggen en aanpassen van basisinstallaties;

• Opsporen en oplossen van storingen en technische problemen;

• Zelfstandig plannen en uitvoeren van kleine elektrotechnische werkzaamheden.

Jij past bij TES als je:

• In bezit bent van een mbo-diploma Elektrotechniek;

• Minimaal twee jaar ervaring hebt als servicemonteur;

• Zelfstandig kunt werken;

• Slim, praktisch en efficiënt werkt;

• Contact met bewoners leuk vindt.

Wij zijn TES Groep:

Een full-service installatiebedrijf met ongeveer 170 medewerkers. Vanuit verschillende disciplines werken wij aan elektrotechnische totaaloplossingen voor uiteenlopende opdrachtgevers. Van ontwerp en realisatie tot service, onderhoud en inspectie: TES is betrokken bij de volledige levenscyclus van installaties.

Wij werken onder andere voor overheden, onderwijsinstellingen, gemeenten, retail, bouwbedrijven en zorginstellingen. TES besteedt veel aandacht aan de mens én diens individuele ontwikkeling: opleidingen, ontwikkeling, doorgroei en het delen van kennis. Samen brengen we techniek tot leven!


Klaar voor je volgende stap?

Bij TES werk je niet alleen aan installaties, maar ook aan je eigen ontwikkeling. Zo kun je bijvoorbeeld doorgroeien naar eerste servicemonteur.

Met volop mogelijkheden voor technische opleidingen en specialistische certificeringen zoals SCIOS Scope, KNX, brandmeld- en beveiligingstechniek (MBV/TBV), NEN 3140 en NEN 1010 blijf jij bouwen aan je toekomst!

Ben je starter met de juiste instelling en motivatie? Ook dan maken we graag kennis met je. Solliciteer direct of neem contact op met Sanne Becht van Forp, via 06 58 88 46 48 of sanne@forp.nl. Twijfel je of deze functie bij je past? Bel of app Sanne gerust even, een cv is niet direct nodig.

title: Rengasasentaja syksyn sesonkiin
description:
Rengasasentaja sesonkiin

Hei, juuri sinä!

Me etsimme asiakkaallemme rengasasentajia sesongin ajaksi Hyvinkäälle.

Mistä on kyse?

Etsimme asiakasyrityksillemme rengasasentajia sesongin ajaksi. Työt alkavat valittujen henkilöiden kohdalla heti, kun sesonki käynnistyy. Työn kesto on muutamia viikkoja, riippuen asiakkaan tarjoamista tehtävistä.

Toivomme aikaisempaa kokemusta renkaan vaihdosta, mutta tämä ei ole välttämätönta, asenne ratkaisee! Omaathan kuitenkin vähintään reippaan työotteen ja oma-aloitteiset työskentely tavat. Työ on fyysistä ja kiireistä ja täten vaatii hyvää kuntoa. Palkkaus määräytyy osaamisesi mukaan, joten ilmoitathan hakemuksessasi mahdolliset aikaisemmat kokemukset, sekä palkkatoiveesi.

Haastattelut pidetään ennen sesonkia ja henkilöt valitaan hyvissä ajoin, jotta aloitus onnistuu nopeallakin rytmillä.

Kuinka haen Carrotille?

Voit jättää hakemuksesi oheisen linkin kautta. Jos olet jo aiemmin jättänyt hakemuksen Carrotille, voit hakemuslomakkeen kautta myös kirjautua sisään käyttäjätunnuksillasi ja päivittää aiempaa hakemuspohjaasi jättääksesi hakemuksen tähän työpaikkaan. Carrotille työhakemuksen jättäminen on helppoa ja nopeaa, ja olemme yhteydessä kaikkiin työhakemuksen jättäneisiin. Kartoitamme osaamisesi ja toiveesi työpaikan suhteen, ja tarjoamme sinulle yhdellä hakemuksella yhteydet satoihin työpaikkoihin, sekä koko elämän mittaisia urapolkuja!

Jos sinulla on kysyttävää työpaikkoihimme, työnhakuun tai palveluihimme liittyen, löydät yhteystietomme myös osoitteesta

Nähdään Carrotilla!

Carrot on nopea, välittävä ja vastuullinen työelämän kumppani, jonka tärkeimpänä tavoitteena on olla luomassa hyvää työelämää kaikille. Tarjoamme valtakunnallisesti henkilöstövuokraus-, rekrytointi- ja ulkoistuspalveluita sekä toimimme strategisena HR-kumppanina asiakkaillemme. Carrot on toiminut jo vuodesta 1998.

title: Customer Enablement Specialist (12 month FTC)
description:
Job title: Customer Enablement Specialist (12 Month Fixed-Term)

Location: Paris

Salary: €42,400 - €53,000

Team: Client Delivery EMEA

Reporting To: Operating Model Design Lead


This role is based in Paris, France and requires an existing right to work in the EU.

At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship.

Please submit your application in English.


Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What will I be doing?

In this role, you will be a key driver of our mission to reimagine energy and make net-zero a reality for everyone. As a Customer Enablement Specialist, you will be the bridge between our innovative technology and the people who use it. You will empower our clients, partners, and colleagues in French-speaking markets to not only understand our platform but to master it - including the AI-powered capabilities we are continuously building and rolling out. Your work will directly accelerate Kaluza's growth by ensuring our users are confident, capable, and ready to support the energy transition.

Strategic Training & Programme Partnership: Act as a trusted advisor to our clients, partners, and internal teams, performing deep learning needs analysis to understand their unique operational challenges. You'll manage your workstream with genuine project and programme management discipline - planning, sequencing and tracking delivery within complex, multi-stakeholder client programmes, ideally drawing on agile ways of working to stay responsive as scope evolves.

Content Creation & Delivery: You will be the master of making the complex simple. You'll create high-quality, engaging training materials in both French and English, including interactive workshops, e-learning modules, and quick reference guides - translating not just today's platform, but AI features and products still in development, into training that's ready the moment they go live. You'll deliver these sessions virtually and in-person, inspiring your audience and building their confidence with every interaction.

Driving Adoption & Impact: Your role is to accelerate the adoption of the Kaluza platform. You will provide post-training support and coaching, monitor the effectiveness of your programmes, and continuously iterate based on feedback and performance metrics. You'll ensure our training leads to real-world, positive change for our users and the energy industry.


About You

Ideally you’ll have/be

  • Bilingual Fluency, to a high standard: You are fluent in both French and English, with outstanding written and spoken communication skills - essential for day-to-day stakeholder management across multiple countries, up to and including executive level.
  • Operational & Technical SaaS Training Expertise: A proven track record designing and delivering training in a SaaS or technology environment, ideally with hands-on experience of operational or technical instructional training rather than generalist L&D delivery.
  • Project & Programme Management Experience: Strong project and/or programme management experience gained within complex, multi-stakeholder environments; experience of agile delivery is a strong advantage.
  • Operational Experience: Demonstrable experience gained within an operational environment - energy sector operations and/or contact centre settings are especially valued - giving you a first-hand understanding of the pressures and workflows your training needs to support.
  • AI Fluency: Demonstrable experience building, productionalising, or delivering training on AI features and products while they are still in development, and genuine confidence working with AI tools as part of your own everyday practice.
  • Simplification Master: You possess a natural ability to take complex technical and business concepts and translate them into clear, engaging, and practical learning materials.
  • Engaging Facilitator: You are a confident and dynamic presenter, able to captivate diverse audiences and create a fun, interactive learning environment.
  • Collaborative & Proactive: You are a team player who builds strong relationships and is proactive in identifying opportunities to support others and drive continuous improvement.

What will set you apart

  • Energy Sector Acumen: A practical background in energy utility operations or decarbonisation technologies, beyond the operational experience above, that lets you connect training directly to the real-world challenges our clients face.
  • Proven Training Leadership: A demonstrated track record of scaling training programmes and an ability to think strategically about how to build and expand a learning culture across an international organisation.


Where you'll work

We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.


Kaluza Values

Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:

Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together.


Our Perks

  • Financial & Insurance: Discretionary bonus, Alan Mutuelle Health Insurance, x3 Life & Death insurance (Prévoyance) via Alan, and standard Sécurité Sociale contributions (pension, family allowance, unemployment insurance)
  • Allowances: 50% commuting expense reimbursement, €200 Home Working Allowance, and €150 Learning Fund
  • Time Off & Flexibility: 25 days holiday + bank holidays + RTT days, Moments That Matter Leave, Compassionate Leave, two paid Volunteering Days, Flexible Working, and Career Break eligibility


We want the best people

We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.

Find out more about working in Kaluza on our careers page and LinkedIn.

You can also find our Applicant Data Protection Policy here.

title: SEND Engagement Facilitator
description: Interviews: 14 th October Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role. Applicants must have a current, unrestricted right to work in the UK. This is a fixed term contract / secondment opportunity until 31 st March 2028. Essex County Council has embarked upon a programme of change for provision and services with the ambition to profoundly improve the outcomes and life experience of children and young people with Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND). Our vision is for a SEND system which identifies and assesses need at an earlier stage, and which provides appropriate and impactful support without such high dependence on Essex County Council’s statutory services. The SEND Engagement Facilitator will support sustainable inclusion for children and young people with SEND, through targeted support to educational settings, families and partners. They enable collaborative practice in throughout One Planning and ensure a joined-up approach to the Assess, Plan, Do, Review Cycle, particularly at points of transition for CYP. This SEND Engagement Facilitator (EF) role will have a focused EF caseload within the Education Otherwise than in School/College (EOTIS/C) workstream. Education otherwise than in school or college (EOTIS/C) | Essex Schools Infolink Responsibilities will include collaborating with parent/carers, young people and professionals to organise and facilitate Education Health and Care Plan (EHCP) Annual Reviews and One Planning. One Planning | Essex Schools Infolink The EOTIS/C EF will sit with the Engagement Facilitator team, line managed by the Senior Engagement Facilitator but will also work closely with the SEND Operations Team. With an RQF level 3 qualification or equivalent by experience, thorough knowledge of the SEND Code of Practice 2015 and experience of working with young people with SEND and extensive stakeholder engagement and collaboration. Accountabilities As part of a multi- disciplinary team, provide targeted intervention to families and professionals at points of change, challenge and transition to support longer term resilience and the dialogue essential to the success of CYP educational placements and outcomes. Utilise and model enabling, collaborative and person-centred ways of working to ensure pupil and family voices are captured, valued and held at the heart of the 0-25 planning for CYP. Identify and facilitate effective ways of gathering, recording and sharing information about a CYP, their family, setting or situation to inform the planning for them, through statutory or non-statutory plans. Support the partnership between educational setting staff, families and other stakeholders to promote shared understanding of the aspirations, needs, outcomes and required provision for CYP. Work directly with CYP and their families to develop their understanding of and participation in assessment, planning and decision-making processes in order that their plans and implementation are fully coproduced and understood. Act as a model of good One Planning to LA colleagues, and as a conduit of information for targeted work with families and educational settings, allowing the Inclusion and SEND Operations teams in each quadrant to work cohesively as part of early intervention approaches. Plan, deliver and evaluate a range of development opportunities for staff in educational settings in relation to partnership and person-centred practice and its application, enabling educators to embed this approach within their engagement with families. title: Huonekalumyyjä Stemma Tornio
description:
Haluatko työskennellä tunnetun huonekalualan brändin parissa ja auttaa asiakkaita löytämään parhaat ratkaisut kotiinsa? Oletko oma-aloitteinen myynnin ja asiakaspalvelun tekijä, joka viihtyy monipuolisissa työtehtävissä ja asiakkaiden parissa?

Haemme asiakkaallemme Stemma Tornille myyjää 1–2 kuukauden sijaisuuteen. Työn arvioitu aloitus on lokakuun alussa sovittavan aikataulun mukaisesti.

Stemma on yksi Suomen suurimmista ja perinteikkäimmistä huonekaluketjusta. Vuonna 1974 perustettu kotimainen ketju tunnetaan laadukkaista kodin kalusteista sekä asiakaslähtöisestä palvelustaan. Nyt sinulla on loistava mahdollisuus liittyä osaksi Stemma Tornion ammattitaitoista ja asiakaspalveluhenkistä tiimiä.

Työssäsi vastaat myymälän asiakaspalvelusta ja myynnistä sekä autat asiakkaita löytämään heidän tarpeisiinsa sopivat tuotteet. Päivittäisiin työtehtäviisi kuuluvat myös myymälä siisteyden ylläpito, tuotteiden esillepano ja noutoasiakkaiden palveleminen. Monipuoliseen työnkuvaan sisältyy lisäksi kalusteiden kasaamista sekä tuotteiden kotiinkuljetuksia. Tehtävässä tarvitaan käytännön läheistä työotetta, hyvää fyysistä kuntoa tuotteiden siirtämiseen ja kantamiseen sekä valmiutta työskennellä viikonloppuisin.

Sovit tähän työhön, jos sinulta löytyy:

  • Asiakaspalveluhenkinen ja myyntiorientoitunut asenne
  • Oma-aloitteinen, vastuullinen ja luotettava työotoe
  • Hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja tiimityötaidot
  • Huolellisuutta sekä kykyä työskennellä myös kiireen keskellä
  • Joustavuutta työaikojen ja työtehtävien suhteen
  • Hyvä fyysinen kunto tuotteiden liikuttamiseen ja kantamiseen
  • Perus IT-Taidot

Hienoa (muttei välttämätöntä) on, jos sinulla on lisäksi:

  • Aikaisempaa kokemusta myyntityöstä
  • Kaupallinen koulutus
  • Ruotsin kielen taitoa
  • Kokemusta vähittäiskaupasta tai huonekalujen myynnistä

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen työn tunnetun huonekaluketjun palveluksessa sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi, myynnin, asiakaspalvelun ja myymälätyön parissa. Pääset osaksi nuorekasta ja joustavaa työyhteisöä, jossa arvostetaan aktiivista asennetta ja halua onnistua työssä.

Me tarjoamme sinulle:

  • Kaupan TESin mukaisen tai sitä paremman palkan, joka maksetaan aina ajallaan. Tässä työssä tuntipalkkasi sijoittuu 13,13-14,93 euron välille, ja se määritellään osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan.
  • Hyvät työvaatteet ja muut työssä tarvittavat varusteet
  • Mukavan ja rennon työporukan
  • Oman Workerin yhteyshenkilön, joka on helposti tavoitettavissa ja auttaa sinua henkilökohtaisesti kaikissa työsuhteeseesi liittyvissä asioissa

Miksi kannattaa hakea töitä juuri Workerin kautta:

"Workerilla voin luottaa siihen, että he näkevät potentiaalini, mihin pystyn ja mikä haastaa minua sopivasti”, kuvailee kauttamme työn löytänyt ammattilainen.

Me teemme sen, minkä lupaamme. Haluamme olla rekrytoijana ja työnantajana joustava, luotettava ja oikeudenmukainen. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa, että:

  • Meillä on reilu meininki. Saat aina työsopimuksen ja palkan ajallaan. Teemme sen minkä lupaamme, emmekä lupaa asioita, joita emme voi pitää.
  • Panostamme henkilökohtaiseen palveluun. Saat oman yhteyshenkilön, joka vastaa, kun soitat – niin pienissä kuin isommissakin työasioissa. Olet myös aina tervetullut piipahtamaan konttorillamme, tarjoamme kahvit! Toimipisteitä meillä on ympäri Suomen yhteensä 13.
  • Olemme puolellasi. Varmistamme, että saat asianmukaiset työvaatteet ja varusteet. Panostamme myös erityisen paljon työturvallisuuteen. Yhteyshenkilösi myös tukee sinua tarvittaessa työelämän kiemuroissa.
  • Tarjoamme paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia. Oli tähtäimessäsi sitten alasi huippu, työelämässä rennosti surffailu tai kokonaan uusi ala, meiltä löytyy mahdollisuuksia ympäri Suomen. Voimme auttaa sinua myös löytämään urallesi uuden suunnan.

Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi!

Jätä hakemuksesi klikkaamalla hakupainiketta. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jatkuvasti, eli jätä hakemuksesi pian! Toivomme että voit aloittaa työt mahdollisimman pian.

Hakemisen jälkeen kuulet meistä lyhyen ajan kuluessa. Jos etenet rekrytointiprosessissa, tapaat ensin Workerin työntekijän rennossa haastattelussa, jonka tavoitteena on tutustua tarkemmin sinuun ja sinun osaamiseesi. Viimeisessä vaiheessa pääset tapaamaan Stemma Tornion yhteyshenkilön.

Lisätietoja tästä työstä ja muista Workerin tarjoamista työmahdollisuuksista voit kysyä arkisin Sannalta p. 050 370 5678 / sanna.mustajarvi@worker.fi

title: Data Analyst
description:
Official Internal Title: Data Specialist

About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Singapore, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

Who Thrives Here?

We hire sprinters, not coasters—people who:

  • Choose growth over comfort
  • Lead through challenges
  • Are energized by high expectations

It’s not for everyone, and that’s intentional. If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

About the Role

You’ll join one of our sector teams, covering industries such as consumer goods, software, or financial services. These teams build and maintain the analytical data products our clients rely on to understand companies and markets.

As a Data Analyst (Internal Official Title: Data Specialist), you’ll learn how to turn large, complex datasets into accurate and useful insights. You’ll help maintain recurring analyses, investigate changes in the data, and improve the workflows behind our products.

You’ll work closely with a Data Lead and experienced teammates to learn our datasets, methodologies, and quality standards. You’ll begin by owning specific analyses and recurring tasks, with support and feedback as you build confidence. Over time, you’ll take on broader responsibility for products and workflows.

This role is well suited to someone early in their analytics career who enjoys solving problems, pays close attention to detail, and wants to understand how data informs investment decisions. You don’t need to arrive with deep knowledge of financial markets or alternative data—we’re looking for a strong analytical foundation, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.

What You’ll Do:

  • Help deliver accurate, reliable data products. Run and maintain recurring analyses, complete quality checks, and investigate unexpected results. Build toward ownership of defined products and workflows as your expertise grows.
  • Work with large datasets to answer client questions. Use SQL and Python to explore data, identify trends, and understand what the results tell us about the companies and industries we cover.
  • Investigate data problems. Work with teammates to trace discrepancies, test assumptions, and evaluate possible explanations. Learn when to investigate further and when to ask for guidance.
  • Use AI and automation to improve your work. Identify repetitive tasks, contribute to reusable workflows, and learn to use AI tools effectively while validating their outputs.
  • Collaborate across teams. Partner with Research, Engineering, Product, and other teams to resolve issues and deliver high-quality products. Communicate your findings clearly and document your work so others can build on it.
  • Suggest improvements. Bring questions and ideas that help the team strengthen quality checks, improve documentation, refine a methodology, or simplify a process.

Over your first year, you might:

  • Take responsibility for a recurring analytical workflow, including quality checks and delivery.
  • Investigate a change in a dataset and help determine whether it reflects a business trend or a data issue.
  • Evaluate a new alternative dataset with support from an experienced teammate.
  • Build a reusable script or AI-assisted workflow that reduces manual work.
  • Contribute an analysis or visualization to a new research product or client dashboard.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You’re early in your analytics career, typically with 1- 3 years of relevant professional experience. We welcome recent graduates and career changers who can demonstrate their skills through internships, academic research, work experience, or substantive projects.
  • You have a working foundation in SQL and can use it to join, aggregate, and explore data. You have some experience using Python for data analysis and are interested in building more reliable, reusable workflows. Familiarity with PySpark is a plus.
  • You enjoy working through analytical questions and care about accuracy. You can explain your approach, test assumptions, and check your results. You notice inconsistencies and follow through to understand what caused them.
  • You’re eager to learn unfamiliar datasets and industries. You ask thoughtful questions and use feedback to improve your work.
  • You follow through on your responsibilities. You keep teammates informed, flag obstacles early, and ask for help when needed.
  • You communicate clearly. You can explain findings and uncertainties to others and are willing to develop your ability to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences.
  • You are curious about industries, competitive dynamics, and the factors that drive company performance.
  • You’re interested in AI tools and willing to experiment with them while checking their work carefully.

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits. The annual base compensation for this position is anticipated to be from SGD 72,000 to SGD 96,000. Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and internal team benchmarks.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities.
  • We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, flexible vacation, parental leave, team events, a wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary Facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.
Senior Security Engineer

Why We Have This Role

Qualtrics is looking for a CDU Analyst to support the (AMR or KRK) team’s daily operations that are responsible for detecting, triaging, and responding to security threats across our global environment. You'll support the day-to-day operations of the team and continuously mature our detection and response capabilities to keep pace with an evolving threat landscape. This is a hands-on role — you'll support in guiding strategy while staying close enough to work alongside the team and manage incidents.

How You’ll Find Success

  • Strategic Visionary: You possess an in-depth understanding of the cybersecurity threat landscape and proactively identify emerging risks. You help shape the Security Operations strategy, ensuring alignment with the organization's overall goals.
  • Technical Innovator: You drive continuous improvement by evaluating and implementing cutting-edge security tools, techniques, and automation. Your relentless pursuit of innovation keeps us ahead of evolving threats.
  • Collaborative Leader: You build strong cross-functional partnerships, championing security across the organization. You foster a collaborative environment where teams work seamlessly to achieve a strong security posture.
  • Resilient and Adaptive: You thrive in a dynamic environment, effectively managing complex security projects and leading teams through change. Your ability to adapt and problem-solve makes you a key asset during challenging situations.

How You’ll Grow

  • Shape Industry Standards: Participate in leading security conferences, thought leadership initiatives, and industry working groups to shape the future of cybersecurity practices.
  • Executive Presence: Gain direct exposure to executive-level decision-making, refining your strategic communication and influencing skills.
  • Expand Your Leadership Toolkit: Lead a team of skilled security professionals, providing you with ample opportunities to enhance your mentorship, coaching, and talent development abilities.
  • Complex Problem-Solving: Tackle high-impact security challenges that will push your critical thinking, analysis, and strategy-building skills.

Things You’ll Do

  • Respond in a Tier 2 role including 24x7 monitoring, detection, triage, and incident response functions
  • Support and develop CDU metrics and KPIs (MTTD, MTTR, alert volume/fidelity, coverage) and report on program health to security leadership
  • Drive continuous improvement of detection logic, playbooks, and automation in partnership with detection engineering and threat intelligence teams
  • Serve as an escalation point and incident commander for high-severity security incidents, coordinating cross-functional response
  • Partner with Threat Intelligence, Detection Engineering, IT, Legal, and Product/Engineering teams to close gaps in visibility and response
  • Manage relationships with any outsourced/MSSP or co-managed CDU partners, ensuring SLAs and quality standards are met
  • Evaluate and help select CDU tooling (SIEM, SOAR, EDR, XDR, ticketing) and drive adoption of automation to reduce analyst toil
  • Own CDU-related audit, compliance, and customer trust requirements (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP as applicable)
  • Build and maintain incident response runbooks, tabletop exercises, and post-incident review processes
  • Participate in an on-call rotation for incidents and provide leadership presence during major security events

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

  • Required
    • 5+ years in security operations, incident response, or a related security discipline, including 2+ years in a people-management or team-lead role
    • Demonstrated experience scaling a 24x7 CDU function, whether in-house, hybrid, or via MSSP oversight
    • Strong technical grounding in SIEM/SOAR platforms, EDR/XDR, network and cloud security monitoring, and the MITRE ATT&CK framework
    • Experience leading incident response for significant security events, including coordination with legal, communications, and executive stakeholders
    • Track record of hiring, developing, and retaining security talent
    • Excellent communication skills — able to translate technical detail into risk-based language for non-technical leaders
    • Experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and SaaS security operations
  • Nice to Have
    • Experience in a SaaS or enterprise software company handling customer data at scale
    • Familiarity with compliance frameworks relevant to Qualtrics' customer base (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, GDPR)
    • Relevant certifications (CISSP, GCIH, GCFA, CISM, or similar)
    • Experience building or maturing threat detection and threat hunting programs
    • Background in scripting/automation (Python, PowerShell) to support SOAR workflows

What You Should Know About This Team

  • Innovation at Our Core: Our Security Operations team embraces change and thrives on solving complex challenges. We value experimentation, continuous learning, and push the boundaries of conventional security practices.
  • Collaborative Environment: We believe in the power of teamwork and foster open communication across the team and the wider organization. Your ideas will be heard, and your collaboration will be essential.
  • Data-Driven Approach: We rely on data-driven insights to inform our security strategies, measure effectiveness, and continuously improve our posture.
  • Growth Mindset: We are committed to your professional development. You'll have opportunities to expand your expertise, contribute to high-visibility projects, and advance your career in cybersecurity.
  • Joining our team means stepping into a role that's vital, challenging, and deeply linked to Qualtrics' aim of reshaping industries by harnessing the power of Experience Management and AI.

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits

  • Annual Leave: 20 or 26 annual leave days per annum plus an additional day for each year of service (to a max of 5).
  • Private Medical Insurance- Luxmed health & dental cover for you and your dependants.
  • Commuter Assistance- Up to the value of 80 PLN net a month for public transport.
  • Savings Plan- Two company saving plans provided by Nationale Nederlanden: Employee Capital Plan (PPK) & Employee Saving Plan (PPO),
  • QED PROGRAM- Qualtrics Engineer Development (QED) program: support, engineering learning activities up to 10% of engineering work time each quarter.
  • Wellness- Up to the value of 800PLN gross per quarter can be reimbursed for a variety of wellness activities via our dedicated platform Forma,
  • A choice of Multispot cards available.
  • Our employee assistance program with Unum provides counselling and wellbeing support to all employees
  • Experience bonus- 7000 PLN gross per annum. Qualtrics experience bonus is a program designed to provide experiences to our employees they might not otherwise have.
  • Group Life & Income Protection Insurance
  • Glasses/Contact lenses Reimbursement
  • Free breakfasts, lunches, snacks, and drinks for everyone in the office

The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model: Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. Amazon Now MENA is seeking a highly capable Senior Business Analyst – Analytics, Automation & AI to build and scale its analytics and automation capabilities across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Egypt.

This hybrid role combines strategic business analysis with hands-on technical development. The successful candidate will own critical datasets, metrics, reporting systems, automated data pipelines, AI-enabled workflows, and web-based analytics applications. description:

The process

1. Intro Call with our Talent Team

title: Data Engineer
description:
About Us

We're the fastest-growing startup transforming the IP industry.

  • Traction: 20-30% MoM revenue growth; selling to 700+ global IP teams (DLA Piper, tech boutiques, and global enterprises).
  • Proven Value: Users report 50-90% efficiency gains using our AI platform.
  • Backing: Recently featured in Sifted following our $40M Series B announcement, bringing our total funding to $55M from elite investors including Y Combinator, 20VC, Visionaries, Microsoft and Thomson Reuters.

About the role

We’re hiring a data engineer to build the ingestion and search systems behind Solve Intelligence’s AI products.

Our sources include global patent literature, case law, technical standards and contributions, scientific databases, academic papers, and content from across the web. The data spans structured records, documents, images, audio and video. You’ll work across bulk ingestion and on-demand retrieval, making this information searchable and useful in our products

You’ll own systems from source acquisition through to serving queries. The work includes:

  • Large-scale ingestion. Build and operate high-throughput, resumable pipelines for large datasets, with efficient incremental updates, monitoring and recovery from failures.
  • Document processing and data quality. Extract useful content from complex documents and other formats. Handle malformed records and changing schemas, and validate outputs while preserving structure and metadata.
  • Search and serving. Build keyword, vector and structured search, and design schemas, indexes and partitioning for fast queries over tens to hundreds of millions of records.
  • Connecting information across sources. Link patents, scientific records and supporting documents, preserve dates and versions, and make results traceable to their original sources.
  • Performance engineering. Profile parsing, ingestion, database builds and queries throughout development, testing against representative datasets at realistic scale. Diagnose CPU, memory and storage I/O bottlenecks, and tune jobs and infrastructure for throughput, latency and cost.

You’ll work closely with our AI researchers and product engineers, with substantial freedom to choose the approach and build the systems yourself.

What you bring

  • Strong Python and SQL, with experience designing and operating production databases.
  • Solid experience building and operating production data pipelines over large, messy datasets.
  • Expertise with running search systems over large document collections.
  • End-to-end ownership from raw data to user-facing functionality.
  • A good understanding of schema design, indexing and query optimisation.
  • A track record of diagnosing and fixing performance bottlenecks in live systems through profiling and measurement.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with PostgreSQL/pgvector, OpenSearch (or Elasticsearch), Spark/Delta Lake, AWS, NoSQL databases, or Rust/C++ is useful.

The Founders

  • Sanj (CRO): PhD in AI (Gatsby Unit, UCL), ex-Huawei R&D, former lead at Magic Carpet AI (acquired).
  • Chris (CEO): PhD in AI (UCL), published researcher, ex-Dyson and Alan Turing Institute.
  • Angus (CTO): MEng Computer Science, ex-Qualcomm and Coremont (Brevan Howard).

What we offer

Competitive Salary + Significant Equity: We want you to have true ownership in the success of the company.

  • Founding Impact: You'll have a direct hand in how we build out the data infrastructure the rest of the product depends on.
  • Support: Full visa sponsorship and private medical insurance.
  • The Environment: Free meals and a seat at the table with an incredibly smart, ambitious team.

Motion Designer

Do VML hledáme Motion Designera, který dokáže vzít kreativní koncept, vizuál nebo natočený materiál a dát mu pohyb, rytmus a život.

Budeš pracovat na obsahu pro různé značky, platformy a formáty - od socialu a digitálních kampaní přes web a e-commerce až po DOOH, TV nebo interní komunikaci. Čeká tě kombinace animace, střihu, compositingu a postprodukce, ale také spousta adaptací a hledání chytrých způsobů, jak kreativní obsah efektivně dostat do všech potřebných formátů.

Co budeš dělat?

  • vytvářet animace a video obsah podle kreativního konceptu a brand guidelines,
  • převádět master vizuály do různých formátů, délek a platforem,
  • připravovat content pro social media, digitální kampaně, web, e-commerce, DOOH, TV i interní komunikaci,
  • vytvářet jazykové a lokální mutace, cut-downy, resizy a další adaptace,
  • animovat typografii, packshoty, produkty, ilustrace i fotografie,
  • pracovat s natočeným materiálem, střihem, compositingem a postprodukcí,
  • připravovat šablony a efektivní workflow pro opakovanou výrobu obsahu,
  • hlídat technickou kvalitu a správnost výstupů před odevzdáním,
  • spolupracovat s creative directory, designéry, editory, producenty, project managery a account týmy.

Co potřebuješ umět?

  • Adobe After Effects na velmi dobré úrovni,
  • Premiere Pro, Photoshop a Illustrator na dobré úrovni,
  • 2D animaci grafiky, typografie, produktů a log,
  • rozumět principům pohybu, timingu, rytmu a easingům,
  • stříhat video a pracovat se zvukem,
  • orientovat se v exportech, kodecích, rozlišení, frame rate, barevných profilech a technických specifikacích jednotlivých médií,
  • připravovat výstupy pro vertikální, čtvercové, landscape i nestandardní formáty,
  • základní znalost 3D nástrojů jako Cinema 4D, Blender nebo Element 3D je výhodou,
  • orientovat se ve Figmě, asset managementu a AI nástrojích.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Job Board / Full Stack Developer

Full Stack Developer

hybrid

100 King Street West, Toronto, Ontario, Canada, M5X 1C0

full-time . July 15, 2026

Description

Stem Health is reimagining the primary care experience for individuals who want a more thoughtful relationship with their health. Physician-led and membership-based, we combine medical excellence with the warmth of hospitality anchored in a beautifully designed flagship clinic at First Canadian Place, opening September 2026. Our care model is relationship-based, data-informed, and built on time, trust, and exceptional service.

Position Summary

Every experience a Stem Health member has booking an appointment, receiving their health results, navigating their care journey is shaped by the software we build. The same is true for every clinician who coordinates care, every administrator who manages the day, and every operator who keeps the clinic running. At Stem Health, technology is not a support function. It is how we deliver on our promise.

We are looking for a Full Stack Developer to join our technology team and take end-to-end ownership of the products and systems that power Stem Health. You will design, build, and maintain features across our member-facing applications, internal clinical tools, third-party integrations, and operational platforms working closely with our Applied AI Engineer, product team, and clinical and operations stakeholders to deliver software that is fast, reliable, and genuinely useful.

This is a high-ownership role in a small, building-mode team. You will be one of the primary engineers shaping Stem Health's technical foundation making architectural decisions that matter, shipping code that gets used, and helping set the engineering standard as the company grows.

Key Responsibilities

Product and feature development

  • Design and deliver full-stack features across Stem Health's core product surfaces including the member portal, onboarding flows, appointment scheduling, care coordination tools, health dashboards, and internal clinical and operational interfaces.
  • Own features from requirements and design to implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing iteration maintaining full technical accountability for the code you ship.
  • Collaborate with the product and design team to translate member and clinician needs into clean, performant, well-considered software.
  • Write front-end code in JavaScript and HTML that is fast, accessible, and consistent with Stem Health's design system and back-end code in Ruby on Rails that is well-structured, testable, and built to last.

Systems integration and API development

  • Build and maintain integrations between Stem Health's platform and external systems including EHR/EMR platforms, diagnostic lab providers, scheduling tools, payment processors, communication services, and insurance or benefits APIs.
  • Design and develop RESTful and GraphQL APIs that are secure, well-documented, and built for reliability at production scale.
  • Own the data layer: design schemas, manage migrations, optimize queries, and ensure data flows accurately and securely across the full system.
  • Build and maintain webhook consumers, event-driven workflows, and background processing pipelines that keep the platform responsive and operationally sound.

Infrastructure and DevOps

  • Manage and improve Stem Health's cloud infrastructure including deployment pipelines, environment configuration, monitoring, alerting, and incident response across staging and production environments.
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD workflows that support fast, confident deployments with appropriate automated testing and rollback capabilities.
  • Ensure the platform meets the performance, availability, and reliability standards appropriate for a healthcare environment, with particular attention to data security, access control, and PHIPA compliance.
  • Manage infrastructure costs and resource configuration proactively, ensuring the technical stack scales efficiently as the membership and team grows.

AI integration and intelligent tooling

  • Collaborate with the Applied AI Engineer to integrate AI-powered features into the platform including LLM-based interfaces, retrieval-augmented search, workflow automation, and intelligent decision-support tools.
  • Build the production infrastructure that makes AI features reliable, observable, and maintainable over time including logging, evaluation hooks, rate limiting, and graceful fallback handling.
  • Contribute engineering judgment on where AI can meaningfully improve product experiences, and where conventional software is the right tool.

Code quality and engineering culture

  • Write clean, well-tested, well-documented code and actively maintain the quality of the shared codebase through thoughtful code review and refactoring.
  • Define and uphold engineering standards coding conventions, testing requirements, deployment practices, and documentation expectations that enable the team to move quickly without accumulating technical debt.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions with a practical, long-term perspective: build what the business needs today in a way that does not constrain what it needs tomorrow.
  • Mentor junior engineers and interns, providing constructive code review and engineering guidance that raises the capability of the whole team.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in full-stack web development, with a proven track record of shipping production-quality applications end to end.
  • Strong proficiency in Ruby on Rails including MVC architecture, ActiveRecord, RESTful routing, background jobs, and Rails best practices for building maintainable, scalable web applications.
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) for front-end interactivity, including experience with modern JS frameworks or libraries (Stimulus, Hotwire/Turbo, React, or equivalent); solid command of HTML5 and semantic markup.
  • Experience designing and managing relational databases (PostgreSQL or MySQL preferred), including schema design, query optimization, and migrations.
  • Solid experience with cloud infrastructure AWS, GCP, or Azure including compute, storage, networking, managed services, and IAM.
  • Proficiency with CI/CD tooling, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes or equivalent), and infrastructure-as-code practices.
  • Experience building and consuming RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs, including third-party integrations with complex external systems.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML integration patterns, LLM APIs, vector databases, embedding pipelines, RAG architectures is a significant asset.
  • Experience working in a healthcare, health tech, or regulated data environment with working knowledge of PHIPA, HIPAA, or equivalent privacy and security standards is highly valued.
  • Experience with EHR/EMR systems, clinical workflow platforms, or health data standards (HL7, FHIR) is a strong asset.
  • Exceptional communication skills: you write clearly, explain technical decisions accessibly, and collaborate effectively with non-technical stakeholders.
  • A product-minded engineering approach: you think about the user and the outcome, not just the implementation.

Ideal Candidate

You are an engineer who takes genuine ownership of the features you build, the systems you maintain, and the codebase you share with your team. You move with purpose: comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, rigorous about the things that cannot be compromised, and pragmatic about the things that can. You understand that building software in a healthcare environment is not just a technical challenge it is a responsibility and that standard shapes how you approach security, privacy, reliability, and correctness. You want to build something that matters, and you want to build it properly.

Why Join Stem Health

  • A foundational engineering role at an early-stage, physician-led healthcare company launching at First Canadian Place in September 2026 the opportunity to shape the technical architecture and culture from the ground up.
  • High ownership, high impact: your architectural decisions will define how Stem Health operates at scale, and your code will directly shape what members and clinicians experience every day.
  • A small, building-mode team where your contributions are visible, valued, and consequential not abstracted behind layers of process.
  • The chance to work at the intersection of healthcare, AI, and product engineering building technology that has real clinical and human stakes.
  • Competitive compensation, meaningful equity participation, and the professional growth that comes with being a senior engineer at an ambitious, early-stage company.

title: A Two-Day Training Programme with a Pathway to Employment for Professional Chefs!

AALTOVOIMA - AALLON VOIMALLA TÖIHIN


Aaltovoima Lapland Chef Academy

17–18 October 2026 | Helsinki | 10:00–17:00

Are you a chef or kitchen professional looking for a new job opportunity, seasonal work or the next step in your career?

Aaltovoima Pohjoinen is organising the Aaltovoima Lapland Chef Academy – a free, two-day intensive training programme where you can develop your professional skills under the guidance of top-level professionals and build a concrete pathway towards seasonal work in Lapland.

This is not an ordinary course. The Academy combines hands-on training, professional development and a direct pathway to employment through Aaltovoima in leading hotels and restaurants across Lapland.


Who is the Academy for?

We are looking for:

* Trained chefs and kitchen professionals looking for a new job or seasonal work
* Early-career chefs with basic professional skills and a strong motivation to develop quickly
* International professionals with sufficient language skills and the right to work in Finland
* Chefs interested in Laplands hotels, experiential restaurants and international clientel


What does the Academy offer?

Top-level trainers
The training is led by experienced professionals Aki Kantelinen and Johan Kurkela, who will share their practical expertise and experience from professional kitchens.

Two intensive days
The training focuses on hands-on work, the demands of professional kitchens and what it takes to succeed during the busy winter season in Lapland.

Certificate of completion
Participants who successfully complete the Academy will receive an Aaltovoima Lapland Chef Academy Certificate.

A pathway to employment
Aaltovoima will connect participating chefs with suitable job opportunities in hotels and restaurants across Lapland during the upcoming winter season.


Practical information

* The Academy takes place on 17–18 October 2026

We are looking for motivated chefs who are passionate about food, eager to develop their skills and ready to take the next step in their careers.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Build your future with Sovos.

If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionizing how businesses navigate the ever-changing regulatory landscape.

At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges -- we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference in everything we do. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.

Our purpose-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!

Don't worry if you don't check all the boxes -- apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.

The Work You'll Do:

At Sovos, we're building a world-class financial data platform to support a global tax compliance leader -- and the Senior Data Engineer is the foundation it all runs on. In this role, you'll own the full pipeline stack: from ingestion through transformation, all the way to the finance-trusted, close-ready outputs that Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Accounting, and leadership rely on to make critical decisions. You'll design and build the Snowflake architecture and dbt model infrastructure that underpins our topline data chain, and you'll be the person the team counts on when something needs to be fixed before close. This isn't just plumbing -- it's high-visibility, high-ownership engineering work with a direct line to business impact. You'll also play a key role in shaping how AI consumers interact with structured financial data, treating them as first-class stakeholders alongside finance teams.

More specifically, you will:

  • Design and build the Snowflake schema and dbt model architecture for the topline data chain: Billing, Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR), Deferred Revenue, Revenue Recognition (Rev Rec), and Close Pack
  • Deliver ingestion and transformation models with full test coverage and documentation across all assigned use cases
  • Own pipeline reliability through financial close -- monitor, alert on, and recover from failures; serve as the primary on-call escalation point
  • Establish data quality standards, dbt testing conventions, and Snowflake governance patterns for the broader team
  • Partner with the Analytics Engineer on business-layer model design to ensure technical outputs map accurately to finance requirements
  • Extend the dbt model layer to cover operating expenses (OPEX), cost of goods sold (COGS), commissions, and ASC 340-40 capitalized software as scope grows
  • Write dbt YAML documentation -- table descriptions, column definitions, and grain statements -- as a first-class production deliverable, recognizing that documentation quality directly determines AI answer accuracy
  • Own row-level security and model freshness SLAs for real-time AI queries, treating AI consumers as first-class stakeholders alongside finance

What We Need From You

  • 5-8 years of experience in data engineering, with a track record of building and maintaining production pipelines and dbt projects at scale
  • Advanced SQL skills: CTEs, window functions, LATERAL joins, performance tuning, and complex multi-source financial queries
  • Production dbt experience: modular models, tests, documentation, and semantic metadata for both AI and BI consumers
  • Snowflake proficiency: roles, warehouses, governance, masking policies, and row-level security -- not just querying, but owning the environment
  • Experience supporting financial close cycles, including on-call ownership of pipeline failures; understands what WD1 means and why it matters
  • Fluency in the revenue data chain (Billing, ARR, Deferred Revenue, Revenue Recognition, Close Pack) with the ability to engage finance stakeholders directly on data discrepancies
  • Strong communication skills: able to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical audiences and write documentation that finance analysts can use to validate outputs
  • Preferred: Experience integrating CRM/ERP systems (NetSuite, Salesforce, or similar) into a warehouse layer, including ELT patterns, API pagination, and incremental loads
  • Preferred: Python for pipeline scripting and orchestration
  • Preferred: Cloud infrastructure experience: Azure (App Service, Azure Active Directory (AD), Functions) or AWS; familiarity with auth patterns (JWT, OAuth) and CI/CD fundamentals
  • Preferred: Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar frameworks for connecting AI agents to structured data
  • Preferred: Background in B2B SaaS metrics: ARR, gross revenue retention (GRR), net revenue retention (NRR), churn, and deferred revenue
  • Preferred: Familiarity with data governance practices: PII handling, access control, and GDPR basics
  • Nice to Have: RAG architecture, hybrid retrieval strategies, or prompt engineering experience
  • Nice to Have: MLOps or ML pipeline experience
  • Nice to Have: Domain knowledge in compliance, tax technology, or e-invoicing
  • Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.

What Does Sovos Offer You?

The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!

  • 30 days holiday (plus 8 days Bank Holiday)
  • Health insurance
  • Dental insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Critical illness insurance
  • Income protection
  • Mental wellbeing support
  • Global Meeting Free Days
  • Award Winning Career Development and Training opportunities, and more!

Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.

Company Background

Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance and trust solutions and services that enable businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with true confidence. Purpose-built for always-on compliance capabilities, our scalable IT-driven solutions meet the demands of an evolving and complex global regulatory landscape. Sovos' cloud-based software platform provides an unparalleled level of integration with business applications and government compliance processes.

More than 100,000 customers in 100+ countries -- including half the Fortune 500 -- trust Sovos for their compliance needs. Sovos annually processes more than three billion transactions across 19,000 global tax jurisdictions. Bolstered by a robust partner program more than 400 strong, Sovos brings to bear an unrivaled global network for companies across industries and geographies. Founded in 1979, Sovos has operations across the Americas and Europe, and is owned by Hg and TA Associates. For more information visit http://www.sovos.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter.

title: Mechanical Project Manager | Sweden
description:

About Kirby Group Engineering
Kirby Group Engineering is an international multi-disciplinary engineering services contractor and leading provider of high-value engineering services to a number of ‘blue chip’ companies. Operating across Ireland, the UK, Europe and South Africa, Kirby has become the engineering service provider of choice in growth segments such as pharmaceuticals, data centres and power transmission and distribution. Our culture is innovative, collaborative and performance focused. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to grow and develop in a company committed to developing talent and rewarding performance.

Role Purpose
As Mechanical Project Manager you will be responsible for a number of construction projects across the Kirby mechanical business unit. The project manager plans, organises, leads, coordinates and controls all activities concerned with the construction of Mechanical Piping / HVAC Projects. The Project Manager participates in the conceptual development of an engineering construction project and leads its organization, scheduling and implementation. He/she is the key point of contact with the client and builds and creates strong, assertive and positive relationships. They ensure that the site meets and exceeds environmental, health and safety standards. They ensure a quality focus and quality outcomes so that the Kirby Group vision, mission & values are fulfilled.


Mechanical Project Manager Responsibilities
In conjunction with your project team, you will be responsible for the execution of various stages of a project as follows:

Project Start-Up:
· Arrange and chair handover of project from estimating department to construction team
· Liaise with OM in staffing of project
· Validate project and in doing so develop business plan, cost control system, cashflow and billable schedules, etc.
· As Project Manager you will be tasked with producing procurement plan, drawing / design plan, construction programme, s-curve and histogram
· Liaise with client and design team on procurement and engineering issues
· Develop project safety and quality plans
· Mobilise sub-contractors and labour in accordance with business plan
· Mobilise site establishment

Project Running Phase:
· Agree a training plan for staff and operatives particular to your site in conjunction with the OM
· Manage your site team in the effective day to day running of site activities
· Ensure compliance with programme, materials deliveries and engineering, quality and safety issues
· Attend meetings with Clients
· Hold weekly progress meetings with sub-contractors and ensure that safety and training are discussed
· Ensure effective cost and sales control in conjunction with Q.S
· Advise client in good time of current sales plan
· Ensure productivity at work face is measured on a weekly basis also maintain project progress control
· Submit monthly internal reports to the OM

Project Completion:
· Ensure testing and commissioning is carried out in accordance with the Quality Plan
· Ensure final design audit (if applicable) is carried out by the EM
· Complete and certify all ‘life systems’ in good time for handover date
· Ensure all systems are demonstrated to Client and District Surveyor
· Handover O&M manual and record drawings
· Prepare final account with the QS, submit and agree with client in line with company objective
· Demobilise site team and establishment in conjunction with the OM
· Produce a project close-out report and submit to the OM
· Archive project
· Maintain contact with client for warranty period and thereafter when retention monies are collected

Other Duties:
· Maintain a site / day book
· Attend and participate in monthly project managers meetings
· Develop your skills in line with agreed training plan
· Put forward idea’s for continuous improvement of company
· Maintain contact with your client base
· Maintain excellent working relationships with the client from project start up to project completion


Necessary requirement of the Mechanical Project Manager

· Building Services Engineer / Mechanical Engineer or Senior Trades qualification or equivalent
· Significant Project management experience 8 years+.
· Previous record of delivering small to medium mechanical pharmaceutical projects
· Pre-commissioning & system turnover experience
· HVAC and building services experience
· Commercial Awareness
· Experience in Process Piping, BMS Systems, HVAC, Clean & Dirty Utilities Piping, is desirable.
· Excellent communicator/strong interpersonal skills/communicates with impact
· Excellent record keeper and administration skills
· Drives for results
· Leads and influences others.
· Identifies and achieves commercial value.
· Innovates and leads in mechanical/technical activity and challenges.
· Plans and effectively manages projects.
· Solves problems analytically and acts decisively
· Mentor and Coach to junior engineers and graduates

title: Intermediate sre / devops engineer
description:
We're looking for an infrastructure-minded engineer who is passionate about technology, automation, and reliability. If you are ready to take on exciting challenges, build robust cloud-native systems, and grow within a supportive environment oriented towards continuous improvement, we would love to hear from you.

Company Overview

Kriterion is a Pretoria-based Saa S company at the cutting edge of predictive maintenance and intelligent condition monitoring. As a rapidly growing scale-up, Kriterion has proven its business model and is now focused on expanding our market presence and refining our operations to meet increasing demand.

Our clients are those who take care of the heavy machinery and infrastructure that underpin our modern society. We at Kriterion enable our clients' maintenance teams to perform at their very best by providing actionable AI-driven decisions. By applying AI insight to sensor-rich assets we ensure that they remain healthy and perform optimally. We help reduce emissions by making these assets perform efficiently through lean maintenance while mitigating downtime and extending their useful lives.

We achieve this by incorporating deep learning with engineering insights in a modern AI-centric framework. Our core product is Cerberus; a cloud-native predictive maintenance platform. Our client base is in the telecommunications and mining space, with 30 000+ assets in our portfolio.

Job Description

As an Intermediate SRE / Dev Ops Engineer at Kriterion, you'll join a vibrant, collaborative team that thrives on innovation. Because we are a smaller scale-up, roles naturally overlap. You will bridge the gap between core infrastructure and software engineering. Your primary focus will be designing, scaling, and maintaining the highly available cloud environments that power the Cerberus platform, while collaborating closely with developers and data scientists to streamline ML and application deployments.

Your day-to-day job will focus on: Infrastructure & Reliability: Design, build, and monitor highly available, scalable infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform and Kubernetes to ensure Cerberus performs flawlessly for our clients. CI/CD & Automation: Build, maintain, and optimize robust deployment pipelines (Git Lab CI, Argo CD) to enable seamless, automated delivery of software and machine learning models. Developer Experience (Dev Ex): Act as the bridge between development and operations. Write clean, tested code to build internal tooling that empowers the wider engineering team to deploy safely and autonomously. Observability & Incident Response: Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks or failures. Continuous Learning: Stretch your boundaries in a supportive environment where you will gain a broad skill set across cutting-edge cloud and MLOps technologies. Requirements 2+ years of experience in Dev Ops, Site Reliability Engineering, or Software Engineering with a strong infrastructure focus. Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker). Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and utilizing Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) principles. A strong focus on system architecture, cloud-native design, and platform security. Ability to write clean, maintainable automation code (Python, Bash, or similar). Proficient verbal and written communication. Relevant bachelor’s degree (Comp. Sci., Engineering, etc.). Technology Stack

Because you will be working across our tech ecosystem, experience in the following (or related) technologies is advantageous. We emphasize our infrastructure stack for this role, but you will interact with the entire system:

Infrastructure & Orchestration: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Kubernetes, Linux CI/CD & Git Ops: Git Lab CI, Argo CD, Crossplane Backend & Scripting: Python, Fast API, Fire Store AI/Data Ops (MLOps): Apache Beam, Tensorflow (TFX), Kubeflow, DBT, Prefect, Big Query Frontend (Good to know): React.js, Type Script Benefits Flexible working hours Career growth opportunities in a rapidly expanding company Chance to contribute to significant company milestones and achievements Exposure to multiple aspects of a scaling business Highly competitive compensation

title: Inbound Logistics Controller
description: Overview Lead and control the site inbound logistics, warehousing, inventory and material-flow activities to ensure uninterrupted production, accurate stock, safe operations and cost-effective service delivery. Translate supply chain and site priorities into logistics plans, controls, performance routines and improvement initiatives that optimize inventory, working capital, warehouse capacity and operational efficiency. Provide decision-making leadership across material availability, inventory risk, supplier and transporter performance, stock integrity, compliance and contingency planning. Lead, coach and develop the logistics team, establish clear performance standards and build capability to deliver safety, quality, service, cost and people objectives. Act as the site subject-matter lead for SAP inventory processes, warehouse controls, stock governance and logistics reporting, while partnering with Planning, Procurement, Production, Quality, Finance, Engineering and EHS. Responsibilities Lead and control all inbound logistics, warehousing, inventory-control and material-handling activities to ensure safe, accurate and uninterrupted supply to manufacturing operations. Determine inventory-control priorities and implement governance for goods receipt, storage, staging, issuing, returns, transfers, cycle counting, reconciliation and stock adjustments in line with approved authority levels. Optimize stock levels, working capital, warehouse capacity and material flow by analysing demand, supply, ageing, slow-moving stock, constraints and operational risk. Own logistics performance routines and KPIs, investigate deviations, lead root-cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions. Manage logistics operating costs and service-provider performance, validate expenditure, identify savings opportunities and support budget planning and cost control. Lead, coach and develop direct and indirect team members through workforce planning, performance management, capability building, succession planning, engagement and consistent application of people practices. Ensure compliance with PepsiCo policies, food-safety and quality requirements, EHS standards, statutory requirements, segregation-of-duties controls and internal or external audit requirements. Lead supplier, transporter and service-provider issue resolution, including escalation of delivery failures, non-conforming materials, capacity constraints and repeated service deviations. Develop and maintain logistics contingency and business-continuity plans for supply interruptions, system downtime, warehouse constraints, equipment failure and exceptional production demand. Sponsor continuous-improvement and digital enablement initiatives that standardize processes, strengthen SAP and warehouse controls, improve productivity and reduce waste, damage, demurrage and inventory losses. Qualifications Relevant degree or diploma in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations Management or a related discipline. Typically, 5 to 8 years of progressive logistics, warehouse, inventory or supply chain experience in an FMCG or manufacturing environment, including at least 3 years in a people-leadership or supervisory role. Demonstrated accountability for inventory control, warehouse operations, supplier or transporter performance and operational service delivery. Advanced working knowledge of SAP inventory processes, preferably SAP MM/WM or equivalent warehouse-management systems. Strong understanding of inventory accounting controls, cycle counting, stock reconciliation, traceability, FIFO/FEFO principles and audit governance. Experience in budget control, cost analysis, KPI management, root-cause analysis and continuous-improvement delivery. Ability to interpret operational and financial data, identify risk and convert analysis into clear decisions and action plans. Knowledge of food safety, quality, EHS and regulatory requirements relevant to logistics and warehousing.

title: Koneenasentaja telakalle
location: Satakunta, Pori, Rauma, Varsinais-Suomi, Kaarina, Lieto, Naantali, Raisio, Turku, Uusikaupunki
description:
Etsimme asiakasyrityksellemme koneenasentajia aluksi määräaikaisiin työsuhteisiin.

Tehtävän kuvaus

Koneasentajana tehtäväsi on antaa suuntaa laadukkaalle ja suunnitelmalliselle laivanrakennukselle. Tehtävässäsi vastaat monipuolisesti koneasennuksiin liittyvistä tehtävistä laivan eri alueilla. Toimit yhteistyössä kumppaneiden kanssa eri laivaprojekteissa käyttöönoton aikana. Huolehdit myös työturvallisuuden toteutumisesta omalla vastuualueella. Työskentelet pääasiassa ns. maalla laivalla, joten esim. perheelliselle paikka on hyvä. Töitä tehdään Turussa, Uudessakaupungissa ja Raumalla. Kun ylitöitä tulee, sinulla on valmius tehdä niitä sekä viikonloppuja. Sinulla on mahdollisuus siirtyä asiakkaan kirjoille myöhemmässä vaiheessa.

Koulutuksesi voi olla esim. putkiasentaja, koneenasentaja, vahtikonemestari, konemestari tai levyseppähitsaaja . Pääasia on, että työkalut ovat tuttuja ja sinulla on kokemusta koneenasennuksesta.

Toivomme, että sinulla on rohkeutta tarttua uusiin haasteisiin. Laivanrakennus on tiimipeliä ja yhteistyötaidot ovat avainasemassa. Sinulla on myös edellytykset hyvään tiimityöskentelyyn, oma-aloitteisuutta ja organisointikykyä. Toivomme sinulta aikaisempaa kokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä koneenasennusten tai laivalla konerakennuksen parissa. Kokemus laivan koneenasennuksesta on iso etu, mutta ei välttämättömyys, jos olet tehnyt muita asennustöitä.

Jos seuraavat asiat ovat hallussa, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö

Hakeaksesi tätä työpaikkaa, sinulla tulee olla:

  • Usean vuoden kokemus vastaavanlaisista töistä - etsimme ammattilaista, jolta asiat sujuvat eikä tarvitse olla vahtimassa.
  • Voimassa oleva työturvallisuuskortti.
  • Hyvä suomen kielen taito - työnjohtokieli on suomi.
  • Korkea työmoraali – työ on itsenäistä ja vastaat itse työnjäljestäsi.
  • Sosiaaliset taidot kunnossa – tulet toimeen ihmisten kanssa tiukoissakin paikoissa.

Vision työntekijälupaus

Oli visiosi työelämästä kirkas tai vasta hahmottumassa, me autamme molemmissa tapauksissa. Varmistamme, että työsopimukset ja varusteet ovat kunnossa, ja että ammattilaisena saat osaamistasi vastaavan palkan. Olemme tukena ja turvana, jos sellaista tarvitset. Meille on tärkeää, että viihdyt työssäsi.

Visiolaisena saat tässä tehtävässä:

  • Osaamisesi mukaan määräytyvän palkan.
  • Pitkäaikaisen ja vakituisen työsuhteen.
  • Palkanmaksun kaksi kertaa kuukaudessa.
  • Mahdollisuuden kehittää ammattitaitoasi ja edetä vaativampiin tehtäviin.

Onko meillä yhteinen visio? — Näin teet työpaikkahakemuksen

Haastattelemme jo hakuaikana potentiaalisia hakijoita, joten mikäli koet olevasi etsimämme työntekijä, niin nyt on aika jättää hakemus. Tee se ohessa olevan linkin kautta!

Voit parantaa omia mahdollisuuksiasi tulla valituksi, kun:

  • liität hakemukseesi ansioluettelon (CV) tai kirjaat aikaisemmat työpaikkasi kuluneelta viideltä vuodelta,
  • kerrot, miten aiemmissa työpaikoissa opitut asiat tukevat sinua pärjäämään hakemassasi uudessa tehtävässä.

Näin saat lisätietoa tehtävästä

Jos haluat lisätietoja tehtävästä, voit lähettää rekrytoinnista vastaaville henkilöille sähköpostia otsikolla "Haettu työ" osoitteeseen Mikko Rautee / mikko.rautee(at)visiohr.fi / 050 3746358. Olemme tavoitettavissa ma-pe klo 09.00-16.00.

Tsemppiä hakemuksen tekoon!

Visio — Aidosti läsnä alueellasi

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut on valtakunnallisesti paikallinen. Tunnemme paikalliset työmarkkinat ja olemme aidosti läsnä alueellasi. Jos haet Varsinais-Suomessa työpaikkaa, siinä auttavat sinua Turusta käsin Jukka, Mikko ja Kristian.

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut
