title: Machine Learning Engineer, Applied AI - Deployed
description:
Our Mission

Rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve.

About Brain Co.

Brain Co. builds AI-native operating systems for large, regulated institutions. Each system is built for a specific industry, powered by agents that push real workflows forward. Underneath it all is Atlas, our proprietary platform that keeps customers in control, secure by design, and never locked into one model.

Why Now

Brain Co. is entering its next phase of production deployments on a national scale with an elite team built from Palantir, Google, Meta, and Nvidia, and a growing footprint across government, insurance, health, and financial services.

Joining now means shaping both the company and a new category of applied AI. Every project here ships to production and is expected to create measurable customer value and impact.

You'll work alongside exceptional peers on some of the hardest problems in applied AI. It’s the kind of work you'll still be proud of in ten years from now.

Machine Learning Engineer, Applied AI

About the Role

So much of the work society depends on is still slower and harder than it should be. Permits take months. Claims sit unresolved. And AI hasn't changed that — because the bottleneck isn't the models. It's the institutional context AI needs to do the work: rules, history, relationships, and judgment scattered across people, documents, and legacy systems.

BrainCo exists to fix that. We build agent-native operating systems for the institutions society depends on, and our products are the first of their kind in the world — we were the first, anywhere, to fully automate construction permitting, and we're now doing the same across insurance and other industries. There is no playbook here, because no one has built this before.

As a Machine Learning Engineer on Applied AI, your work begins where the demo ends: getting a model to look impressive is the easy part; making it a production decision system an institution stakes its process on is the job. The problems come in every shape — custom vision model pipelines that check blueprints against building codes at 95%+ accuracy, agents that untangle policy stacks to reveal coverage gaps, systems that predict from clinical records whether a patient is on their care path — and you'll own them end-to-end, from ambiguous customer problem to the eval that catches a whole class of errors.

This is frontier ML applied where it's hardest and matters most. The problems are underspecified, the documents are brutal, the accuracy bar is institutional-grade — and the feedback loops are real, because our systems move real workflows forward every day.

Who We're Looking For

You understand how machine learning actually works — not just the tooling, but the philosophy underneath: what a loss function really optimizes, how generalization breaks under distribution shift, why evaluation is where systems quietly go wrong. And you live at the bleeding edge of modern AI, with hard-won instincts for squeezing the most out of LLMs and agentic systems — prompting, fine-tuning, tool use, and reasoning. That combination is the job: you know when a fine-tuned segmentation model beats a VLM, when a rule engine beats both, and how to compose all three into a system more accurate than any single model. You treat frontier models as components to be measured, pushed, and engineered — never as magic.

Most of all, you're energized by building things that have never existed, and comfortable when the problem, the data, and the definition of success all have to be invented at once.

The Problems You'll Work On

Composite AI systems and credit assignment. Our most demanding systems chain vision transformers, segmentation models, VLM reasoning, and rule engines. When the pipeline is wrong, which component failed? One of the most interesting open problems in applied ML.

Document understanding beyond the frontier. Blueprints, site plans, policy stacks, contracts, clinical records — dense, multimodal documents that break off-the-shelf models. You'll build models that actually read them.

Agents that learn from real work. Our deployments generate verified, ground-truth outcomes on every decision — reward signals most labs can only simulate. You'll help design the data, evals, and training loops to build and fine-tune agents on them.

Evaluation as a product discipline. When a regulator has to trust your system, evals are the product. You'll build eval suites and failure-mode taxonomies rigorous enough to earn institutional sign-off.

Institutional Intelligence that compounds. Every verified correction improves the system twice: the corrected fact percolates to every application, and the system that builds the intelligence learns to build it better. You'll work on both loops.

In This Role, You Will:

Turn ambiguity into shipped systems — from no problem statement, no labeled data, and no agreed definition of success, to well-posed ML problems and production deployments.

Own AI systems end-to-end. There is no handoff: the person who trains the model owns its behavior in production.

Work at the research frontier with production stakes, applying LLMs, RL fine-tuning, and agentic systems where the output is a decision an institution acts on.

Work directly with the institutions we serve — permit reviewers, underwriters, compliance officers — to understand how decisions actually get made and ensure your systems change how the work gets done.

Engineer for production reality, navigating accuracy, latency, cost, and reliability in environments far messier than any benchmark.

Raise the bar across the company through design reviews, our internal paper club, and the shared playbook for AI systems institutions can trust.

title: AI Safety & Value Consultant
description:
AI is moving from isolated experiments to something organisations have to run at scale: more use cases, more teams, more exposure. As AI becomes embedded in business processes and decision making, the stakes grow. Most organisations aren't equipped to manage the risks that come with it, from unreliable outputs and security concerns to compliance and operational challenges, while still capturing its value.

We believe successful AI adoption is not about moving fast at any cost. It's about creating value while keeping AI systems safe, trustworthy and under control.

We're looking for an AI Safety & Value Consultant who can help clients unlock the benefits of AI while managing its risks. You'll help organisations identify, assess and mitigate AI risks, establish the right governance and operating models, and drive the adoption of AI at scale. From shaping strategy with leadership teams to embedding practical safeguards, you'll help clients build AI capabilities that are both valuable and trustworthy. You're not a lawyer and you're not a data scientist? Good. We want a strategy minded consultant who understands how AI impacts organisations, people and processes, and can balance innovation with safety.


Your responsibilities

Set up AI portfolio management

  • Design AI governance operating models: roles, decision rights, intake and approval flows

  • Build the AI lifecycle process, from intake and risk triage through deployment, monitoring and retirement

  • Drive the organisational change that makes it work: onboarding stakeholders, embedding ways of working, building internal capability rather than a document nobody reads

  • Set up inventories and registries so clients know what AI they run and how it performs

  • Conduct comprehensive AI risk assessments and ethical evaluations for client systems

Manage risk and quality

  • Design AI risk management approaches that integrate the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001 into something practical for the client

  • Run AI risk assessments and guide individual use cases through classification, mitigation and sign-off

  • Pressure-test solution quality: feasibility, evaluation approach, hallucination and data-leakage risks, workflow fit and vendor overclaims

  • Keep clients ahead of a fast-moving regulatory and standards landscape

Your qualifications

Required experience & skills

  • 3-5 years of consulting, strategy or business analysis experience, with a track record of designing processes or governance and driving their adoption

  • Strong stakeholder management across technical and non-technical audiences

  • Solid understanding of AI and machine learning fundamentals, including generative AI and LLMs, enough to ask the right questions and challenge the answers

  • Experience identifying and managing risk (AI, data, technology or compliance: bias, privacy, security, robustness, transparency)

  • Familiarity with AI governance frameworks and regulation (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, GDPR)

  • Fluent in English; Dutch is a strong plus

Desired qualifications

  • Background in data ethics, DPIAs or algorithmic impact assessments

  • Experience setting up governance or management systems (risk, quality, security, privacy) at scale

  • Relevant certifications (e.g. ISO/IEC 42001, AIGP, risk or privacy)

  • Familiarity with AI evaluation, monitoring and documentation practices (model cards, datasheets)

  • Sector experience in financial services, pharma/life sciences or the public sector

Our offer

  • Fringe benefits including continuous training that builds and extends professional, technical and management skills in all areas;

title: Chauffeur in opleiding portaalwagen Alkmaar
description:
Altijd al gedroomd van een toekomst als vrachtwagenchauffeur?

Bij GP Groot krijg je niet alleen de kans om je CE-rijbewijs te halen, maar ook om te groeien als professional. Met persoonlijke begeleiding en een vast contract na je opleiding investeren wij in jouw ontwikkeling én in een duurzame toekomst.

Jouw traject als chauffeur in opleiding
Bij GP Groot draait het om méér dan alleen je rijbewijs. Tijdens jouw opleiding krijg je:

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding: Onze ervaren mentorchauffeurs begeleiden je stap voor stap.

  • Slagingsgarantie: Wij geloven in jouw succes en helpen je om jouw C(E)-rijbewijs te behalen.

  • Een vaste baan: Na het afronden van je opleiding ben je verzekerd van een plek in ons team.

Start als chauffeur kraakperswagen: Teken je contract en begin met je opleiding en als bijrijder op de kraakperswagen bij GP Groot. Dit is dé perfecte manier om het vak écht te leren. Samen met een mentorchauffeur zorg je voor het veilig en efficiënt inzamelen van bedrijfsafval in de regio. Ondertussen ga jij aan de slag met het behalen van jouw rijbewijs C.


En zodra je je rijbewijs hebt? Dan wissel je van stoel en word je zelf chauffeur. Samen met een mentorchauffeur zal je ingewerkt worden op de portaalwagen. Ondertussen haal jij ook jouw rijbewijs CE, zodat je met aanhanger mag rijden.


Werktijden die bij jou passen: Bij GP Groot werk je vooral regionaal. Dit betekent dat je van 06:30 tot 15:00-17:00 uur aan het werk bent. Hierbij wordt er gezorgd dat je altijd op tijd thuis bent voor het avondeten of andere afspraken. Een ideale balans tussen werk en privé!

Voor wie is dit programma geschikt? Of je nu net van school komt, een carrièreswitch wilt maken, of al ervaring hebt – bij GP Groot ben je welkom. Het enige wat je nodig hebt is een enthousiaste en leergierige houding.

Hoe ziet jouw traject eruit?

  1. Screening: Ons recruitmentteam beoordeelt jouw sollicitatie;

  2. Testdag bij STL: Je zal verschillende testen uitvoeren, zoals een capaciteitentest, rijtest en competentietest. Dit alles bepaalt of jij gebruik kan maken de STL Subsidie;

  3. Gesprek met je leidinggevende: Maak kennis met je team;

  4. Meeloopdag: Ervaar hoe jouw toekomstige werkdag eruitziet;

  5. Testdag bij Hoekstra Opleidingen: Bij onze vertrouwde opleidingspartner zet je de laatste stap met een rijtest en een capaciteitentest;

  6. Start als chauffeur: Begin met je opleiding én je baan bij GP Groot.

Klaar om te starten?

We bieden:

  • Volledig gesubsidieerde opleiding van jouw rijbewijs C/CE;

  • Een leeromgeving waarin jij alle facetten van het chauffeursvak leert kennen;

  • Werkervaring opdoen in teamverband en met directe begeleiding;

  • Je komt direct bij ons in dienst met uitzicht op een vast contract;

  • Een salaris die begint in de B schaal (€ 2.604,- per maand) als bijrijder en door kan groeien naar de D schaal (2.893,55– 3520,40 per maand) na het behalen van het C rijbewijs. Volgens de voorwaarden van de CAO beroepsgoederenvervoer.

We verwachten:

  • Je hebt een Nederlands B rijbewijs;

  • Je spreekt goed Nederlands (ivm theorie);

  • Je hebt MBO werk- en denkniveau;

  • Je bent leergierig en zet jezelf 100% in om je rijbewijs te halen.

Assist in infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code (Ia C). Support system upgrades, patching, and version control of infrastructure components. Help implement security best practices, including access control and vulnerability monitoring. Use monitoring tools to analyze system logs and metrics for performance tuning. title: Character Illustrator, 2D Animator (계약직) - 브랜딩 (캐릭터)
description:
당근 팀 합류 여정에 오르신 것을 진심으로 환영해요

당근은 회사의 성장에 맞춰 개인이 함께 성장할 수 있는 환경을 만들기 위해 노력을 하고 있어요.

멋진 동료들과 행복한 고민을 하는 그 순간이 올 수 있도록 당근 채용팀이 도와드릴게요.

캐릭터 파트를 소개해요

“Branding Humanizes Technology” 기술을 인간화하는 브랜딩, 이는 우리 팀이 당근에 존재하는 이유이자 미션이에요.
당근의 브랜딩팀은 기술의 복잡함을 사람의 언어로 바꾸고, 고객이 공감할 수 있는 브랜드 경험으로 설계해요.
우리는 브랜딩을 단지 ‘좋은 이미지와 퀄리티’로 바라보지 않아요. 당근에서 브랜딩은 내부 조직의 공감을 얻은 브랜드의 철학이 제품을 거쳐 외부 고객의 마음에 닿게 되는 하나의 여정이며, 브랜드 정체성에 기반한 크리에이티브 디렉션을 통해 비즈니스 전략과 고객 경험 사이에 다리를 놓는 일이에요.그중 브랜딩팀 캐릭터 파트는 캐릭터 특유의 귀여움으로 기술을 가장 인간답게 만드는 데 앞장서고 있어요. 이웃의 얼굴을 닮은 친근한 캐릭터들을 통해 사람들 사이의 작은 온기, 동네에 숨어 있던 일상의 가치를 전달하며, 사용자의 일상에 소소한 즐거움과 위안을 주고 싶어요.

캐릭터 디자이너는 브랜드의 페르소나와 스토리가 투영된 IP를 개발하고, 일러스트로 캐릭터에 생명력을 불어넣는 일을 하고 있어요.캐릭터의 애착 포인트를 감도 높은 그림으로 표현해 대중의 마음을 사로잡죠. 우리는 아직 출발선에 서 있지만, 캐릭터를 통해 할 수 있는 일은 무궁무진해요.당근이를 비롯해 단추, 앙리 등 당근의 캐릭터를 향한 관심과 사랑이 당근 브랜드에 대한 관심과 사랑으로 이어질 수 있도록 하는 다양한 도전에 열려 있어요.


이런 일을 해요

  • 캐릭터 애니메이션 릴스를 주도적으로 기획하고 제작해요
  • 트렌디한 바이럴 릴스뿐만 아니라, 당근 IP만의 매력이 담긴 콘텐츠를 기획해요
  • 캐릭터의 성격과 세계관을 기반으로 한 스토리를 짜고, 그것을 콘티로 그려요
  • 릴스 외 툰, 일러스트 등 전반적인 IG 콘텐츠 기획 및 제작을 함께하여 캐릭터 팬덤을 만들어요

이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요

  • 기업 내 IP 콘텐츠 부서에서 1년 이상의 관련 직무 경험을 쌓으신 분
  • 애니메이션 툴을 능숙히 다룰 수 있어 (Clip Studio, Procreate 등) 2D 기반 애니메이션 스킬을 보유하신 분
  • 캐릭터 애니메이션 릴스를 직접 기획, 제작, 발행해본 경험이 있으신 분
  • 자막, 오디오 등 애니메이션 영상 편집을 감각적으로 잘하시는 분
  • 트렌드에 민감하고, 현 캐릭터 콘텐츠 시장에 대한 이해도가 높으신 분
  • 가이드를 기반으로 한 캐릭터 드로잉이 뛰어나신 분
  • 캐릭터마다의 사랑스러운 행동 포인트를 감각적으로 캐치하고 표현해낼 수 있는 분

이런 분이면 더 좋아요

  • 개인 창작 IP를 개발하여 성공적으로 운영해본 경험이 있으신 분
  • 20초가 넘는 롱폼의 캐릭터 애니메이션 릴스를 제작해보신 분
  • 콘텐츠를 기획하여 폭발적인 조회수 / 팔로워 성장을 이끈 경험이 있으신 분
  • 내 콘텐츠를 좋아해주는 사람들의 반응에 귀 기울이고, 그 피드백을 다음 콘텐츠에 녹여낼 수 있는 분

참고해 주세요

  • 포트폴리오(필수)는 PDF로 제출해주세요
  • 본 포지션은 최초 3개월 계약 후 평가를 통해 9개월 연장 여부를 결정하는 계약직 포지션으로 해당 기간동안 풀타임 근무가 가능해야 해요
  • 포트폴리오 용량이 큰 경우 제출 시 간혹 오류가 발생하고 있어요. 이 경우, 먼저 포트폴리오를 제외한 정보를 등록해주시고 recruit@daangn.com 으로 파일을 제출해주세요
  • ‘장애인고용촉진 및 직업재활법’, ‘국가유공자 등 예우 및 지원에 관한 법률’에 따라 장애인 및 보훈대상자는 채용 전형 시 우대하고 있어요

이렇게 합류해요

1. 서류 전형 → 2. 과제 전형 → 3. 직무 인터뷰 → 4. 최종 합격

당근 전형 소개

서류 전형

당근은 자유형식의 지원서를 받고 있어요.

본인의 강점이 잘 드러나는 다양한 정보를 자유롭게 활용해 이력서를 작성해 주세요.

  • 문서 형식은 hwp(한글) 파일을 제외하고 word, pdf, 웹 링크 등 자유롭게 선택해주시면 돼요.
  • 웹 링크(노션, 구글드라이브 등)로 서류를 제출해주실 때는 접근 권한을 꼭 열어주세요.
  • 평가와 상관 없는 사진, 주소 등의 개인정보는 제외해주세요.

화상 면접

지원해주신 직무와 업무 연관성이 높은 당근 팀원과 화상으로 직무와 관련된 기본적인 지식에 대해 이야기를 나누는 단계예요.

과제 전형

직무에 따라 과제 전형이 있어요. 과제는 직무 능력과 연관된 내용으로 출제돼요. 과제 전형을 별도로 운영하는 직무도 있고, 화상 면접 또는 직무 면접에서 과제가 함께 출제되는 경우도 있어요.

직무 면접

지원하신 직무와 업무 연관성이 높은 당근 팀원들과 직무 역량, 경험에 대해 화상 면접보다 심층적인 이야기를 나누는 단계예요.
과제가 출제되었을 경우 과제에 대한 질문을 드려요.

컬쳐핏 면접(정규직 공통)

당근은 면접을 단순히 회사에 사람을 뽑는 자리로 생각하지 않아요. 당근과 지원자가 서로 추구하는 가치관과 생각을 교환하는 시간이라고 생각하고 있어요. 컬쳐핏 단계는 당근이 추구하는 문화와 일하는 방식과 잘 어울릴 수 있는 분인지 확인하는 단계예요. 또한 포지션에 대한 전문성을 다시금 확인하는 이야기를 나눠요.

안내사항

  • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있어요.
  • 전형 절차는 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있다는 점 참고해 주세요.
  • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우 합격이 취소될 수 있어요.
  • 보훈대상자 및 장애인 여부는 채용 과정에서 불이익이 없어요.
  • 경력 기간에 따라 추가 역량 검증을 위해 최대 3개월 계약직으로 근무할 수 있어요.
  • 정규직 채용의 경우 입사 후 3개월의 수습 기간이 있어요.
    평가 결과에 따라 수습 기간이 연장되거나 채용이 취소될 수 있어요.

당근 채용에 대해 궁금한 점이 있으면 언제든지 편하게 문의 주세요 :)

title: Manufacturing Plant Head
description:
Manufacturing Plant Head

About the Role

The company is scaling up electrospun nanofiber membrane production, and we are looking for a Manufacturing / Plant Head to own the plant end-to-end. You will run day-to-day operations across production, maintenance, quality, and materials; build the leadership bench beneath you; and turn a growing specialty-materials line into a disciplined, metrics-driven plant. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone equally comfortable on the production floor and in front of management.

Key Responsibilities

Plant Operations

· Own total plant performance — output, yield, uptime, cost per unit, and on-time delivery against the production plan.

· Direct daily manufacturing operations across electrospinning, converting, finishing, packaging, and utilities.

· Translate the sales and production forecast into executable line schedules, manpower plans, and equipment loading.

· Control plant operating expenses and manage the plant budget, including capital requests for equipment and facility upgrades.

· Drive process stability and repeatability on precision, parameter-sensitive equipment.

People and Leadership

· Lead, coach, and develop supervisors, team leaders, and shift leaders; build a leadership bench that can run the plant without you on the floor.

· Set performance expectations, conduct reviews, and manage skills matrices, cross-training, and succession for critical roles.

· Instil a culture of accountability, discipline, and 5S housekeeping across all shifts.

· Assume direct supervision of production in the absence of the Production Supervisor.

Quality, Safety, and Compliance

· Enforce adherence to product specifications, SOPs, and quality standards; partner with QA/QC on deviations, root-cause analysis, and corrective action.

· Champion occupational safety, chemical handling, and environmental compliance in line with DOLE, DENR, and local regulatory requirements.

· Maintain audit readiness for ISO 9001 (and ISO 14001 / 45001 where applicable) and customer or regulatory plant audits.

Supply Chain and Materials

· Monitor inventory of polymers, solvents, substrates, and consumables; initiate and follow through on purchase requests to prevent line stoppages.

· Coordinate with procurement, warehouse, and logistics on material availability, incoming quality, and finished-goods dispatch.

· Work with suppliers and toll partners on material qualification, lead times, and cost-reduction opportunities.

Continuous Improvement and Reporting

· Assess current production efficiency and management practices, identify gaps, recommend improvements, and implement them to completion.

· Establish reporting standards and dashboards that measure OEE, scrap and rework, downtime, labour productivity, and cost.

· Lead Kaizen, 5S, and Lean or Six Sigma initiatives and problem-solving activities on the floor.

· Support scale-up of new products and processes from pilot to commercial production together with R&D and Engineering.

· Represent the plant in management, production, and cross-functional meetings and report performance to senior leadership.

Qualifications

· Bachelor's degree in Chemical, Industrial, Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, or Materials Engineering, or a related technical field.

· At least 7 years of progressive manufacturing or production experience, including 3 or more years leading a plant, production department, or multiple shifts.

· Industry background preferably in specialty chemicals, advanced or technical materials, nonwovens, membranes or filtration, coatings, electronics or electrical manufacturing, or a comparable precision process industry — including suppliers and converters within these supply chains.

· Proven ownership of full plant operations: multiple departments, manpower planning, budgeting, and strategic planning.

· Strong command of production planning, inventory and materials control, maintenance coordination, and KPI-based performance management.

· Working knowledge of quality management systems (ISO 9001) and occupational safety and environmental regulations in the Philippines.

· Demonstrated ability to develop supervisors and team leaders and to lead change on the floor.

· Comfortable with data: Excel or ERP-based reporting, cost analysis, and efficiency metrics.

· Willing to work on-site in Dasmariñas, Cavite, with flexibility to support shift operations.

Preferred / Advantageous

· Exposure to electrospinning, nanofiber, or other thin-film and coating technologies, or to their upstream polymer and solvent supply chain.

· Experience scaling a process from pilot or R&D into commercial production.

· Lean, Six Sigma (Green or Black Belt), TPM, or Kaizen certification or equivalent hands-on track record.

· Experience in an export-oriented or PEZA-registered manufacturing environment.

Work Set up:

  • Onsite
  • Dasmariñas, Cavite

title: Marketing Data Analyst/Scientist

You will analyse campaign and customer data, develop reporting and forecasts, investigate performance trends, and support data-driven optimisation of our paid-search investment. Proven track record designing and maintaining high‑scale, mission‑critical services in cloud environments (AWS preferred). Experience delivering greenfield systems and evolving legacy platforms incrementally. Demonstrated impact in agile, product‑led, high‑stakes settings. Prior experience in regulated or financial services environments is advantageous. What Success Looks Like Measurable improvements in latency, throughput, and error rates against defined SLOs. Clearly defined and documented service boundaries with stable, versioned APIs. Robust test coverage and automated quality gates in CI/CD. Zero‑trust principles applied across services with least‑privilege access and strong auditability. title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer

Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. As a Principal Machine Learning Engineer, you'll serve as the definitive technical authority on ML engineering across the organisation, setting the standard for how we design, build, and scale AI systems. You will own the architectural vision for our most complex and high-stakes programmes, influence engineering strategy at an organisational level, and act as a trusted partner to senior leadership and executive clients.

This role goes beyond leading projects, you are a force multiplier who shapes the engineering culture, elevates the capability of those around you, and ensures our technical foundations are built to last.

What you'll be doing:

  • Defining and owning the organisation-wide technical vision for ML engineering, establishing architectural standards and engineering practices that scale across teams and clients.

  • Overseeing the end-to-end delivery of flagship, business-critical ML programmes, spanning multiple workstreams, engineering teams, and client organisations.

  • Driving the strategic adoption of new technologies, platforms, and ways of working, influencing how the entire engineering craft evolves.

  • Cultivating senior engineering talent, coaching leads and managers, building capability pipelines, and embedding a culture of technical rigour and excellence.

  • Acting as the principal technical voice in C-suite and executive client engagements, shaping AI strategy and securing long-term strategic partnerships.

  • Leading on the most significant sales and pre-sales opportunities, providing architectural authority that differentiates our proposition and wins high-value engagements.

  • Partnering with Data Science, Commercial, and Infrastructure leadership to align ML engineering strategy with broader business goals and growth ambitions.

Who we're looking for:

  • You are a recognised ML engineering authority, able to go exceptionally deep across multiple domains and provide definitive technical judgement on the hardest problems.

  • You have mastery of Python and a proven track record of designing and operationalising production-grade ML systems at scale, across multiple frameworks and paradigms.

  • You are an expert across multiple major Cloud Solution Providers and have set the architectural direction for complex, full-stack AI platforms spanning multiple organisations.

  • You have a visible external profile, through publications, conference contributions, open-source leadership, or industry influence, that reflects your standing in the field.

Our Interview Process

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Introduction to the role (45 minutes)

  3. Pair Programming Interview (90 minutes)

  4. System Design Interview (90 minutes)

  5. Commercial & Leadership Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Head of Legal @ AI Chip DeepTech Venture, Dresden / Berlin
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.


About the Venture

We build brain-inspired computing hardware designed to tackle problems that conventional computing handles badly or not at all. Our technology has its roots in leading European research and is now a commercial system, being deployed by research institutions, supercomputing centres and companies internationally.

We are a deep-tech company moving from research-led development into a much larger commercial operation. We are scaling our hardware deployments, expanding our international customer base and building the organisation and infrastructure to support the next phase of growth.

We recently closed fresh funding, are around 70 employees in size and based out of our Dresden HQ.

About the Role

This is our first legal hire.

Legal currently sits largely with the managing directors. Your mandate is to build the legal function, establish clear decision rights and create the infrastructure that allows the company to scale without unnecessary friction.

You will own legal end to end, from corporate and commercial through to export control, IP and product regulation. The remit is broad because we sell sophisticated, regulated hardware internationally and are moving faster than our processes have historically allowed.

This is a role for someone who enjoys both the legal and operational sides of the job: not simply answering questions, but building the frameworks, processes and decision-making structures that prevent the same questions from coming up repeatedly.

What you'll do

  • Own corporate governance across our German GmbH and US entity: shareholder and board matters, financing rounds, related-party and conflict-of-interest questions.

  • Lead commercial contracting across hardware sales, licensing, research collaborations, cloud and service agreements, and NDAs. Build the templates and playbook so that standard cases can be handled efficiently.

  • Take ownership of export control and dual-use matters, including EU Dual-Use Regulation, German licensing requirements, US export-control exposure, sanctions and restricted-party screening.

  • Lead our cybersecurity and product compliance agenda, including NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and related incident-reporting and conformity requirements.

  • Cover product safety and market access for the hardware itself, including CE marking, EMC, RoHS, REACH and product liability.

  • Manage our IP portfolio: patents, freedom to operate, trade secrets, licensing, technology rights and trademarks.

  • Manage compliance obligations connected to public funding, including grant conditions, record keeping and audit readiness.

  • Work with People & Culture on employment matters, including contracts, terminations, employee participation structures, immigration. Data protection and GDPR sit here too.

  • Oversee open-source licence compliance and software supply-chain obligations together with engineering.

  • Build the delegation layer: signing authority, approval thresholds, decision rights and clear ownership, so that routine hiring, procurement and commercial decisions do not automatically converge on the managing directors.

  • Decide what we keep in house and what goes to external counsel, then manage those firms and the associated budget.

About You

You are comfortable being the only lawyer in the building, and you see that as an opportunity rather than a risk. You enjoy the operational side of legal work as much as the technical side.

You are direct, commercially minded and comfortable making judgement calls. You know where your own limits are and are happy to bring in specialists when the question warrants it.

  • Qualified German lawyer (Volljurist), with fluency in EU regulation.

  • In-house experience at a semiconductor, hardware or deep-tech company, ideally in a start-up or scale-up environment rather than exclusively in a large corporate legal department is strongly preferred.

  • Experience with export control and dual-use questions in a business that actually ships internationally, including an understanding of the difference between licensing and per-transaction screening.

  • Comfortable across a wide surface: corporate, commercial, IP, employment and regulatory. You do not need to be the deepest expert in each area, but you need to know what good looks like and when to escalate.

  • You have built structure inside a company before: templates, approval frameworks, signing authority or something equivalent that outlived your involvement.

  • Familiarity with hardware product regulation, CE marking, RoHS and REACH, or with the evolving EU cybersecurity regime is a strong plus.

  • German and English at working fluency, both written and spoken.

  • Based in or willing to relocate to the company's location in either Dresden or Berlin.

Why Join

You would be shaping the legal function of a company with direct access to the managing directors.

The subject matter is unusually interesting: brain-inspired computing, advanced hardware, international technology sales, export-controlled technology, research partnerships and a regulatory environment that is evolving in real time.

The work environment is flexible and inclusive, and we offer a competitive salary with relocation support for the right person. If you want to build something meaningful rather than maintain something that already exists, this is that kind of role.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
I'm recruiting a Senior Data Engineer to join an established organisation continuing a significant modernisation of its data capability.

Over the last couple of years, the business has been moving away from a legacy data estate and establishing a modern Microsoft Fabric/Azure platform.

The next stage is about turning those foundations into a genuinely modern, code-led engineering environment.

This is a hands‑on Senior Data Engineer role. They aren't looking for someone who wants to move away from development into pure management.

You'll work across:

  • Python / PySpark
  • Microsoft Fabric
  • Spark and notebook engineering
  • Lakehouse / Medallion architecture
  • Delta
  • SQL
  • Azure
  • Git / CI/CD
  • Automated testing
  • Data quality and observability
  • Reusable engineering patterns

They're particularly interested in people coming from Databricks/PySpark environments, so extensive Fabric experience isn't essential.

At Senior level, you'll also have the opportunity to influence architecture, technical design, coding standards, CI/CD, testing and engineering best practice, while supporting other engineers and taking ownership of more complex technical problems.

There's still a significant amount to build, and the longer‑term direction extends beyond traditional data engineering into AI, Generative AI and intelligent automation.

It's a good opportunity for somebody who wants to remain deeply technical and hands‑on, but wants more influence over how a modern data engineering capability develops.

£70,000 - £80,000 North West 1-2 days per week

Potential flexibility above this for an exceptional candidate.

title: Data platform engineer
description:
Ninety One is South Africa’s largest investment manager and the only one with a global presence. The firm has 22 offices across 15 countries on five continents and manages R4.0 trillion of assets on behalf of clients (as at 30 June 2026).

Established in Cape Town in 1991 as part of the Investec Group, Ninety One demerged and rebranded in 2020, becoming an independent firm dual-listed in London and Johannesburg.

Always an active manager, Ninety One today offers strategies across equities, fixed income, multi-asset and private markets to institutions, advisors and individual investors around the world.

About the team:

At Ninety One, the vision for data is for trustworthy, discoverable and timely information to be at everybody’s fingertips. Data is our number one technology priority and foundational in our journey to become an AI-centred organisation.

The Data Technology team are custodians of Ninety One’s enterprise data platform and the core data domains that drive the firm’s investments and analytics engines. The team comprises several cross-functional, high-performing delivery squads, resourced through a mix of business and technology stakeholders. Their mandate is to deliver high quality, business value solutions, while assuring the highest standards of speed, accuracy, stability and security.

We treat data as a product and subscribe to a modern, customer-centred product development philosophy and as a team our key objectives are:

Better data - by improving the quality, trustworthiness, traceability and ownership of data Faster data - by continuously reducing the time between data sourcing and information delivery More data - by expanding the contextual, historical and domain content available and making it discoverable

We believe in the power of technology to enable our vision and are looking for passionate, committed individuals to join us on our journey.

In this role you will have a unique opportunity to work in a blended role requiring Data Engineering, Azure Cloud Infrastructure and Dev Ops practices to keep Ninety One's Databricks environment reliable, secure and well governed while building automation, common tooling and self-service for platform users.

In this role you will: Work across both the data engineering and infrastructure/platform spaces to design, build and maintain solutions at the platform layer: Python solutions for platform and automation. Common shared libraries/modules used by data engineers and analysts across the platform. Pipelines/processes that support overall platform management (e.g. for purposes such as cost tracking, governance, provisioning, monitoring). CI/CD pipelines (Dev Ops/Git Hub Actions) for platform and application deployments Terraform Ia C for Azure services and Azure Databricks (e.g. Unity Catalog, workspaces, networking, compute policies) Collaborate with a wide ranging scope of teams including data engineers, analysts, security and infrastructure teams to translate requirements into capabilities. Provide platform support to engineering teams and platform users including assisting with issues, ranging from code, platform and infrastructure. Contribute to platform documentation, patterns and best-practice standards You should consider applying if you have: BSc Computer Science or equivalent Minimum 7 years technology experience, with at least 3 years’ experience in the cloud platform/data platform roles Intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Azure infrastructure Proficiency in Python and/or SQL;. NET is a plus Azure Dev Ops and/or Git Hub Actions Terraform (Ia C) experience, ideally in a multi-environment setup Understanding of Platform Governance, Security Experience in Data Modelling, Data Contracts and exposure to Fin Ops/cost attribution practices Some of the attributes we look for in a person: The ability to build and maintain meaningful relationships The ability to ‘approach and own’ and continuously look for opportunities to develop A client focused and collaborative approach High conviction and be comfortable sharing opinions A curiosity about technology and its potential to drive innovation

title: Senior cloud data engineer
description:
Location: CT/JHB

Our client, a well-known South African media and technology company, is looking for a Senior Cloud Data Engineer to join their team. This organisation is behind some of the country's most recognisable digital news and information brands, and its in-house team of engineers, data scientists, product managers and UX/UI designers builds the digital products that keep millions of South Africans informed, entertained and inspired every day.

Why join this team?

You’ll be joining a people-focused, innovation-driven engineering culture that uses a sophisticated, modern tech stack to deliver world-class digital solutions. This is a business with a strong societal mission, and the data engineering team plays a central role in turning raw data into the stories and insights that help decision-makers steer the business forward.

What will you do?

You’ll work primarily within a Google Cloud environment, using tools across the Google stack, from Big Query and Dataproc to Kubernetes and AI Hub. You should be comfortable thinking in Python and speaking fluent SQL, and you shouldn’t be afraid to dive into messy, unstructured data and help the wider team make sense of it. Continuous learning and growth: benefit from a wealth of learning opportunities, including free access to platforms like Udemy, the chance to pursue nanodegrees, complimentary Microsoft certification training, and bursary opportunities, all backed by a major listed parent group. Stay ahead: attend leading tech events and expos to keep up with industry trends and innovation. Personalised benefits: choose from optional medical aid and customisable retirement funding options to suit your needs. Give back: take up to 3 days of paid volunteering leave each year to support causes you care about.

This role is being handled on an exclusive basis by our agency on behalf of our client, whose identity will be shared with shortlisted candidates. In line with our client’s employment equity policy, preference will be given to suitable candidates from designated groups.

As we receive a high volume of applications, we are unfortunately not able to respond individually to every candidate. If you have not heard from us within one month, please take this as confirmation that your application was not successful on this occasion. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Asiakkaastamme, työstä ja Duuri-tiimistä työnantajana (sekä tarjoamistamme henkilöstöeduista, mm. Epassi) kuulet lisää haastattelussa.

Täytä hakemus oheisen linkin kautta, niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä ja sovitaan aika työhaastattelulle. Haastattelut aloitetaan heti ja valinta saatetaan tehdä jo hakuaikana. Odotamme hakemustasi!

---



Voit hakea matalalla kynnyksellä. Hakulomakkeen kaikkia kohtia ei ole pakko täyttää.

Mikä on Duuri-tiimi?

9,49/10 suosittelee meitä työnantajina. Lähde: 6/2025 anonyymi henkilöstökysely

Muutama vuosi sitten syntyi hurja idea: voisiko olla vuokratyöfirma, jonka työntekijät olisivat niin tyytyväisiä siihen alustana tehdä töitä, että se voisi tuntua vähintään yhtä houkuttelevalta vaihtoehdolta kuin suora työsuhde.

Tavoite tuntui tuoreelle yrittäjäpariskunnalle utopistiselta - vaikka alan maine onkin paljon parantunut viime vuosina - mutta siltä pohjalta lähdettiin rakentamaan. Sittemmin Duuri-tiimiin on työllistynyt kymmeniä ihmisiä, joista osa on päättänyt rakentaa uraa työllistämällä muita Duuri-tiimin toimihenkilöinä.

Strategia on yksinkertainen: hoidetaan rekrytointi ja työsuhteet niin hyvin ja suoraselkäisesti, että ihmiset haluavat jäädä meille töihin ja toivottavasti suosittelevat myös tutuilleen. Kasvu onkin ollut vauhdikasta ja käytännön alojen lisäksi olemme rekrytoineet myös päällikkötason tehtäviin ja monille eri aloille.

Toimimme ympäri Suomen. Henkilöstökyselyn tuloksena päätimme hiljattain investoida työntekijöillemme Epassin työsuhde-etuna.

Kyselytulosten mukaan näyttää siltä, että jotain on tehty ilmeisesti oikein ja useammat ovat jopa päättäneet mielummin jäädä meidän kirjoillemme, mikä on koskettava luottamuksen osoitus.

Tule mukaamme tuomaan lisää Duuria työelämään. Meidän alustalla voit tehdä käytännössä mitä vain töitä ja tilaajalle malli on yksinkertainen. Me maksamme palkan, kuten yleensäkin työsuhteissa ja tilaaja saa kustannukset kätevästi laskutuksella.

Kauttamme saa sekä keikka- että vakihommaa.

title: Senior Business Analyst Europe (d/f/m)
description:
Position, Location, Department
Full-time | Madrid, Spain | Digital Europe


Position Summary

The Senior Business Analyst Europe supports the Team Lead Digitalisation Europe in understanding business needs, gathering stakeholder requirements, and coordinating digitalisation and transformation initiatives across Europe. You act as a link between European business stakeholders, the Digitalisation team, and relevant HQ teams in China, helping ensure that business requirements, project activities, user feedback, and implementation progress are clearly documented and followed through.
In this position, you work closely with European departments to understand their processes and needs, while coordinating with HQ in China to identify existing digital solutions and assess their applicability to the European business.
As a secondary area of responsibility, you support market and commercial analysis to provide relevant insights for business and sales decision-making.

Reporting Line
Reports to Team Lead Digitalisation Europe


Major Responsibilities

Business Analysis & Digitalisation Projects

  • Gather business requirements and stakeholder input across relevant functions and European departments, developing a clear understanding of their processes, challenges, and digitalisation needs
  • Translate business needs into clear and structured requirements for the Digitalisation team and relevant HQ stakeholders
  • Coordinate assigned digitalisation and transformation initiatives, including project planning, stakeholder alignment, user feedback, implementation follow-up, and communication
  • Track actions, requirements, issues, dependencies, milestones, and project progress to support successful delivery
  • Facilitate communication and alignment between European stakeholders, the Digitalisation team, and relevant HQ teams in China
  • Work with HQ to understand existing systems, digital solutions, and transformation initiatives in China and assess their applicability to European business processes and requirements
  • Support the adaptation and implementation of suitable HQ solutions within the European organisation
Business Performance & Reporting
  • Prepare business analysis and ad hoc insights to support management decision-making
  • Support selected reporting, dashboards, and data analysis activities
  • Conduct structured analysis on commercial, operational, or organisational topics as required
Market & Commercial Analysis
  • Analyse relevant market developments, customers, competitors, and commercial trends
  • Provide structured market and commercial insights to support Sales and management decision-making
Selected Strategic Projects
  • Support selected cross-functional projects through analysis, project coordination, stakeholder alignment, and follow-up
  • Assist with fact-finding, project tracking, and preparation of materials for assigned initiatives
  • Coordinate with European departments and HQ stakeholders to ensure that project requirements, responsibilities, and next steps are clearly understood and followed through

Performance Indicators

  • Timely delivery of assigned analysis, project coordination, and digitalisation support activities
  • Quality of business requirements, analysis, and reporting outputs
  • Successful coordination, implementation, and adoption of assigned digitalisation projects and initiatives
  • Effective coordination and alignment between European stakeholders, the Digitalisation team, and HQ teams
  • Stakeholder satisfaction with delivered analysis and support
  • Contribution to management decision-making and business improvement initiatives

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Business Analytics, Economics, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field
  • Typically 3-8 years of experience in business analysis, digitalisation, digital transformation, project coordination, or a comparable business-facing role; experience within the solar or wider renewable energy industry is advantageous but not required
  • Experience gathering business requirements and supporting digitalisation or business improvement initiatives is an advantage
  • Experience coordinating digitalisation, transformation, IT, or other cross-functional projects is strongly preferred
  • Experience in commercial, market, or business analysis is an advantage
  • Experience working with international and cross-cultural stakeholders, particularly between European and Chinese teams, is an advantage
  • A combined background in digitalisation, IT, or transformation and the solar or renewable energy industry is a strong advantage
  • Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with Salesforce, Power BI, or similar tools is an advantage
  • Fluent English and Chinese are mandatory; additional European languages are an advantage

Skills & Competencies

  • Structured analytical thinking
  • Strong fact-finding and requirements-gathering skills
  • Ability to translate business needs into clear requirements and actions
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Strong project coordination and organisational skills, with the ability to manage actions, dependencies, timelines, and stakeholder follow-up
  • Ability to communicate effectively across European and Chinese business environments and facilitate alignment between stakeholders with different operational perspectives
  • Ability to understand existing digital solutions and assess their suitability for European business requirements
  • High level of ownership and attention to detail

Travel Requirement

Occasional travel across Europe and, where required, to support coordination with HQ or other international stakeholders.

title: Tarjoilijoita, The Icebreaking Company Oy (talvikausi 2026–2027)

title: ICT Centralised Services - Maldon District Council
description:
Maldon District Council is working in partnership with Essex Shared Services to support the role of ICT Centralised Services a full-time position offering hybrid working with an expectation of attending the office one day per week. Check out Maldon's careers page to see what it’s like to work for Maldon.

Role Purpose:

  • Provide specialist technical support across ICT services by monitoring, maintaining and assuring the performance, availability and stability of the Council’s ICT systems and infrastructure.
  • Act as a central technical resource between IT projects and IT support, supporting the transition of systems, upgrades and changes into business-as-usual service.
  • Monitor system performance, alerts and incidents to identify emerging issues, risks or service degradation and support timely resolution.
  • Support business-as-usual ICT services by responding to and assisting with technical incidents and problems when required, flexing effort in response to operational need.
  • Provide technical input and assurance to IT projects, ensuring systems are stable, secure and supportad services operate in line with agreed standards, security requirements, policies and best practice.
  • Maintain accurate technical records, documentation and monitoring information to support effective service management and continuity.
  • Work collaboratively with IT support, project teams and suppliers to deliver reliable, resilient and customer-focused ICT services.
  • Be a role model for the service, demonstrating professionalism, resilience and a strong focus on communication, continuous improvement and service quality.

Accountabilities – Service Delivery:

  • Monitor the performance, availability and health of ICT systems, infrastructure and services, identifying issues, trends and risks and supporting timely resolution.
  • Provide specialist technical support across ICT services, contributing to the resolution of incidents, problems and service disruptions where required.
  • Support the transition of IT projects, system changes and upgrades into business-as-usual support, ensuring appropriate handover, documentation and technical assurance.
  • Work closely with IT support and project teams to ensure systems are stable, secure and supportable, providing technical input and challenge where appropriate.
  • Maintain and update technical documentation, system records and monitoring information to support effective service management and continuity.
  • Identify opportunities to improve system performance, resilience and monitoring arrangements, contributing to continuous improvement activity.
  • Support compliance with ICT policies, security standards, data protection requirements and technical governance arrangements.
  • Engage with internal teams and external suppliers as required to support effective ICT service delivery and issue resolution.

The Experience You Will Bring:

Qualifications and Knowledge: A strong candidate will have a relevant degree or equivalent experience, supported by ongoing CPD and technical knowledge across ICT systems, infrastructure, cloud services and service management. You’ll bring hands‑on experience in ICT service delivery, with a solid understanding of local‑authority‑scale environments, Azure cloud platforms, system monitoring, performance management and ITSM practices. You should understand how projects transition into BAU support, be aware of cyber security, resilience, backup and recovery, and have strong knowledge of information governance and data protection. Crucially, you’ll recognise how ICT underpins wider council operations and frontline services.

Experience: A strong candidate who has hands‑on experience in technical ICT support within medium or large organisations, confidently monitoring live systems, responding to alerts and resolving or escalating issues. You’ll have experience supporting both BAU services and project changes, working with cloud platforms like Azure, following ICT standards and change control, and contributing to incident investigation and service improvement. You’ll work collaboratively with teams and suppliers, managing competing priorities and adapting to changing operational demands in a technical environment.

Skills and Ability: A strong candidate who will bring solid technical aptitude, able to monitor and interpret system performance, investigate issues and take appropriate action. You’ll work confidently across BAU and project activity, using strong problem‑solving skills, clear communication and the ability to explain technical matters to non‑technical colleagues. You’ll collaborate effectively with ICT teams, stay organised while managing competing tasks, remain calm in a live operational environment, and use ICT tools and Microsoft applications to track activity and maintain accurate records. A willingness to continue developing your technical skills as systems evolve is essential.

We are able to offer ongoing training opportunities to the successful candidate to support your career growth.

Be part of Maldon District Council - 'Where Quality of Life Matters'

Maldon District Council is a local authority 'Where quality of life matters'. Our Corporate Plan sets out our vision and priorities for the next three years and will be reviewed regularly to make sure we are on the right track. Using a range of data and what we know about the needs of our residents, we have set out what we will be doing and what we aim to achieve between now and 2028. It is also a useful tool that helps with decision-making and allocating resources.

To download or listen to a presentation of the Corporate Plan 2025-2028 click here

Maldon District Council plays a crucial role in the development and prosperity of the District, working for the good of the community and the long term benefit of residents, you can be part of our friendly team. From front line customer facing roles to policy and strategy, the work of the Council is diverse and dynamic.

In addition to a competitive salary, you will be entitled to a range of benefits, including:

  • The Local Government Pension Scheme
  • Generous holiday entitlement
  • Flexible and agile working
  • Employee assistance programme
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Salary sacrifice car lease scheme
  • Discounted local gym membership
  • Free parking

Maldon District Council is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of vulnerable groups including children, young people and adults and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. Disclosure and Barring checks will be undertaken according to the responsibilities of the role. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, culture and experience. Applicants will be considered regardless of race, sex, disability or marital status.

Maldon District Council is committed to the employment and career development of disabled people. To demonstrate our commitment, we have been accredited as a Disability Confident Employer. As a Disability Confident Employer we take various actions in order to successfully employ and retain disabled people and those with health conditions.

For more information on these roles or if you have any questions, please email essexsharedservices@essex.gov.uk. Alternatively, you can contact us by phone:

Samantha Myddelton, Business Development Lead: 0333 013 0098

Thea Towers, Specialist Recruitment Consultant: 0333 013 0184

For further information about the organisation, please visit the Maldon District Council website.

Essex Shared Services is advertising this role as part of its partnership with Maldon District Council; however, the successful candidate will be employed directly by Maldon District Council.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer - SDET
description:
About MariaDB

MariaDB is making a big impact on the world. Whether you’re checking your bank account, buying a coffee, shopping online, making a phone call, listening to music, taking out a loan or ordering takeout – MariaDB is the backbone of applications used everyday. Companies small and large, including 75% of the Fortune 500, run MariaDB, touching the lives of billions of people. With massive reach through Linux distributions, enterprise deployments and public clouds, MariaDB is uniquely positioned as the leading database for modern application development.

The Role

We’re looking for an experienced Senior QA Automation Engineer / SDET to join the GridGain Core QA Team and help drive the quality, reliability, and performance of our distributed database platform.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated tests and support frameworks for functional and performance testing;
  • Participate in release testing activities and contribute to improving the release validation process;
  • Validate new product features, bug fixes, and performance improvements;
  • Investigate complex issues involving distributed transactions, replication, networking, storage, and cluster management;

  • Strong Java programming skills and knowledge of the Java ecosystem;
  • Experience designing, developing, and maintaining automated tests and frameworks.

  • Solid understanding of at least three of:
    • Multithreading;
    • Concurrency;
    • Networking;
    • Distributed systems concepts;
    • Transactions;

  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes;
  • Experience with MariaDB or other relational databases;
  • Experience with modern AI tools and applying them to improve engineering productivity;
  • Experience with performance testing, profiling, and troubleshooting complex systems

Remote – Croatia, Estonia, Finland, Italy, Poland, Romania, Serbia, Spain.

We weren't built to follow, we were built to lead.

SAMY is the global powerhouse redefining brand communication for a social-first world—helping brands stay relevant, shape culture, and build real connections at the speed the world moves.

Since 2013, we've grown from a bold idea into a global force: 1,200+ experts, 17+ offices, 55 markets, 22+ countries. We launch 40+ campaigns a week, create one piece of content every minute, and generate +$500K in revenue every day.

We are Path Finders: curious, ambitious, and never afraid to challenge what's next.

We don't play it safe. We build what's next.

Instagram | TikTok | Culture page

Role Mission

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize scalable data solutions that enable business decision-making. This role will be responsible for developing and maintaining data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and data models while ensuring data quality, availability, and performance within the Google Cloud Platform ecosystem. ,

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and optimize complex SQL queries for data transformation and analysis.
  • Design and maintain Data Warehouse models.
  • Develop Python scripts to ingest data from APIs.
  • Automate data ingestion, transformation, and validation processes.
  • Manage and optimize large datasets using Google BigQuery.
  • Integrate multiple data sources using tools such as Fivetran, Supermetrics, or similar platforms.

  • Collaborate with Analytics, BI, and Engineering teams to deliver scalable data solutions.

  • Experience developing Python scripts for API integrations and data ingestion.
  • Solid experience designing and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines.
  • Experience with data integration tools such as Fivetran, Supermetrics, or similar.
  • General knowledge of the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ecosystem, particularly data storage and processing services.

Benefits

because respect, trust, and honest feedback make great teams stronger.

because good is never enough when excellence is the standard.

because the best ideas don't happen in silos.

because growth lives outside the comfort zone.

Own It

because real impact starts with accountability.

Diversity & Inclusion

At SAMY, difference is not something we accommodate, it's what makes us stronger.

With a team made up of 70% women and more than 35 different nationalities, our different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences challenge our thinking, sharpen our creativity, and push us to build better work, and a better company.

title: Workplace Experience Specialist (HQ)
description:
Brief info about Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information about the position

The Workplace Experience Team creates diverse, flexible, and engaging work environments across Vinted offices, warehouses, and verification centres. Our mission is to empower employees to choose the working approach that best suits their needs. We support hybrid working models by providing tools, infrastructure, and experiences that foster productivity, collaboration, and connection.

As a Workplace Experience Manager, you will manage the day-to-day operations and facilities of our Vilnius office. You will work with the Workplace Experience Team to ensure Vinted’s workplace standards are consistently applied, while identifying opportunities for improvements and driving continuous enhancement initiatives.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on tehtävään soveltuva ammattitutkinto tai muu soveltuva koulutus.

Tehtävään valittavan tulee toimittaa rikosrekisterilain 6 § 2 momentissa tarkoitettu rikosrekisteriote (laki lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä 504/2002) työnantajalle.

Jäkärlän päiväkoti sijaitsee vehreän luonnon keskellä Turun pohjoisosassa. Uusi päiväkotirakennus tarjoaa nykyaikaiseen oppimisympäristöön tarvittavat valoisat, monipuoliset tilat ja toimintavälineet. Päiväkodin ympäristössä on runsaasti rakentamatonta luontoa oppimisympäristön laajentamiseen, ja päiväkodin vieressä sijaitsevan Jäkärlän urheilupuiston peruskorjaus tuo vielä mahtavat lisämahdollisuudet liikuntaan päiväkodin salin ja uusien pihojen lisäksi.

Jäkärlässä on pitkät perinteet koulun ja päiväkodin yhteistyölle, joten nivelvaiheet varhaiskasvatuksesta esikouluun ja sieltä kouluun sujuvat jouhevasti yhteisiä projekteja tehden.

Jäkärlän päiväkoti sijaitsee hyvien liikenneyhteyksien päässä; omalla autolla matka keskustasta taittuu reilussa vartissa, ja päiväkodin edustalla on reilusti parkkitilaa. Myös julkisilla kulkuneuvoilla päiväkotiimme pääsee sujuvasti, ja Turku tukee bussilla kulkemista tarjoamalla työsuhdematkaedun.

Työsuhde-etuina Turun kaupunki tarjoaa mm.:
- monipuolisia koulutuksia
- Fölin työmatkakortin edullisempiin bussimatkoihin
- Tyky-rannekkeen Turun kaupungin liikunta- ja kulttuuripalveluihin

Tasa-arvon ja yhdenvertaisuuden edistämiseksi Turun kaupunki suosii anonyymiä rekrytointia. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa sitä, että rekrytointiprosessin ensimmäisessä vaiheessa työhakemuksen avoimiin kysymyksiin ei tule sisällyttää tietoja esim. iästä, äidinkielestä tai sukupuolesta. Vaikka osaa tiedoista taustatiedoissa kysytään, nämä tiedot eivät näy rekrytoivalle lähijohtajalle anonyymissä hakijaraportissa. Anonyymin rekrytoinnin tavoitteena on kohdentaa huomio hakijan ammatilliseen osaamiseen sekä työkokemukseen.

Työpaikan osoite: Jäkärlän puistokatu 8, 20460 Turku

title: Senior Product Manager,Trust Platform – Modules (f/m/d)

description:
IDnow is a leader in digital identity and fraud prevention in Europe with a mission to transform trust into the most powerful asset in the digital world, empowering enterprises with AI-driven, SaaS-based identity solutions that deliver scalable security, adaptive compliance, and real-time fraud prevention. Through its broad portfolio of digital identity and fraud prevention solutions, IDnow establishes, maintains and enriches trust throughout the customer journey, ensuring businesses can confidently and securely operate while leveraging digital identity to drive growth, security and scalability.

The company has offices in Germany, United Kingdom, Romania and France, and is backed by renowned institutional investors, including Corsair Capital and Seventure Partners. Its portfolio of international clients spans a wide range of end markets including financial services, telecommunications, travel & mobility, gaming, and other industries.

This position is based in Berlin/Munich, Germany.

The Trust Platform team builds the capabilities that bring identity and fraud prevention signals together into configurable customer journeys. It gives customers a consistent way to orchestrate signals, configure decision logic, and access outcomes through APIs and a studio. By connecting IDnow products, external providers, and customer needs, the team turns a broad platform ecosystem into clear, scalable solutions. Its work strengthens IDnow’s ability to help businesses make trusted decisions throughout the customer journey.

As (Senior) Product Manager, Trust Platform – Modules (f/m/d), you own the product direction for platform capabilities that extend the Trust Platform’s orchestration model, studio, APIs, dashboard, and data layer. You work at the intersection of market and commercial functions, customers, vendors, other IDnow product teams, Engineering, Data, Design, and Analytics. This is the most strategic and market-facing product role in the team, with responsibility for anticipating customer needs and translating them into coherent platform capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • You are very close to our customers and work closely with Sales, Solutions, Marketing, and other commercial functions to assess market needs, anticipate customer problems, and proactively identify viable use cases
  • Lead the end-to-end integration lifecycle for non-IDnow signals, including biometrics, device fingerprinting, Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) and sanctions screening, document databases, and credit bureaus, across the orchestration model, studio, and application programming interfaces (APIs)
  • Conduct commercial and technical evaluations of vendors and lead requests for proposal (RFP) processes to ensure the Trust Platform offers state-of-the-art tools and capabilities
  • Act as the product counterpart to other IDnow product teams, own the integration of their products into the Trust Platform, and manage cross-functional dependencies
  • Own the dashboards and analytics features within the Trust Platform dashboard, providing customers with meaningful real-time data on conversion, drop-offs, and fraud
  • Design unified data schemas and reusable data blocks so signals from different providers use consistent definitions and speak the same language within the Trust Platform
  • Enable internal teams to understand and navigate the Trust Platform so they can help customers gain the most value from their integration

Turn back if …

  • You prefer working on a single product in isolation over orchestrating a broad ecosystem of signals, vendors, and integrations.
  • You prefer to work in a traditional product-owner style that primarily focuses on executing and backlog management
  • You're looking for a highly structured environment where every process already exists.
  • You are uncomfortable working in complex stakeholder environments with multiple priorities and high degree of ambiguity.

Preferred Experience

  • You bring 5+ years of product management experience with end-to-end ownership of product strategy, discovery, prioritisation, delivery, and continuous improvement
  • You have experience in bringing new products to the market, coordinating go to market activities and pricing of SaaS products
  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment, have an easy time managing ambiguity and constantly re-assess the current direction and priorities
  • Knowledge and experience in digital identity, fraud prevention, risk, compliance, or a regulated industry such as banking, fintech, insurance, or telecommunications is a strong plus
  • You have experience with platforms, orchestration, APIs, or third-party integrations in a technically complex environment
  • You are great at building strong relationships with customers and commercial stakeholders, using market conversations to identify meaningful product opportunities
  • You have a track record of leading vendor evaluations and RFPs across commercial, technical, security, and operational criteria
  • You an autonomous and pragmatic working style and experience in launching new products, bringing them to the market and scaling them
  • Communicate complex technical and business topics clearly to senior stakeholders, customers, and internal enablement audiences

Perks & Benefits

  • We value personal and professional development: make full use of Udemy, our training platform with 24/7 access and unlimited licences.

  • We value collaboration & love to come together: regular onsite gatherings, internal initiatives and summer parties to connect across teams.
  • May your family require your attention or other reasons apply: use the benefits of our parental leave policy or our sabbatical programme.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:

Senior Data Engineers lead the design and implementation of complex data flows, connecting operational systems to analytics platforms. In this role, you’ll work with the EUC&C community to identify data sources, engage with analysts and stakeholders, and build robust pipelines that align with business needs through collaboration with Product Owners.

The Senior Data Engineer collects, organizes and studies data to provide business insight. Collaborating with fellow members of the Data Engineering community to set the direction of the service technology and data architecture. The post holder will also mentor more junior members of the team - promoting challenge, collaborating and encouraging an agile approach to working.

The End User Compute and Collaboration (EUC&C) team develops and delivers a range of Microsoft 365 solutions, including Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Power Platform, and Office applications. These tools support collaboration and productivity across the organization.

Watch this video to hear from members of the team talking about the projects they work on and their experience of working here.

Full-time. This role is not suitable for part‑time working due to business requirements and the nature of the role.

  • Ensuring the successful delivery of completed data loads for customers, Data Analysts and Data Scientists, troubleshooting where required.

title: Yhteyspäällikkö Hunaja Worksille
description:
Haluatko auttaa yrityksiä löytämään oikeat osaajat ja rakentaa pitkäjänteisiä asiakassuhteita henkilöstöpalvelualalla?

Etsimme Hunaja Worksille Turkuun yhteyspäällikköä. Hunaja Works on henkilöstöpalveluyritys, joka yhdistää osaajat ja yritykset ympäri Suomen. Toimimme vahvasti teollisuuden rekrytointien ja henkilöstöratkaisujen parissa, ja yhteistyömme HC TPS:n kanssa tarjoaa myös mahdollisuuksia verkostoitumiseen, uusien asiakkuuksien rakentamiseen ja alueellisen näkyvyyden kasvattamiseen.

Työssäsi tunnistat uusia liiketoimintamahdollisuuksia, rakennat luottamuksellisia asiakassuhteita ja autat asiakkaita löytämään heidän tarpeisiinsa sopivat henkilöstöratkaisut. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä muun tiimin kanssa varmistaen, että asiakkaat ja vuokratyöntekijät saavat laadukasta palvelua koko yhteistyön ajan.

Tehtäviisi kuuluu esimerkiksi:

  • uusien asiakkuuksien hankinta ja nykyisten asiakassuhteiden kehittäminen
  • asiakkaiden henkilöstötarpeiden kartoittaminen sekä ratkaisujen myynti
  • henkilöstövuokraus- ja rekrytointipalveluiden myynti
  • tarjousten, palvelukokonaisuuksien ja sopimusten valmistelu
  • asiakastapaamisten suunnittelu ja toteuttaminen
  • lisämyynnin ja uusien liiketoimintamahdollisuuksien tunnistaminen
  • osallistuminen tarvittaessa rekrytointiprosesseihin
  • verkostoituminen tapahtumissa sekä markkinointiyhteistyöhön osallistuminen.

Millaista henkilöä etsimme?

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on kokemusta henkilöstöpalvelualalta ja ymmärrystä yritysten henkilöstötarpeista. Arvostamme erityisesti kokemusta henkilöstöpalvelualan myynnistä sekä alueellisten yritysverkostojen tuntemusta.

Toivomme, että:

  • toimit oma-aloitteisesti ja tavoitteellisesti
  • nautit tiiviistä yhteistyöstä muiden kanssa
  • viet asiat sovitusti maaliin asti
  • ymmärrät hyvän asiakas- ja työntekijäkokemuksen merkityksen
  • rakennat luottamusta luontevasti.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa suoraan liiketoiminnan kasvuun kasvavassa joukkueessamme. Et hyppää jäälle yksin, vaan tukenasi ovat kokeneet myyntitykkimme Juha Lehtonen ja Juha Oksanen, joiden kanssa sparrailet arjessa. Myynnin tukena toimii myös osaava HR-tiimi, joka huolehtii vuokratyöntekijöiden työsuhdeasioista, sopimuksista ja henkilöstöhallinnon käytännöistä. Kansainvälisestä rekrytoinnista vastaava Julia auttaa puolestaan löytämään osaajia myös Suomen rajojen ulkopuolelta, joten pystyt tarjoamaan asiakkaillesi ratkaisuja entistä laajemmin. Näin voit keskittyä siihen, missä tuotat eniten arvoa: asiakassuhteiden rakentamiseen ja ratkaisujen myyntiin.

Lisäksi tarjoamme:

  • mahdollisuuden osallistua yritystoiminnan kehittämiseen
  • laajennetun työterveyden Mehiläisessä
  • huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön ja tekemisen meiningin
  • vaihtelevan työn, jossa yksikään päivä ei ole täysin samanlainen
  • reilun palkkauksen (pohjapalkka 4000 – 5000 e/kk + kuukausittainen provisio).

Aloitus sopimuksen mukaan.

Toimistomme sijaitsee keskustassa hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella osoitteessa Maariankatu 2, 20100 Turku. Käytössämme on myös Gatorade Center esimerkiksi asiakastilaisuuksia ja työhaastatteluja varten.


Kiinnostuitko? Valitse alta mieluisin tapa lähestyä:

  • Hae paikkaa linkin kautta:
  • Laita CV ja vapaamuotoinen hakemus osoitteeseen: juha.oksanen@hunajaworks.fi
  • Soita Juhalle numeroon +358 40 094 6007

HUNAJA WORKS ON REKRYTOINNIN AMMATTILAINEN

Tarjoamme monipuolisia työmahdollisuuksia eri aloilta ympäri Suomen. Autamme sinua löytämään työn, joka tukee arkeasi ja tavoitteitasi.

Tarjolla on mahdollisuuksia eri aloilta ympäri Suomen – olipa haussa uusi suunta tai joustavampi arki.

Meille on tärkeää, että työn hakeminen ja tekeminen on selkeää ja toimivaa alusta loppuun. Haluamme, että löydät työn, jossa viihdyt ja pääset hyödyntämään osaamistasi.

Toimimme laajasti eri aloilla, kuten palvelu- ja asiantuntijatehtävissä, teollisuudessa, rakentamisessa ja logistiikassa.

Teemme yhteistyötä HC TPS:n kanssa ja tuomme sitä kautta työntekijöillemme myös elämyksiä työn ulkopuolelle.
