title: Senior Security Engineer - Threat Detection
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara Security is looking for a Senior Threat Detection Engineer. This is a hands-on engineering role: you will build and operate the signals, pipelines, and tooling that power how we discover threats against Samsara and our customers.

The Threat Detection team owns the detection platform end to end — the data pipelines that feed it, the detection content that runs on it, the CI/CD that ships it, and the AI-assisted tooling that scales what a small team can cover. You will write detections, and you will also build the machinery that makes the next detection faster to develop, safer to deploy, and measurable in production.

You will report to the Director of Threat Detection and Response and work closely with Security Operations, Application Security, and Enterprise Security, as well as engineering teams across the company.

We are looking for someone who takes projects from idea to proof-of-concept to production, who is comfortable being the first person to build something, and who is genuinely interested in what AI can and cannot do for detection engineering — including where it introduces risk rather than removing it.

This role is open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Build, deploy, and continuously improve MITRE ATT&CK–aligned detections across cloud, endpoint, identity, email, and application telemetry, with clear false-positive thresholds.
  • Own the full detection lifecycle—from hypothesis, data validation, and baselining through deployment, tuning, validation, and retirement.
  • Advance our detection-as-code platform through version control, peer review, automated testing, CI/CD, and improved pipeline reliability and observability.
  • Identify emerging threat surfaces and build integrations that strengthen data ingestion, enrichment, and coverage across internal and third-party systems.
  • Evaluate AI-powered security capabilities, including secure MCP integrations, threat hunting, anomaly detection, and response automation.
  • Turn threat intelligence into actionable detection and retrospective scanning.
  • Partner closely with Security Operations during investigations, incidents, table top exercises, detection maintenance, and code pairing.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 6+ years in security engineering, detection engineering, or a related technology discipline.
  • Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience analyzing large datasets to build and validate detections.
  • Hands-on experience with detection-as-code, Git-based workflows, automated testing, and CI/CD deployment.
  • Deep experience with modern SIEM platforms, including data onboarding, advanced queries, dashboards, and threat intelligence enrichment.
  • Working knowledge of AWS, Linux, containers, and EDR.
  • Proven ability to build systems from scratch, lead projects independently, learn new technologies quickly, and communicate technical concepts clearly through documentation, RFCs, and presentations.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience with data orchestration platforms such as Airflow or Databricks.
  • Applied experience with LLMs, agentic frameworks, and MCP integrations, including their security risks and failure modes.
  • Experience with behavioral analytics, anomaly detection, feature engineering, and model evaluation.
  • Familiarity with risk-based alerting, ChatOps, distributed alerting, and attack simulation.
  • Additional experience with Go, Terraform, malware analysis, digital forensics, or FedRAMP environments.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. title: Senior Product Builder
description:
Mission

Integral was founded in October 2024 and is already one of the fastest-growing startups in Germany. We're building the leading AI-native platform for accounting, payroll, and tax for European SMEs, and we're looking for the sharpest people to help us get there.

As Senior Product Builder, you own a core area of the product end to end. You work alongside top-tier engineers and build with them: you write specs, prototype ideas, and ship, using AI tools the way an engineer does.

You sit with users, find what slows them down, and give them that time back. The domain is complex and heavily regulated, so getting it right means holding several things at once: what the user needs, how Ops works today, and what the rules demand. AI makes a product like this possible. The bar is whether it's genuinely good for the people who use it.

You work in a small team, close to the founders. Onsite in our Berlin Prenzlauer Berg office.


Core Responsibilities

  • Build, not just decide. Prototype your ideas, ship features with engineering, and stay close enough to the code to make real product calls.

  • Learn the domain cold. Sit with accountants, watch how the work actually happens, and learn German bookkeeping well enough to know what "correct" means before you build it.

  • Get the workflows right. Accounting and payroll have to be correct, auditable, and traceable. You set that bar and check it against real client data.

  • Decide how AI fits. Work out what AI can own today, what stays with a person, and how that line moves as models improve. Design workflows that get better as the technology does.

  • Free people from the grunt work. Turn today's manual steps into agents that handle them, cut exception handling, shorten time to close, and measure the hours saved.

  • Own your area. Discovery, prioritisation, release, iteration. You call what ships and when.

What makes it special:

  • You build a product area that sits at the center of what Integral does, and you actually build it.

  • You work directly with the CTO and a senior engineering team that ships fast and cares about craft.

  • You're early enough that the big product decisions are still open.

  • Your work reaches thousands of business founders who run their finances on Integral.


Your Profile

  • You build. You prototype your own ideas, you can take them most of the way yourself, and you'd rather ship a rough version than write a long doc about it.

  • You use AI tools effectively, to build and not just to chat, or you're hungry to learn.

  • You've taken products from 0 to 1 and know what that actually takes.

  • You move on your own, think in systems, and bring clarity to messy domains.

  • You hold a high bar without chasing perfection. You ship, learn, and improve.

  • You're fluent in German and English.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in fintech, or building software for accounting, payroll, banking, or other money-movement domains.

  • A track record with genuinely complex systems: lots of state, edge cases, and integrations, where getting the details wrong has real consequences.

  • A working feel for German tax and regulatory requirements for small businesses.


The Hiring Process

We move fast. The full process takes less than two weeks.

  1. Intro call with a member of our team

  2. Meeting Lukas, our co-founder and hiring manager

  3. Take-home case study with 5 days turnaround time

  4. On-site in Berlin: meet the team, work through the case study together, meet Anil and an office tour

  5. Reference calls


Our Offer

  • Above-market salary

  • Direct line to the Founders: no filter, no queue, no committee

  • Total autonomy on what you build; we measure hours saved

  • The best tools, no questions asked: Claude Max, Cursor, OpenAI, whatever ships next week

  • Internal tools and resources purpose-built to support agentic AI development at scale, read about how we work at

  • 28 vacation days per year, plus half-days on December 24 and 31

  • Urban Sports Club membership, Sachbezug to over 200+ partner companies, or Deutschlandticket

  • Laptop of your choice: MacBook Pro or Windows

  • Company pension scheme (bAV)

  • Modern office in the heart of Berlin Mitte, right next to Mauerpark

  • Weekly team lunches on us, office BBQs, and a dinner budget for late nights

  • A team of 50+ (and growing!) ambitious, diverse people, 20%+ ex-founders learning and building together

We value diversity and hire people based on their abilities and capabilities to succeed in this role. We welcome people of every background, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status, political belief or marital status.

title: Huoltamokahvilatyöntekijä, Kangasala
description:
Etsimme asiakasyrityksellemme energistä ja asiakaspalvelusta innostuvaa huoltamokahvilatyöntekijää Kangasalalle noin 6 kuukauden määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen. Työaikaa on tarjolla 60 tuntia / 3 viikkoa.

Viihdytkö siellä, missä tapahtuu?

Saatko energiaa ihmisten kohtaamisesta, nautit vaihtelevista työpäivistä ja tykkäät pitää monta palloa ilmassa? Haluatko nähdä oman kädenjälkesi ja olla mukana luomassa asiakkaille mukavia kohtaamisia? Jos vastasit kyllä, saatat olla etsimämme tekijä!

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

Päiväsi koostuvat monipuolisista kahvilan ja asiakaspalvelun tehtävistä. Työhösi kuuluu esimerkiksi:

  • Iloinen ja sujuva asiakaspalvelu
  • Kassatyöskentely
  • Vitriinin täyttäminen ja houkuttelevasta esillepanosta huolehtiminen
  • Kahvien ja vitriinituotteiden valmistaminen
  • Kahvilan siisteydestä ja laadukkaasta asiakaskokemuksesta huolehtiminen

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

  • Monipuolisen ja vaihtelevan työn vauhdikkaassa ympäristössä
  • Mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi osaavan tiimin tukemana
  • Rennon ja kannustavan työyhteisön, jossa viihdytään yhdessä
  • Määräaikaisen työn, jossa yksikään päivä ei ole samanlainen

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

  • Alan koulutusta ja/tai aiempaa kokemusta vastaavista työtehtävistä
  • Reipasta, oma-aloitteista ja vastuullista työotetta
  • Aitoa asiakaspalveluasennetta ja positiivista energiaa
  • Hygieniapassia
  • Hyvää suomen kielen taitoa

Jos tunnistit itsesi kuvauksesta, lähetä hakemuksesi pian – paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Tule mukaan tekemään asiakkaiden päivästä hieman parempi, kuppi kahvia kerrallaan!

Työ alkavat sopivan henkilön löydyttyä ja työllistyt Amikon kirjoille osa-aikaiseen työsuhteeseen. Työlle on mahdollisuus saada jatkoa. Työtunteja on tarjolla keskimääräisesti 60 h/3vko. Työvuorot sijoittuvat, niin ilta- kun aamuvuoroihinkin. Palkkaus 12,21–13,58 € h ja määrittämisessä otetaan huomioon aikaisempi kokemus ja koulutuksesi.

Kolahtiko?

Kuulostaa hyvältä, mutta miksi hakisin töitä juuri Amikon kautta?

Amiko tarjoaa kaiken tasoisille ammattilaisille laajan valikoiman töitä. Olemme sinulle reilu, luotettava ja joustava työelämän kumppani. Amikolla on hyvä maine työmarkkinoilla. Pyrimme aina etsimään parhaat mahdolliset ratkaisut työllistymisesi tueksi. Amikolaisena saat:

• Vähintään TES:in mukaisen palkkauksen-palkkausjärjestelmämme on kannustava, joskus jopa suurempi kuin työllistyessä suoraan yrityksen palkkalistoille.

• Laajasti erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia- meillä on kattavat verkostot ja laaja työpaikkavalikoimaniin osa-aikaisia, kokopäiväisiä kuin sesonkitöitä monelta eri alalta. Kun sopiva työ löytyy, monille tarjoutuu myös mahdollisuus siirtyä vakituiseksi työntekijäksi asiakasyritykseen.

• Oman yhteyshenkilön ja yksilöllistä työnhakua – Amikolta saat henkilökohtaista palvelua ja oman tutun yhteyshenkilön, johon voit olla suoraan yhteydessä.

• Kattavat työterveyspalvelut, normaalin eläkekertymän ja sairausajan palkan sairauden sattuessa – Vaikka teetkin työsi asiakasyrityksessämme, olet amikolainen ja kannamme sinusta vastuun ja huolehdimme eduistasi.

• … vai kenties jotain ihan uutta urallesi? Autamme myös alanvaihdossa. Räätälöidyt uravalmennukset auttavat päivittämään osaamistasi ja löytämään uuden suunnan urallasi.

Voisiko tässä olla sinulle uusi työpaikka?

Toimimme asiakkaallemme rekrytointikumppanina, käsittelemme saapuvat työhakemukset sekä vastaamme ensimmäisen vaiheen haastatteluista. Jätäthän hakemuksesi pikimmiten tai soita Amikon Terhille p. 0504076747 ja nappaa itsellesi uusi huippuduuni!

Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivien henkilön löydyttyä.

Huomioithan, että emme käsittele sähköpostitse vastaanotettuja hakemuksia vaan jätäthän hakemuksen nettisivujemme kautta tietosuojasyistä.

Please note that we do not process applications submitted by e-mail, so please submit your application via our website for privacy and data protection reasons.

Kotihoidossa tarjoat asiakkaillesi turvaa, hoivaa ja vastuullista läsnäoloa heidän omassa kodissaan. Pääset työskentelemään vaihtelevissa ympäristöissä, ja toteutat asiakkaan kokonaisvaltaista hoitotyötä yhdessä asiakkaan, omaisten ja moniammatillisen työyhteisön kanssa. Työssäsi korostat asiakkaiden voimavarojen vahvistamista, osallisuuden tukemista sekä kuntouttavaa työotetta.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Saat merkityksellisen työn, jossa olet tärkeässä roolissa asiakkaidemme arjessa. Mukana kulkee moniammatillinen ja kannustava tiimi, jonka kanssa et jää yksin. Pääset kehittämään ammattitaitoasi monipuolisissa hoitotyön tehtävissä ja saat hyvän perehdytyksen sekä jatkuvaa tukea. Lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus vaikuttaa työvuorosuunnitteluun.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Arvostamme hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja, joustavaa ja positiivista työotetta sekä kykyä sopeutua muuttuviin tilanteisiin ja toimia itsenäisesti. Työssäsi tarvitset hyvää suomen kielen taitoa. Tehtävä edellyttää ajokorttia ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta.

Eduksi katsomme voimassa olevan LOVe-lääkeluvan, työkokemuksen ikääntyneiden palveluista, RAI-arviointimittariston tuntemuksen ja hyvät tietotekniset taidot.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon ammatillinen perustutkinto (lähihoitaja) tai alan aikaisempi kouluasteinen tutkinto sekä voimassa oleva rekisteröinti JulkiTerhikki- ja JulkiSuosikki-rekisterissä.Tehtävää täytettäessä huomioimme myös lähihoitajaopiskelijat, joilla on vähintään 120op suoritettuna sekä sairaanhoitajaopiskelijat, joilla on vähintään 90op suoritettuna.

Kiinnostuitko? Hae pian, etenemme rekrytoinnissa jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävän sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Required

  • Experience using AI agents in software development.

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

title: Verpleegkundige - 24 tot 36 uur
description:
Voor De Baton, de nieuwste woonzorglocatie van Saffier in Den Haag, zijn wij op zoek naar meerdere verpleegkundigen. De Baton biedt een warm thuis aan mensen met dementie en beschikt daarnaast over een afdeling Screening Gesloten Herstel.

De locatie is inmiddels geopend en volop in ontwikkeling. Dat betekent dat je niet alleen goede zorg verleent, maar ook meedenkt over hoe we de zorg, samenwerking en kwaliteit iedere dag verder kunnen verbeteren. Samen met je collega's zorg je voor een veilige, warme en prettige leefomgeving, waarin bewoners zich thuis voelen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als verpleegkundige werk je met bewoners met psychogeriatrische en/of somatische zorgvragen, waaronder ook bewoners op de afdeling Screening Gesloten Herstel. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het coördineren, uitvoeren en bewaken van de verpleegkundige zorg en hebt een signalerende rol bij complexe zorg- en gedragsvraagstukken.

Je observeert, analyseert en rapporteert veranderingen in de gezondheid en het gedrag van bewoners en vertaalt deze naar passende zorginterventies. Je voert verpleegtechnische handelingen uit, stelt (mede) zorgdoelen op en draagt actief bij aan het evalueren en bijstellen van het zorgleefplan. Daarnaast stem je nauw af met collega-verpleegkundigen, verzorgenden, (woon)zorgcoördinatoren en behandelaren. Met jouw deskundigheid, klinische blik en rust zorg je voor veilige, persoonsgerichte zorg en draag je bij aan een prettig en stabiel leefklimaat voor bewoners.

Waar ga je werken?

De Baton is de nieuwste woonzorglocatie van Saffier in Den Haag Zuidwest. In deze moderne locatie wonen 136 mensen met dementie in kleinschalige woongroepen van 11 tot 12 bewoners. De warme inrichting, ruime gezamenlijke woonkamers en slimme technologie zorgen voor een veilige, huiselijke omgeving waar bewoners zich zo vrij mogelijk kunnen bewegen.

Wat werken in De Baton bijzonder maakt, is dat je onderdeel wordt van een nieuwe locatie waar alles nog volop in ontwikkeling is. Je krijgt de kans om mee te bouwen aan een hecht team, nieuwe werkafspraken en toekomstgerichte dementiezorg. Samen creëren we een plek waar bewoners zich thuis voelen en waar medewerkers de ruimte krijgen om mee te denken, initiatief te nemen en zich verder te ontwikkelen.

De Baton ligt in de Haagse wijk Bouwlust/Vrederust, dichtbij het Westland en goed bereikbaar met zowel de auto als het openbaar vervoer (bus 25 en tram 4).

Past dit bij jou

  • Je hebt een mbo- of hbo-diploma Verpleegkunde en bent BIG-geregistreerd

  • Je voelt je verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit en continuïteit van zorg

  • Je bent een inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor collega’s en denkt mee in het zorgproces

  • Je werkt graag samen in een multidisciplinair team

  • Je hebt affiniteit met PG, somatiek en/of onbegrepen gedrag

Wat levert het je op

  • Salaris in FWG 45 cao VVT, tot max. €4.245,84 bruto per maand bij een 36-urige werkweek

  • Je hebt recht op een toeslag als je onregelmatige diensten werkt (ORT). De percentages zijn afhankelijk van je uurloon en het moment waarop je een ORT-dienst draait, variërend van 22% tot 60%

  • Pensioenopbouw bij Pensioenfonds Zorg & Welzijn, 8% vakantietoeslag en 8,33% eindejaarstoeslag

  • Persoonlijk opleidings- en ontwikkelingsplan

  • Saffier heeft een actieve personeelsvereniging waar je automatisch gratis lid van bent

  • Wij stimuleren gezondheid en vitaliteit. Op elke werkplek is gratis fruit voorhanden en je kunt als medewerker korting krijgen op de aanschaf van een fiets, eigen telefoon, tablet, laptop, wellness bon of sportschoolabonnement

Meer informatie

Voor meer informatie over de functie, kun je contact opnemen met Teammanager Connie Roomer via 06-57 53 69 13

title: Lead Software Engineer (Point of Sales)
description:
This role exists to provide senior technical leadership that solves complex challenges, supports the development of engineering talent, and delivers high-quality web solutions aligned with the organization’s business objective.

  • Awareness of emerging technologies and platforms in areas such as Cloud, Analytics, GenAI, and automation, with a strong self-driven mindset for continuous learning.

  • Prior experience in the financial services industry and/or working within highly regulated environments is an advantage.
  • Cloud platform experience and/or relevant cloud certifications are an advantage.
  • Strong teamwork, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with stakeholders.

How you succeed

  • Take accountability of business and regulatory compliance risks, implementing measures to mitigate them effectively.
  • Keep abreast with industry trends, regulatory compliance, and emerging threats and technologies to understand and highlight potential concerns/ risks to safeguard our company proactively.

Who we are

Founded in 1908, Great Eastern is a well-established market leader and trusted brand in Singapore and Malaysia. With over S$100 billion in assets and more than 16 million policyholders, including 12.5 million from government schemes, it provides insurance solutions to customers through three successful distribution channels – a tied agency force, bancassurance, and financial advisory firm Great Eastern Financial Advisers. The Group also operates in Indonesia and Brunei.

The Great Eastern Life Assurance Company Limited and Great Eastern General Insurance Limited have been assigned the financial strength and counterparty credit ratings of "AA-" by S&P Global Ratings since 2010, one of the highest among Asian life insurance companies. Great Eastern's asset management subsidiary, Lion Global Investors Limited, is one of the leading asset management companies in Southeast Asia.

Great Eastern is a subsidiary of OCBC, the longest established Singapore bank, formed in 1932. It is the second largest financial services group in Southeast Asia by assets and one of the world’s most highly-rated banks, with an Aa1 rating from Moody’s and AA- by both Fitch and S&P. Recognised for its financial strength and stability, OCBC is consistently ranked among the World’s Top 50 Safest Banks by Global Finance and has been named Best Managed Bank in Singapore by The Asian Banker.

title: Data Engineer III, AWS Marketplace Demand Generation & Lifecycle Engagement
description:
This is a foundational hire — you will be the first dedicated data engineer on a data science team embedded within the B2B Marketing organization of AWS Marketplace. You will own the data infrastructure that powers marketing intelligence systems: ML scoring engines that decide which customers to reach, auto-nurture pipelines that personalize outreach at scale, attribution models that connect marketing activity to revenue, and customer economics frameworks that predict lifetime value. The groundwork has been laid over two years with production ML models and live pipelines already in place. What comes next is yours to define — there is significant room to shape the architecture, set standards, and make decisions that determine how data infrastructure evolves on this team.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and operate production data pipelines that serve ML models and analytics — including feature engineering, model scoring infrastructure, output delivery, and data quality enforcement.
- Define and own the team's data architecture, making trade-offs between speed and durability, cost and scalability, and short-term delivery versus long-term maintainability.
- Build and maintain analytical datasets that stitch together product activity, marketing engagement, customer transactions, and revenue data into query-ready models that enable analysis not previously possible.
- Produce well-documented, maintainable code built for others to extend — establish patterns and templates that raise the quality bar for all data work on the team.
- Partner with data scientists, marketers, and cross-functional engineering teams to gather requirements, define data contracts, influence upstream data producers, and ensure downstream consumers can self-serve.

A day in the life
Your scope spans the full ML lifecycle: ingestion from multiple data platforms, feature engineering for model training, production pipeline deployment, model output delivery, and the reporting layer that makes it all consumable. Some problems are well-scoped and need execution; others are ambiguous and need you to define the path. You will wear multiple hats — data modeling, pipeline engineering, infrastructure automation, and partnering directly with data scientists on systems that are genuinely new.

About the team
We are a data science team within the B2B Marketing organization of AWS Marketplace — AWS's digital catalog where customers discover, evaluate, and purchase third-party software. We build measurement, targeting, and intelligence systems that power marketing decisions: multi-touch attribution models, ML-powered targeting engines, customer unit economics frameworks, experimentation platforms, and partner intelligence systems. Our aspiration is to build an end-to-end intelligent B2B marketing platform where data science and AI are at the core of every decision. Because you will work shoulder-to-shoulder with data scientists building production AI systems, this role is a natural path to deepen your expertise in data science and machine learning — understanding not just how to move data, but how models consume it and how engineering decisions shape AI outcomes. If you want to help build something at the frontier of AI-powered B2B marketing alongside a collaborative, technically rigorous team, this is where to do it.

title: Games Security Specialist
description:
#### Company Description

Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming with teams across the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin’s Creed, Rainbow Six to Just Dance and more. We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you’re passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help create the unknown!

#### Job Description

As a Games Security Specialist at Ubisoft Montréal, you will be fully embedded on For Honor as the owner and executor of the Player Protection domain for the project. This is a single‑project role, focused on protecting fair play and community health within For Honor’s live environment.

You will work hands‑on with production, online, data, moderation, and security partners to identify issues, coordinate responses, and drive concrete mitigation actions related to cheating, exploitation, matchmaking abuse, toxicity, ban evasion, and account‑related abuse . This role emphasizes execution, follow‑through, and operational impact, not just reporting or strategy definition.

**What you’ll do**

- Drive and execute player protection actions for For Honor, from issue identification to mitigation and validation
- Coordinate and implement anti‑cheat and anti‑exploitation measures, ensuring fixes are tested and effective
- Analyze and address matchmaking abuse, ban evasion, and repeat offenses impacting competitive integrity
- Lead operational responses to toxicity and abusive behaviors, in collaboration with moderation and support teams
- Orchestrate incident triage and intervention, including sanctions, fixes, and follow‑up actions
- Maintain and apply intervention playbooks and decision matrices to ensure fair, consistent outcomes
- Track player protection risks, trends, and outcomes, and adjust actions based on live data
- Act as the day‑to‑day player protection point of contact for the For Honor team
- Raise awareness of security, fairness, and player experience trade‑offs during production decisions
- Contribute to continuous improvement through threat monitoring and post‑incident reviews

#### Qualifications

**What you bring to the team**

- Knowledge or awareness of online games or live operations involving security, trust and safety, anti‑cheat, or moderation
- Ability to execute and follow through on cross‑team actions in live environments
- Solid understanding of game security risks, abuse patterns, and exploitation vectors
- A player‑centric mindset that balances fairness, consistency, and community health
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Comfort working with data, dashboards, and signals to support operational decisions
- Ability to document findings, decisions, and outcomes in clear, accurate, and shareable formats
- A collaborative approach and respect for diverse perspectives

description:
Een station dat moet blijven draaien, er dreigt een grote storing en jij staat er alleen voor. Dat klinkt misschien spannend, maar jij vindt dat juist een toffe uitdaging! Lees snel verder en solliciteer op de functie van E-Servicemonteur Treinstations!

Als E-Servicemonteur Treinstations krijg je bij TES Groep:

Voorwaarden volgens de CAO voor het technische installatiebedrijf én een salaris dat bij jouw kennis en ervaring past.

• En verder:

• Bovenop je normale salaris € 285 bruto stand-by-vergoeding;

• Interne opleidingen en certificaten (bijv. NEN3140, NEN1010, VCA);

• Doorgroeimogelijkheden naar eerste servicemonteur of andere posities binnen TES;

• Personeelsactiviteiten, Sinterklaasviering, (sport-)evenementen, etc.

Als E-Servicemonteur Treinstations:

Werk je aan de elektrotechnische installaties van treinstations door heel Nederland. Je gaat zelfstandig op pad, onderzoekt storingen en zorgt dat ze worden opgelost. Soms is de oplossing simpel en gaat het vooral om een belangrijke montageklus. Op andere momenten moet je echt op onderzoek uit: eerst denken, dan doen!

Hoewel je zelfstandig werkt, sta je er nooit alleen voor. Binnen het serviceteam helpen collega’s elkaar en delen ze kennis. Sta je voor een lastige storing? Dan is er altijd iemand die met je meedenkt!

Jouw werkzaamheden:

• Het opsporen en oplossen van elektrotechnische storingen;

• Uitvoeren van reparaties en onderhoud;

• Controleren en testen van installaties;

• Zelfstandig beoordelen wat nodig is om een storing op te lossen;

• Werken volgens strikte veiligheids- en werkprocedures;

• Je werkzaamheden en bevindingen administratief bijhouden.

Jij past bij TES als je:

• In bezit bent van een mbo-diploma Elektrotechniek;

• Minimaal twee jaar ervaring hebt als servicemonteur;

• Eerst nadenkt voordat je handelt en veiligheid altijd serieus neemt;

• Het leuk vindt om in een (soms) hectische omgeving te werken;

• Doorzet wanneer een storing niet direct gevonden is.


Wij zijn TES Groep:

Een full-service installatiebedrijf met ongeveer 170 medewerkers. Vanuit verschillende disciplines werken wij aan elektrotechnische totaaloplossingen voor uiteenlopende opdrachtgevers. Van ontwerp en realisatie tot service, onderhoud en inspectie: TES is betrokken bij de volledige levenscyclus van installaties.

Wij werken onder andere voor overheden, onderwijsinstellingen, gemeenten, retail, bouwbedrijven en zorginstellingen. TES besteedt veel aandacht aan de mens én diens individuele ontwikkeling: opleidingen, ontwikkeling, doorgroei en het delen van kennis. Samen brengen we techniek tot leven!


Klaar voor je volgende stap?

Bij TES werk je niet alleen aan installaties, maar ook aan je eigen ontwikkeling. Zo kun je bijvoorbeeld doorgroeien naar eerste servicemonteur.

Met volop mogelijkheden voor technische opleidingen en specialistische certificeringen zoals SCIOS Scope, KNX, brandmeld- en beveiligingstechniek (MBV/TBV), NEN 3140 en NEN 1010 blijf jij bouwen aan je toekomst!

Voor TES weegt ervaring en de juiste instelling zwaarder dan alleen een diploma. Vind jij het mooi dat jij degene bent die de storing oplost? Solliciteer dan direct of neem contact op met Sanne Becht van Forp, via 06 58 88 46 48 of sanne@forp.nl. Twijfel je of deze functie bij je past? Bel of app Sanne gerust even, een cv is niet direct nodig.

title: Transportation Audit & Compliance Specialist, Transportation Risk and Compliance (TRC)
description:
** This role can be based from: Berlin, Munich, Paris, Milan, Luxembourg, Gdansk, Iasi or London



Amazon is the most customer-centric company on Earth. We need exceptionally talented, customer-centric, bright, and driven people. We are looking for an organized self-starter to join the Transportation Risk and Compliance (TRC) team at Amazon. This position will be based out of an Amazon corporate office, and may require to travel periodically.

Amazon Transportation Services have built world-class Middle Mile operations, which rely on an exceptional pool of carriers who work relentlessly to meet our customers’ expectations. TRC is looking for a high-judgment individual to join us as an Audit & Compliance Specialist to assess carriers’ compliance against contractual and legal requirements, and drive a compliance culture both internally and externally.

We are looking for an individual with technical abilities (e.g., Python, SQL, VBA, AI agents and workflows, etc.) and audit / compliance experience, preferably in transport. The candidate will apply their knowledge to 1) conduct and manage carrier audits, identifying legal, financial, and reputational risks, and proposing risk-mitigation solutions, 2) deliver detailed finding and recommendation reports for both carriers and business teams (e.g., carrier management teams, Legal), and 3) semi/automate and/or launch new audit workstreams, driving efficiencies and expansions. The successful candidate will have excellent attention to details aptitudes, data/tech-driven mindset and capabilities, and good soft skills for building trustworthy relationships with peers, stakeholders, and carriers. Finally, the successful candidate will display good team spirit and autonomy.

If you wish to innovate on behalf of customers, are passionate about driving compliance, improving processes, reducing risks, and making an impact on society, come join our team and make history!

Key job responsibilities
• Audit carriers to verify that they operate compliantly with contractual, and regulatory requirements
• Provide precise audit reports to carriers and internal management teams, with clear finding details, and actionable short/mid/long-term corrective and preventative action items, thus helping them achieve and maintain compliance requirements
• Semi/automate audit workstreams, leveraging e.g., AI, Python, SQL, etc.
• Launch new audit workstreams in line with business and legal demands
• Manage escalations by triaging, investigating, and resolving carrier escalations, coordinating with internal stakeholders and leadership to drive timely resolution
• Lead and/or participate in special projects and/or assignments as necessary

A day in the life
There are no two days completely alike in this role, but most will include:
1. Conducting and/or managing audits, working collaboratively with e.g., Global Solutions Risk and Compliance, Legal, and Carrier Operations
2. Delivering audit reports, inclusive of compliance-driving recommendations
3. Attending team and stakeholder meetings to drive a compliance culture in and out of the organization
4. Supporting carriers with their compliance questions or doubts
5. Semi/automating audit workstreams to gain speed and quality
6. Diving into new transportation programs and launching associated new audit workstreams


About the team
TRC’s mission is to empower Amazon’s transportation business and its partners to do the right thing for the community at large, with a vision to inform decision-making that drives business growth through world-class scalable risk management solutions. Through ongoing compliance monitoring and risk management activities, we provide transportation leaders with the data they need to make informed risk management decisions.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead documentation improvement initiatives across the team's reporting estate, building a documentation baseline that includes a dataset catalog, dashboard inventory, and runbooks
- Coordinate and track open migration items across teams, maintaining a named owner and a target date for each item through to completion
- Support the expanding scope and clean-up of data quality metrics spanning transportation, warehousing, and sustainability
- Help build self-serve data quality tooling so teams can answer their own data quality questions across operational domains
- Manage and track data quality issue resolution across various platforms
- Support business intelligence and data analytics projects, including data preparation for recurring business reviews
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to update and maintain knowledge management systems
- Assist with reporting system configurations, access management, and operational support
- Support the retirement of legacy data infrastructure through inventory building and decommissioning coordination

A day in the life
You start with the migration tracker: what moved, what is blocked, and who owes the next step. Mid-morning you join the BI team sync, then follow up with the engineers on both sides of the migration to close out open items. Afternoons go deeper: documenting a dataset or dashboard, investigating a data quality issue raised by a stakeholder, or preparing data for an upcoming business review. You end most days having written something down that the team will still use after your internship ends.

About the team
AWS Cloud Logistics (ACL) manages a continuously evolving portfolio of shipments through a worldwide supply chain. We deliver the right product at the right time, cost, and place - ensuring our AWS supply chain is reliable. You will work in a fast-paced environment where your contributions will have direct impact on operational efficiency and customer experience. Our team values builders who write things down, simplify complexity, and leave processes better than they found them.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

What makes RightShip a great place to work at:

RightShip is an equal opportunity employer, and we champion diversity. Our teams are composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities, and generations. We believe that a diversity of experiences makes us stronger—as individuals, as communities and as an organization.

Don’t meet every single requirement of this role? Still apply! Research tells us that that women and underrepresented groups are less likely to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At RightShip we believe that the right hire is someone who makes an addition to our culture, rather than someone who fits in and conforms to our status quo. We want to add team members who not only value RightShip standards and workplace culture, but also bring an aspect of diversity that positively contributes to our work environment. If you are excited about this role, or about our company in general, we would love to hear from you!

We are growing the AI capability within our Product team and are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join us in London.

This is an applied, experimental role that sits inside the Product team rather than a central engineering function. You will work directly with Product Managers to understand the problems our customers face, shape those problems into candidate AI solutions, and prove or disprove them quickly through prototypes, experiments and rigorous evaluation. What works, you carry through to production-ready code, with the tests, evals and documentation our engineering teams need to take it on and run it at scale.

You will work across LLM-based applications, agentic systems and retrieval over structured and unstructured maritime data, primarily on Azure and Databricks, and you will help set how the AI team builds, evaluates and hands over AI at RightShip. A large part of the job is working out what is worth building, so you should be comfortable with ambiguity and confident recommending that an approach is dropped when the evidence says so.

Major Responsibilities

  • Work directly with Product Managers to gather and refine requirements, and translate them into candidate AI solutions with clear success criteria and evaluation plans.
  • Rapidly prototype and experiment with LLM-based applications, agents and retrieval pipelines to establish whether an idea works before it is committed to the roadmap.
  • Propose and document solution architectures, covering model choice, orchestration, data access, guardrails, and cost and latency trade-offs.
  • Design and build AI evaluation suites, offline and online, that define what good looks like for each feature and can be run in production to monitor quality over time.
  • Produce production-ready code with tests, evals, documentation and observability, hand it over to the engineering teams for productionisation, and support them through that transition.
  • Build and maintain retrieval and embedding pipelines over maritime data such as inspection reports, vessel records, documents and the RightShip knowledge graph.
  • Apply Responsible AI practice: traceability, guardrails, assessment of failure modes and bias, and alignment with RightShip's AI risk management framework.
  • Present experimental results and recommendations clearly to product, engineering and senior stakeholders.
  • Contribute to the AI team's shared tooling, patterns and standards; review code and share knowledge with colleagues.
  • Keep abreast of developments in models, agent frameworks and evaluation methods, and assess which are worth adopting.

Qualifications, Skills & Experience

Essential

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of hands-on AI/ML or software engineering experience, including LLM-based applications that have reached production.
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals: testing, packaging, version control, code review and CI.
  • Demonstrated experience building agentic systems and RAG pipelines with LangGraph (and LangChain or similar), including tool use, state management and structured outputs.
  • Experience designing and running LLM evaluations: building evaluation datasets, choosing metrics, LLM-as-judge, regression testing and monitoring quality in production.
  • Practical knowledge of embeddings, vector search and hybrid retrieval.
  • Experience deploying AI workloads on Azure, for example Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry, Azure AI Search and Functions or Container Apps.
  • Comfortable working in an experimental setting where requirements are loosely defined and part of the job is working out what to build.
  • Excellent communication skills, including explaining technical trade-offs to non-technical colleagues.

Desirable

  • Experience with Databricks (MLflow, Delta Lake, model serving).
  • Solid ML fundamentals; exposure to PyTorch or classical ML is useful but not central to this role.
  • Experience with multi-modal models, particularly document and image understanding.
  • Familiarity with graph databases (Neo4j, Cypher) or knowledge graphs.
  • Experience in maritime, shipping, logistics or another safety- or compliance-driven domain.
  • Open-source contributions or a public portfolio of work.

RightShip is an Equal Opportunity Employer and values diversity, enables access and promotes inclusion in our workplace. You must have the right to live and work in this location to apply for this job.

title: 2nd Shift Production Line Lead
description:
About the Opportunity

We are growing and ramping up production at our Plymouth manufacturing facility and are looking for highly energized, positive, hands-on Production Line Leads who can help build strong, accountable production teams.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a fast-moving manufacturing environment, leading from the floor, developing employees, and using metrics and measurable results to improve daily performance.

Our second shift is especially new and growing, making this a great opportunity for someone who enjoys helping establish routines, expectations, and a strong team culture from the ground up.

The ideal Line Lead is upbeat, organized, solutions-focused, comfortable with change, and able to balance people leadership with production execution.

What You'll Do

As a Production Line Lead, you will help coordinate the people, processes, training, and daily performance of an assigned production line.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Lead and coordinate daily production activities for an assigned line or work area
  • Help ensure production goals are achieved safely, efficiently, and consistently
  • Track and communicate key production metrics and performance measurements, including:
    • Output and production attainment
    • Labor utilization
    • Efficiency and productivity
    • Downtime
    • Waste and rework
    • Quality results
    • Attendance and staffing
    • Training progress
  • Effectively manage and adjust daily employee rosters and line assignments based on production needs, employee skills, attendance, and workflow
  • Ensure the right employees are positioned in the right jobs to support production goals
  • Conduct strong shift starts, communicate priorities, and maintain focus throughout the shift
  • Identify production obstacles and escalate or resolve issues quickly
  • Coach employees on performance expectations and reinforce accountability
  • Maintain a positive, respectful, and highly engaged work environment
  • Support onboarding and training of new and existing employees
  • Use Training Within Industry (TWI), Job Instruction, standardized work, or similar structured training methodologies to help employees learn jobs safely and consistently
  • Verify that employees can demonstrate required job skills before working independently
  • Help maintain and improve training matrices and employee skill records
  • Work closely with production leadership, quality, maintenance, safety, HR, and other departments
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflow, labor utilization, quality, training, and efficiency
  • Reinforce food safety, quality, sanitation, and workplace safety standards
  • Help create a culture where employees understand both what is expected and how their individual performance impacts the larger operation

What We're Looking For

We are looking for individuals who bring energy and leadership to the production floor.

Strong candidates will have:

  • Manufacturing, production, food manufacturing, warehouse, or similar operational experience
  • Previous lead, trainer, team lead, or supervisory experience preferred
  • Strong ability to organize employees and manage changing daily staffing needs
  • Comfort working with production numbers, metrics, dashboards, or other performance measurements
  • Ability to recognize when performance is off target and take appropriate action
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to train employees using clear, repeatable job instruction
  • Strong attention to safety, quality, and operational details
  • Ability to remain organized and positive in a fast-paced environment
  • A willingness to learn, solve problems, and find a way forward when circumstances change
  • Ability to hold people accountable while maintaining a respectful and supportive work environment
  • Basic computer and data-entry skills

1st Shift Language Requirement

For 1st Shift Line Lead positions, fluency in both Spanish and English is required due to the needs of the workforce and the importance of clear communication, training, coaching, and safety instruction.

The Person Who Will Thrive Here

You may be a great fit if you:

  • Like being on the production floor rather than sitting behind a desk
  • Notice when something isn't working and immediately start looking for a solution
  • Enjoy developing people and teaching others how to perform a job correctly
  • Like numbers and want to know whether the team is actually meeting the goal
  • Can organize people quickly when attendance or production demands change
  • Bring positive energy to your team
  • Are comfortable working in an operation that is growing and evolving
  • Understand that standards, measurements, and accountability are essential to successful manufacturing
  • Want an opportunity to help build something, not simply maintain what has always been done

Why Join Us?

Our Plymouth manufacturing operation is growing, and we're building the next stage of our production capability. You'll have the opportunity to directly influence how your team operates, how employees are trained, and how we improve performance as production expands.

If you are energized by people, production, measurable results, and continuous improvement, we'd like to meet you.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager
description:
Location: Bengaluru,Karnataka,India

About Exotel

Exotel is the operating system for business communications in emerging markets.

Every day, our platform powers the calls, messages and Voice AI interactions that connect a Bajaj agent to a customer, a Zomato delivery partner to a household, a HDFC banker to a borrower, and a Bolna voicebot to millions of end users.

We process billions of minutes and messages annually across India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East and Africa. We are the substrate underneath one of the fastest-scaling contact centre and Voice AI ecosystems in the world.



Own the largest surface we run

Voice powers thousands of enterprise deployments including HDFC, RBL and international BFSI accounts, and sits underneath the fastest-growing segment of our business: Voice AI.

It is also the most complex product surface we operate — ExoML APIs, the voice platform, throttling and traffic management, LeadAssist, recording infrastructure, K8S-based enterprise deployments and real-time telephony reliability across geographies.

This role is the product owner for that surface.

You define what gets built, why it matters and how success is measured, in close partnership with our Engineering leadership and the go-to-market team.

If you want an environment where technical depth is respected, product craft is expected, and the roadmap has real revenue and enterprise weight behind it, this is that seat.

What You Will Own

  • Platform strategy and roadmap - outcomes, sequencing, and trade-offs across a 12–18 month horizon. Build ground-up product stories from customer signals, QBR data, competitive analysis and platform reality. You are not processing inbound requests.

  • Platform APIs and payload surface — including AMD, recording status callbacks, disconnectedBy, throttling APIs, and the next generation of programmable platform primitives.

  • Enterprise platform deployments

  • Cross-product platform integrations - with platformbot, CQA, contact centre, and streaming.

  • The developer and enterprise customer experience - including QBR ownership on top 20 accounts and Developer NPS >45 across the API surface.

  • Build ground-up product stories from customer signals, QBR data, competitive analysis, and platform reality — not just processing inbound requests.

What We’re Looking For

We care more about what you have actually owned than your previous title.

You have ideally:

  • Built real systems as an engineer, and now want to own the product decisions behind them.

  • Spent at least 3-4 years operating in technically complex domains — CPaaS, telephony, developer platforms, API-first products, data infrastructure or equivalent.

  • Read system design docs, held your own in a review with a staff engineer, and known when an engineering estimate is soft.

  • Written PRDs engineers actually reference.

  • Done real discovery and built user stories from first principles.

  • Defended prioritisation with data.

  • Taken vague mandates and converted them into executable roadmaps without heavy hand-holding.

  • Committed publicly and held yourself accountable, including to slips.

  • Known when to move fast and when to wait, when to be direct and when to be diplomatic, when to hold a scope and when to renegotiate.



This Role May Be a Strong Fit If You Are

A senior or staff engineer considering a product move. If your technical depth is real and your appetite for product craft is genuine, apply and tell us how you are thinking about the transition. We have seen this path produce some of the best technical PMs in our space.

A product manager from a CPaaS-adjacent developer platform — auth, messaging, payments, analytics infrastructure. The domain-specific telephony knowledge can be built. The platform thinking and API-product craft cannot.



This is probably not the right role if:

  • Your experience is primarily roadmap execution and processing inbound requests.

  • You have not worked in a technically complex domain and do not want to start.

  • You need a well-defined mandate and close supervision to make progress.

Apply to this job

title: Senior data engineer - jhb
description:
Hire Resolve's client is looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join their team in Johannesburg, GP. The Data Engineer will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines to support telecommunications CDR processing, real‑time data ingestion, and analytical workloads. This role requires expertise in data modeling, ETL development, stream processing, and distributed data systems. The ideal candidate will work closely with developers, Dev Ops, and analytics teams to transform raw network data into clean, structured, and query‑ready datasets that power dashboards, machine learning models, and business logic. The candidate will provide technical leadership, optimize data workflows for performance and reliability, and drive best practices in data engineering methodologies.

Responsibilities Build ETL/ELT pipelines for ingesting, cleansing, and transforming CDRs and telecommunications logs from multiple network elements (5 G/4 G/3 G/2 G). Design and maintain real-time data flows using Kafka, Apache Ni Fi, and Apache Flink. Work with large‑scale distributed file systems for batch and streaming ingestion. Integrate and structure data for analytics platforms such as Apache Druid, Hudi, and Superset. Develop CI/CD pipelines for deploying data workflows and transformation logic. Ensure data quality, schema validation and compliance with retention and security policies. Monitor data pipeline health and optimize performance, throughput, and cost efficiency. Write complex and performant queries for data validation, transformation, aggregation, and analytics across relational and distributed platforms. Develop and optimize big data processing workflows in platforms such as Apache Spark, Hive, and Druid. Establish efficient issue tracking and workflow processes, enhancing productivity and collaboration across engineering teams. Implement security best practices and compliance frameworks to safeguard infrastructure, data, and applications from vulnerabilities and threats. Maintain secure role‑based access control mechanisms, encryption strategies, and identity management solutions to protect sensitive data and ensure regulatory compliance. Map data flows from source to transformation to consumption. Design and implement full‑text search and indexing solutions for querying and retrieval of structured and unstructured telecommunications data using Apache tools or similar search engines. Analyze and estimate storage requirements and strategies for large‑scale CDR datasets and real‑time data streams, ensuring optimal resource allocation and scalability across environments. Ensure data integrity and consistency across ingestion, transformation, and storage layers through validation checks, schema enforcement, and robust error‑handling mechanisms. Develop and maintain quality monitoring tools to proactively detect anomalies, missing records, or data corruption across pipelines. Perform other duties as assigned. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. Strong experience in building data pipelines using tools such as Apache Ni Fi, Kafka, Airflow, or similar. Proficiency in SQL, Python, and database administration and management (e.g., Postgre SQL, My SQL). Solid understanding of distributed data systems such as Hive, Hudi, and Spark. Experience with streaming frameworks such as Kafka Streams, Apache Flink, and Apache Beam. Familiarity with data serialization formats such as JSON. Knowledge of SFTP and secure data transfer mechanisms for ingesting remote files. Proficient with Linux environments, shell scripting, and storage systems such as Ceph. Experience with data governance, including data privacy and regulatory compliance (e.g., GDPR) and implementing access control, auditing, and data usage policies. Experience in maintaining a central inventory of data assets, managing metadata, and enabling searchable discovery across structured and unstructured datasets. Experience in data lineage tracking to map data flows, visualize, and track dependencies. Experience with OLAP systems, analytical modelling, columnar databases, and designing/querying multidimensional cubes. Strong problem‑solving skills, ability to work in a fast‑paced environment, and manage multiple projects efficiently. title: Docent vormgevingstheorie / Design
description:
Docent Vormgevingstheorie | Design

Help ontwerpers van de toekomst hun eigen visie te ontwikkelen

Wil jij studenten inspireren om kritisch te kijken, onderzoekend te werken en theorie betekenisvol te verbinden met hun ontwerppraktijk? Als docent Vormgevingstheorie binnen de opleiding Design van de Kunstacademie Maastricht lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan de ontwikkeling van nieuwsgierige makers, onderzoekers en ontwerpers die impact maken op de samenleving.

Over de functie

Binnen de opleiding Design draagt het vak Vormgevingstheorie bij aan de ontwikkeling van een kritische en onderzoekende ontwerphouding. Je biedt studenten theoretische kaders en methodieken die hen ondersteunen bij het verdiepen van hun ontwerppraktijk.

Als docent Vormgevingstheorie:

  • verzorg je inspirerende lessen waarin theorie, actuele ontwerpvraagstukken en het ontwerpproces van studenten samenkomen;

  • begeleid je eindexamenstudenten individueel bij het opzetten, uitvoeren en schrijven van hun onderzoek;

  • schrijf je beoordelingen en neem je deel aan beoordelings- en evaluatiemomenten binnen het eindexamenjaar;

  • werk je nauw samen met ontwerpdocenten en collega's om theorie en praktijk binnen de opleiding te verbinden;

  • draag je actief bij aan de doorontwikkeling en positionering van het vak Vormgevingstheorie binnen het curriculum.

Waarom werken bij Zuyd?

Werken bij Zuyd is bijdragen aan een ambitieuze hogeschool met sterke regionale wortels en een duidelijke blik op de toekomst. Met ruim 14.000 studenten en 30 lectoraten bouwen we elke dag aan onderwijs en onderzoek dat ertoe doet. We geloven in ieders unieke talenten. Het begint met jou - en we doen het samen. Bij Zuyd vind je kleinschalig en persoonlijk onderwijs, een open cultuur en een gedeelde passie voor ontwikkeling. Niet voor niets zijn we in de Keuzegids 2026 uitgeroepen tot beste grote hogeschool van Nederland. Hier krijg je de ruimte om te groeien en impact te maken - voor studenten, het werkveld en de regio.

Het team en de werkomgeving

  • Je maakt deel uit van een bevlogen en betrokken team binnen de opleiding Design van de Kunstacademie Maastricht.

  • Samen met makers, onderzoekers en docenten werk je aan eigentijds en toekomstgericht designonderwijs.

  • Je komt terecht in een inspirerende omgeving met werkplaatsen, ateliers en studio's.

  • De opleiding biedt veel ruimte voor samenwerking, experiment en innovatie.

  • Je werkt midden in het culturele hart van Maastricht.

Wat wij vragen

  • Een afgeronde relevante opleiding op het gebied van design, vormgeving of een vergelijkbare richting.

  • Ervaring als productontwerper binnen een eigen ontwerppraktijk, ontwerpstudio of industriële omgeving.

  • Aantoonbare kennis van vormgevingstheorie en het vermogen deze te koppelen aan actuele ontwerppraktijken.

  • Didactische vaardigheden en ervaring met het begeleiden van studenten in hun ontwikkeling en leerproces.

  • Een onderzoekende, samenwerkingsgerichte houding en de bereidheid om actief bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van onderwijs en opleiding.

Wat wij bieden

  • Het betreft een vacature voor 0,2 fte. We willen beginnen met een jaarcontract.

  • Het salaris is maximaal schaal 11 cao-hbo. Dat betekent een bedrag van minimaal € 4.427,64 en maximaal € 6.677,44 bruto per maand op basis van een fulltime aanstelling.

  • Vakantietoeslag van 8% en eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3%.

  • Ruim aantal vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om hybride te werken.

  • Professionaliserings- en inzetbaarheidsuren en een compleet vitaliteitsaanbod.

title: Superintendent FMD
description:
Ben jij een enthousiaste zeevarende die een afwisselende en uitdagende walbaan zoekt? Of ben je een werktuigbouwkundige die geïnteresseerd is in de scheepvaart? En wil je een bijdrage leveren aan het in goede staat brengen en houden van de Wagenborg vloot? Lees dan snel verder!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Superintendent op de afdeling Fleet Management (FMD) krijg je een aantal schepen onder je hoede. Je zorgt ervoor dat deze schepen in een goede staat zijn. Je zorgt voor (preventief) onderhoud aan je schepen en regelt de noodzakelijke reparaties. Verder zorg je ervoor dat de technische en nautische uitrusting aan boord voldoet aan de gestelde eisen. Je stelt per schip onderhoudsbudgetten op en stemt binnen dit budget bestellingen af met de Inkopers.

Om dit allemaal in goede banen te leiden ga je regelmatig naar “jouw” schepen toe in binnen- en buitenland. Je hebt hierbij veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. Je neemt zelf beslissingen en voert deze uit, of ziet erop toe dat deze conform afspraak uitgevoerd worden. Daarbij hou je steeds de kosten in het oog en handelt hiernaar. Omdat onze 24/7 schepen over de hele wereld varen, werk je soms op onregelmatige tijdstippen.

Superintendent Onno Steenweg vertelt:

“Het is mijn taak om de juiste oplossing te vinden voor problemen van een schip, om te voorkomen dat een schip off-hire gaat. Eerst probeer ik in overleg met de bemanning het probleem vast te stellen. Als dat gelukt is, begint de grote puzzel. Hoe urgent is het probleem, waar gaat het schip laden en lossen, hoe lang blijft ze daar en kan ik daar de juiste mensen en materialen hebben? Daarna is het mijn taak om de juiste mensen bij elkaar te brengen om het op te lossen.”

Waarom wij?

  • Een inhoudelijk veelzijdige en uitdagende baan

  • De kans om regelmatig aan boord te stappen in binnen- en buitenland

  • Leuke collega’s en een goede werksfeer

  • De mogelijkheid om opleidingen te volgen

  • Een prima salaris

  • Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden

Wie ben jij?

  • Je hebt een afgeronde opleiding richting scheepvaart, scheepsbouw of werktuigbouw

  • Ervaring als zeevarende is een pre

  • Je spreekt en schrijft goed Engels

  • Je denkt in oplossingen, weet je observaties en ideeën om te zetten in goede adviezen en kunt goed improviseren

  • Je hebt goede sociale vaardigheden en bent stressbestendig

Ben je geïnteresseerd?

Klik op 'Solliciteer', vul het formulier in, voeg jouw motivatiebrief en CV toe en druk op 'Verzenden'. Wij berichten je dan zo spoedig mogelijk over de verdere procedure.

title: Meewerkstage Verhuur | 's-Hertogenbosch
description:
De juiste huurauto op het juiste moment bij de juiste klant krijgen: daar krijg jij energie van. Tijdens deze stage binnen Verhuur leer je hoe je overzicht houdt, schakelt tussen klanten en collega’s en bijdraagt aan een soepel lopende mobiliteitsdienstverlening. Welkom bij Van den Udenhout!

Een dag als Stagiaire Verhuur

  • ’s Ochtends start de dag vaak direct aan de verhuurbalie, waar klanten hun huurauto komen ophalen en je de benodigde documenten zorgvuldig controleert.

  • Tijdens het ontvangst begeleid je klanten naar hun huurauto en help je hen op weg, bijvoorbeeld met het instellen van het navigatiesysteem.

  • Gedurende de dag houd je de mailbox en reserveringen in de gaten en stem je af welke voertuigen op welk moment op de vestiging in ’s-Hertogenbosch nodig zijn.

  • Samen met collega’s zorg je dat het transport tijdig wordt geregeld, zodat de juiste huurauto’s beschikbaar zijn voor komende reserveringen.

  • Aan het einde van de dag worden huurauto’s weer ingeleverd en controleer je samen met de klant of alles in orde is, inclusief eventuele schades.

  • Tussendoor denk je mee over de inzet van het wagenpark, bijvoorbeeld wanneer blijkt dat bepaalde modellen extra populair zijn.

Profiel

  • Interesse in autoverhuur, mobiliteit en klantcontact.

  • Representatief en klantgericht.

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden.

  • In staat om overzicht te houden en gemakkelijk te schakelen tussen verschillende werkzaamheden.

  • Enthousiast om binnen een stage meer te leren over autoverhuur en mobiliteitsdienstverlening.

Wij bieden

  • Een stagevergoeding van €350 per maand.

  • Een leerzame stage binnen onze afdeling Verhuur in ’s-Hertogenbosch.

  • De mogelijkheid om praktijkervaring op te doen binnen autoverhuur en mobiliteitsdienstverlening.

  • Een stageplek binnen een gezellig team met een informele werksfeer.

  • De kans om jezelf in de praktijk verder te ontwikkelen.

Van den Udenhout als organisatie

Sinds onze oprichting in 1957 is Van den Udenhout uitgegroeid tot een van de grootste en meest vooruitstrevende mobiliteitsorganisaties van Zuid-Nederland. Vanuit onze vestigingen in Noord-Brabant bieden we verkoop en onderhoud van auto’s, aangevuld met mobiliteitsoplossingen zoals verhuur, lease, schadeherstel, bedrijfswageninbouw en (e-)bikes.

Wij zijn De Nieuwe Dealer voor Volkswagen, Audi, SEAT, Škoda, CUPRA en Volkswagen Bedrijfswagens met vestigingen in Best, Boxtel, Breda, Den Bosch, Eindhoven, Halsteren, Oss, Oud Gastel, Roosendaal en Veldhoven. Daarnaast hebben we een belang in diverse Porsche- en Bentley-dealerbedrijven in Brabant en Limburg, waaronder Porsche Centrum Brabant, Porsche Centrum Maastricht en Bentley Maastricht.

Werken bij Van den Udenhout betekent werken in een warme, ambitieuze Brabantse organisatie waar persoonlijke aandacht, groei en passie voor mobiliteit centraal staan. Samen met zo’n 1.000 collega’s bouwen we iedere dag aan de mobiliteit van morgen.

Contact

Meer weten? App met recruitment via 06-23364172 of mail naar werkenbij@udenhout.nl.

title: B2B-myynnin ja asiakkuuksien hoidon osaaja Hiilipörssiin
description:
Hiilipörssi on Suomen johtava yksityinen toimija soiden ennallistamisessa, ja pian kuusivuotisen osakeyhtiötaipaleemme aikana olemme tehneet paljon työtä suoluonnon, vesistöjen ja ilmaston hyväksi. Jotta voimme palauttaa elämän yhä useammalle suolle, tarvitsemme lisää yrityksiä mukaan toimintaamme.

Etsimme nyt tiimiimme myyntihenkistä ja asiantuntevaa B2B-myyjää. Pääpaino työssäsi on aktiivisessa uusasiakashankinnassa sekä aiempien asiakkuuksien hoitamisessa ja lisämyynnissä. B2B-myynnin lisäksi toimenkuvaasi voi liittyä myös yhteyksien hoitamista maanomistajien suuntaan, sekä tuotekehitystä ja markkinoinnin suunnittelua.

Mistä sinulla on osaamista tai vahva halu oppia lisää?

* B2B-myynti ja asiakkuuksien hoito: Sinulta löytyy kokemusta ja nälkää B2B-myyntiin. Olet myyntihenkinen etkä kaihda soittelua, myyntitapaamisia tai verkostoitumistapahtumia. Ymmärrät potentiaalisia B2B-kohderyhmiämme, joihin kuuluvat esimerkiksi energia-, infra-, teknologia- ja elintarvikealan yritykset sekä asiantuntijaorganisaatiot (kuten konsulttitalot ja suunnittelufirmat).

* Hiili- ja luonnonarvomarkkinat: Ymmärrät hiilimarkkinoiden ja luonnonarvomarkkinoiden perusperiaatteet ja osaat vakuuttaa yrityspäättäjät niiden merkityksestä.

* Metsäalan tuntemus ja maanomistajayhteistyö: Tunnet metsäalaa ja ymmärrät metsäojitettujen soiden peruslogiikan. Koska toimit tarvittaessa linkkinä maanomistajien suuntaan, kokemus yhteistyöstä maanomistajien kanssa on eduksi.

* Organisointikyky ja projektinhallinta: Osaat pitää langat käsissäsi ja huolehtia, että myyntiliidit etenevät sopimuksiksi ja liikevaihdoksi aikataulussa.

* Viestintä ja asiakaspalvelu: Olet asiakaspalveluhenkinen ja vastaat nopeasti erityisesti avainasiakkaidemme ja maanomistajien kyselyihin.

* Aito kiinnostus luontoa kohtaan: Olet kiinnostunut luonnonsuojelusta ja ymmärrät perusekologiaa. Sinulla on myös näkemystä ja visiota siitä, miten Hiilipörssiä pitäisi tulevaisuudessa kehittää.

Emme oleta, että olet jo valmis mestari jokaisella yllä listatulla osa-alueella. Tärkeintä on rohkea myyntiasenne, järjestelmällinen ote työhön ja aito palo edistää Suomen luonnon tilaa. Tukena työssäsi on aina Hiilipörssin muu tiimi.

Työsuhteesta ja palkasta:

* Sijainti: Koska toivomme sinulta valmiutta ja kiinnostusta olla mukana alan tapahtumissa ja verkostoissa, paras sijainti työn tekemiselle on pääkaupunkiseutu. Yrityksellämme ei toistaiseksi ole omaa toimistoa, mutta viikoittaisten lähipäivien järjestäminen Helsingissä on tärkeää etä- ja hybridityön rinnalla.

* Palkkaus: Palkkaus sovitaan kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi mukaan. Kerrohan hakemuksessa palkkatoiveesi perustelujen kera.

* Aloitus: Sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Heräsikö kysymyksiä? Soita tai lähetä sähköpostia: Outi Ugas, p. 040 4114541, outi.ugas@hiiliporssi.fi

title: Commercial Excellence Lead Malmö (Student)
description:
Commercial Excellence Lead, Malmö


About the role

Help grow athme in Malmö by building relationships with existing sports communities and supporting them in bringing their activities onto the platform.

You will be athme’s local representative in Malmö, working with sports organizers, student communities, clubs, companies, and players. Although the role is based locally, you will work closely with our headquarters team in Denmark.

You will receive a proven playbook, clear weekly priorities, outreach materials, regular check-ins, and ongoing support. You are not expected to enter the market alone or develop the strategy from scratch. Your responsibility is to execute and adapt an existing approach while helping us understand what works best in Malmö.


What you will do

  • Identify and connect with sports clubs, student organizations, informal groups, universities, and companies in Malmö

  • Build relationships with organizers, hosts, and community leaders

  • Introduce communities to athme and help them understand how the platform can support their activities

  • Help onboard organizers, events, and entire communities onto the platform

  • Support existing partners in running recurring activities and growing participation

  • Attend relevant events, campuses, sports venues, and community meetups

  • Follow and execute athme’s local business development playbook

  • Work closely with the headquarters team on priorities, outreach, and follow-ups

  • Share insights about the Malmö market and identify new partnership opportunities

  • Collect feedback from organizers and players to improve the product and local experience


What success looks like

Success is not about transforming the Malmö market overnight. It is about consistently building relationships and creating measurable progress with support from the wider team.

Over time, this means:

  • New sports communities and organizers joining athme

  • Strong relationships with local partners and community leaders

  • More recurring events and active hosts on the platform

  • Organic player growth through established communities

  • Growing awareness of athme across Malmö’s sports and student ecosystem

  • Strong execution of the playbook, adapted to the local market

  • Close collaboration between Malmö and the headquarters team in Denmark


Who we are looking for

You do not need previous business development or startup experience. We care more about your energy, reliability, communication skills, and willingness to learn.

You could be a strong fit if:

  • You enjoy sports, meeting people, and building relationships

  • You are comfortable approaching organizers and starting conversations

  • You are structured and follow through on what you start

  • You are proactive, curious, and willing to learn by doing

  • You can take ownership while also asking for support when needed

  • You are business-minded but natural and approachable

  • You have been involved in student organizations, volunteering, sports teams, events, or community initiatives

  • You actively play or follow sports such as football, padel, volleyball, fitness, running, or similar

  • You are a student, ideally living in Malmö and studying in Denmark

  • You understand the Malmö and Copenhagen student environment, or are excited to work across both cities


Support and onboarding

You will not be left alone to figure out how to grow athme in Malmö.

From the beginning, you will receive:

  • A structured onboarding process

  • A practical business development playbook

  • Clear weekly priorities and realistic targets

  • Outreach materials, templates, and relevant contacts

  • Regular meetings with the headquarters team

  • Ongoing feedback and sparring

  • Direct support when approaching communities or handling challenges

  • Close collaboration with the founding team

You will have real responsibility, but always with clear direction and support.


Internship structure and growth opportunity

The position begins with a one-month unpaid internship, allowing both sides to test the collaboration in a real working environment.

During this period, you will work closely with the athme team and gain hands-on experience in business development, partnerships, community growth, and marketplace operations.

If the collaboration is a strong mutual fit and you demonstrate reliability, initiative, and progress, the role can continue as a paid student assistant position.


What we offer

  • Hands-on experience growing a live product used by real sports communities

  • Direct exposure to business development, partnerships, growth, operations, and product

  • Close collaboration with the founding team

  • A clear playbook and structured support from Denmark

  • Meaningful responsibility without being expected to know everything from day one

  • Flexibility alongside your studies

  • Opportunities to build a strong local network in Malmö and Copenhagen

  • A role where your work creates visible and measurable impact

  • The possibility of continuing in a paid student position

  • Long-term growth opportunities, including potential equity for people who grow with athme


Duration

Initial period: One-month unpaid internship

Possible next step: Paid student assistant position based on performance and mutual fit
