location: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

We're hiring a Regional Lead to join our Agent Operations team in DRC. Reporting to the Agent Ops Lead, the role holder will oversee all Wave agent network acquiring and operations management for the assigned region by supervising all the activities of the agent openers and liaising with the respective agent admin teams to attain the set targets in the region.

In this role, you'll;

  • Agent growth: Coordinate the Agent Openers in identifying opportunity areas for new agent locations and acquiring required agents according to the set agent selection criteria and guidelines.
  • Agent Contracting: Ensure the Agent Openers recruit agents in compliance with the legal and policy requirements as per the defined procedure. Ensure all agents in your region have executed valid contracts and are trained on the contents of the contract before they sign it.
  • Agent Activation & Training: Ensure all agents are trained and certified (for all products and procedures). This includes Know Your Customer (KYC) and AML/CTF as per the defined agent training procedure and requirements. It also includes delivering supplies and coordinating outlet branding.
  • Agent Ongoing Liquidity Management: Coordinate the cash / e-value availability monitoring at agents in liaison with Liquidity and Agent Quality Territory teams.
  • Risk Management and Routine Visitation: Manage the teams in Monitoring Agent vs. target performance through Reports on emerging issues and assessments of the region's performance.
  • Agent Churn: Coordinate the Identification of Agents for Closure (as per internal procedure), recover Wave items and equipment, and ensure branding material is removed.
  • Be the primary contact person for all agency networks acquiring & Wave products in your region: Execute operational excellence, manage costs, and ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory guidelines.
  • Champion excellent customer service and implementation of quality service delivery standards.

Key details

  • Location: You'll work from Kinshasa, Kongo Central, or Bandundu.
  • Work authorization in DRC is required.
  • Contract type: Permanent Contract
  • Our salaries are competitive and calculated using a transparent formula.
  • We offer generous health insurance for yourself and your dependents.
  • We support working parents - we offer 26 weeks of parental leave for mothers and 4 weeks for fathers, in addition to subsidized child care when they return to work.
  • Airtime reimbursement.
  • Free food and a beautiful office space.

Requirements

  • Fluent in English
  • Master’s degree in a related field.
  • Speak both French and English fluently.
  • At least 5 years of relevant work experience, specifically managing an agent network in DRC, and a minimum of 2 years of experience managing field-based teams.
  • Must have worked and overseen agent network activities in the upcountry.

You might be a good fit if you

  • Communicate effectively and often, both in writing and in person, to the point of over-communication.
  • Are detail-oriented and seek to achieve excellence in everything you do.
  • Are a self-starter and proactive about achieving ambitious targets.
  • Enjoy owning projects - you're autonomous yet know when to escalate problems.
  • Have built and led strong teams in achieving key results.
  • Are intellectually curious, creative in the way you go about tackling problems, and embrace failure as a means to spark innovation and growth.
  • Adjust quickly to changing priorities and conditions.
  • Think about culture and process from the users' perspective.
  • Are tech-savvy: comfortable navigating Excel and onboarding to new tools.

Our team

  • We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
  • We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
  • We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
  • We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.
  • We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Endeavour Group is Australia’s largest retail drinks network under the Dan Murphy’s and BWS brands, operating the country's largest portfolio of licenced hotels. We are seeking a skilled PAM Identity Engineer to drive the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of our Privileged Access Management function. title: Data Engineer
description:
Job Description: Data Engineer

Location: London/Hybrid – Office two+ days per week

We’re hiring data engineers who want to take ownership in a fast-scaling startup

About Clariti AI

Clariti AI is a B2B SaaS company providing price optimisation software to retail banks. We help banks make pricing decisions on products like mortgages and savings. Our pricing software guides clients to price recommendations that are worth millions of Pounds or Euros in additional revenue.

This is an exciting time to join the company, with a growing set of clients in the UK and Ireland. After recent successes, Clariti AI has built a very promising pipeline of new clients, with revenues expected to increase significantly in the next year. The company is bootstrapped (no VC or angel investment) and is already very profitable.

Data Engineer

This data engineer role will play a key role in helping us improve the production quality of our software as we scale. Our software offering has a significant financial impact for our clients and needs to be outstanding for our clients to get value.

As an early joiner, the Data Engineer role is key, and provides multiple opportunities for the right person to grow significantly. There are many things to focus on depending on experience and interests. The role is all about pro-active "building and improving", whether that is scaling our infrastructure as we take on more clients and larger clients, streamlining and automating data refresh processes, improving our data security, building and deploying machine learning models, or getting involved with client pitches.

What you'll be working on

  • Building, optimising, and deploying price optimization machine learning ETL/ELT pipelines and data processes.
  • Improving and adapting our data infrastructure and code base as we scale – including collaboration, security, scalability, efficiency, automation and auditability.
  • Interacting with new clients on client pitches, and working with existing clients to onboard our software, offering engineering and pricing expertise.

Essentials:

  • Strong academic background with a minimum bachelor’s or master’s degree in a STEM subject (Computer Science, Mathematics or Engineering)
  • At least 2 years’ experience working as a data engineer (ideally consulting / financial services) – salary and level will reflect experience.
  • Proficiency in Python (pandas, numpy)
  • Professional experience with Azure cloud services (AWS / GCP acceptable with deeper experience)
  • Strong experience deploying clean, maintainable, production-level code.
  • Basic understanding of DAG (Directed Acyclic Graphs) and their role in pipeline orchestration

It would be nice if you could bring (desirables)

  • Professional experience with PySpark, MySQL, Docker, Kubernetes
  • Experience with best-practice pipeline orchestration software (Airflow, Dagster).
  • Experience migrating code from prototype notebooks to .py, while maintaining logic and transparency of underlying code
  • Owned a project across a whole software product lifecycle, from data infrastructure, to model development and deployment, to front-end integration
  • Experience of pricing analytics and/or optimization ideally in retail banking
  • Experience in producing PowerPoint presentations / reports and presenting to clients or colleagues
  • Willingness to get involved in all parts of the business – we are a small company so we all wear many hats
  • An entrepreneurial spirit and drive to work in an early-stage start-up that directly rewards impact

Tech stack:

  • Platform: We build everything in Azure (but sometimes need to work in other cloud providers like AWS depending on client’s needs).
  • Backend – We develop all our code in Python
  • Front-end – MySQL and jQuery/React

What we offer

  • A highly competitive salary
  • A genuinely compelling profit share scheme, with the potential to own a significant stake in the business
  • Equity options that deliver significant gains if the company is acquired
  • Flexible working hours
  • “Work anywhere” for up to two months a year
  • A significant opportunity to grow quickly with regular performance-based promotions and pay increases
  • 25 days per year holiday allowance, increasing by one day per year after two years’ service to 30 days

Other

  • We cannot sponsor visas, so only applicants with the permanent right to work in the UK will be considered
  • Successful applicants should be willing to work in London up to two days a week and should be willing to travel to clients occasionally

title: Fullstack Developer
description:
Fullstack Engineer – Fletchers Solicitors AI

Location

Hybrid – primarily remote, with in‑person collaboration once per month in Manchester or Liverpool, option for more in‑person and growing London presence

Overview

We are looking for a Fullstack Engineer to join our expanding AI team at Fletchers Solicitors. This role sits within a fast‑paced, high‑autonomy environment where we are rapidly prototyping, iterating, and deploying state‑of‑the‑art AI products for use across Fletchers and the wider legal sector. The team operates as a start‑up‑style unit within the wider business, reporting directly to the executive team, with a clear mandate to move quickly from idea to production. You will be responsible for building and maintaining the backend systems and web applications that support the development, testing, deployment, and scaling of our Machine Learning and LLM‑based tools, and for helping to transform these into robust, market‑ready products. We have ambitious plans to grow the AI team significantly over the next few years as we expand our internal capabilities and commercialise our technology externally.

About Fletchers Solicitors & the AI / Data Science Team

Fletchers is a fast-growing consumer law firm specialising in personal injury and clinical negligence, and with a growing practice in family and private client. Fletchers was one of the first consumer law firms to deploy a machine learning tool for legal work (a decision support system for screening incoming cases, launched in 2017) and was one of, or the first, law firm to have a dedicated AI department, which started in August 2023. Since then, we have been experimenting with a broader range of ML techniques, extending those tools already in use, and productionising new ones through our growing data science & engineering teams.

We believe that we are well positioned to leverage Fletchers’ unique legal‑medical dataset and industry expertise to build AI tools that will shape the future of consumer law. We are well funded through our Private Equity backers, which allows us to invest heavily in the development of sector‑specific AI tools that assist, automate, and augment our specialist legal work. Tools we have built range from simple behind‑the‑scenes custom model inference, to agentic‑AI pipelines for ‘always on’ monitoring, to the core user interface that some of our colleagues work on for 90%+ of their day. We’re also commercialising these tools so that other specialist law firms can leverage Fletchers legal and AI expertise, and have an ambitious agenda for external growth for the next 18 months.

Fletchers is headquartered in the North‑West of the UK, with offices in Manchester, Liverpool, Leeds, Southport, Bolton, Cambridge, Reading, Birmingham, Northampton, and Newcastle. With an ever‑expanding operation, it has also recently opened offices in London. Colleagues work primarily from home: the existing AI team is distributed across London, Manchester, Liverpool, Cambridge, and Bristol, and we typically meet in person once or twice per month in Manchester.

The Role

As a Fullstack Engineer within the AI team, you will support the design, development, and ongoing evolution of our core backend services, data processing pipelines, and frontend applications. You will play a key role in enabling rapid experimentation while ensuring that successful prototypes can be hardened and scaled into production‑grade systems.

You will work closely with product stakeholders, data scientists, and clients across multiple projects in parallel. This is a role suited to someone who is comfortable working close to the user, taking ownership of systems end‑to‑end, and making pragmatic engineering and architectural decisions in a fast‑moving environment.

We are open to candidates of all experience levels. The scope of responsibilities can flex depending on proficiencies and interests, with clear opportunities for rapid progression and significant professional growth for motivated candidates as the team and product portfolio grow.

Main Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of backend services and frontend applications that support the development, testing, deployment, and monitoring of ML‑enabled products
  • Contribute to infrastructure and architecture decisions by developing a strong understanding of business and product need
  • Maintain and extend existing, and build new APIs and data processing pipelines to support evolving product requirements
  • Own and maintain aspects of our frontend applications, to ensure excellent user experience
  • Collaborate closely with product and data science teams to deliver end‑to‑end solutions
  • Work directly with internal users and stakeholders to scope, prioritise, and resolve issues and bugs
  • Enable ML development through efficient and scalable data integrations from diverse sources, including case management systems, unstructured documents (Word, PDF), and SQL databases

Required Skills And Attributes

  • Strong proficiency in Python, with experience designing and building backend systems and web apps (proficiency with at least one Python web framework is desirables
  • Strong professional experience building frontend applications with TypeScript and React
  • Comfort operating in a fast‑paced production environment where deployments have direct user impact
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, demonstrating strong ownership, prioritisation, and delivery focusStrong communication skills and sound engineering judgement
  • Based in the UK, with the ability to attend in‑person team meetings at least approximately once or twice per month (expenses paid if far from office)
  • Based near London or Manchester (although the role can be primarily remote, we anticipate meeting with the whole team twice/month in Manchester, and a local team two or three times/week in a London office)
  • Fluency in English
  • Strong degree qualification(s) in a STEM subject from a top‑tier university

Desirable (Nice‑-to‑-Have) Experience

  • Experience designing and deploying infrastructure (e.g. cloud environments, containers, CI/CD pipelines, secure networking, or databases)
  • Experience architecting applications through periods of scale‑up (e.g. going 100 users -> 1000)
  • Start‑up or greenfield experience, particularly building backend systems or data environments from scratch
  • ‘Product engineer’ experience
  • Previous experience with Azure
  • Familiarity with Machine Learning concepts and workflows

We want to grow quickly, so reserve the right to close this role early depending on candidate quality and volume.

Additional Employee Benefits

  • Annual bonus scheme (subject to targets being met)
  • Pension scheme with salary sacrifice option
  • Life Assurance policy
  • Medicash policy covering dental, optical, and other medical expenses, plus discounts on travel, cinema, electronics, home, and groceries
  • 35 days’ holiday per year including bank holidays and Christmas closure, with the option to purchase up to 3 additional days
  • Long service awards: up to 3 additional days’ holiday after your 5th, 7th, and 9th full years of service
  • Enhanced company sick pay, maternity, paternity, and IVF pay schemes
  • Flexible and agile working environment supporting positive work‑life balance
  • Funded company social events throughout the year

Our People

Our people are at the heart of everything we do. We take pride in the results achieved for our clients and consistently go the extra mile to secure justice. Fletchers is an employer of choice and has been rated a Top 80 Law Firm by The Times. Our culture supports high performance, professional growth, and employee wellbeing.

Recent Highlights at Fletchers

  • Transition to Fletchers Group following several acquisitions, with further growth planned
  • Opening of new offices in London, Leeds, Liverpool, Bolton, and Cambridge (in addition to Southport and Manchester)
  • Launch of the Fletchers Foundation charity supporting injured people

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

Our National Security and AI Safety business unit is dedicated to advancing the responsible development and deployment of AI in support of national security and global stability. From strengthening mission-critical capabilities across national security and intelligence, to working with frontier labs to provide robust AI safety red teaming and evaluation, we work at the frontier of high-stakes, high-impact missions.

We understand that powerful AI systems bring both transformative opportunities and complex risks and we are proud to partner with Government and the biggest tech organisations in the world to ensure AI is not just transformative but is also secure, trustworthy and safe for all.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Developed Vetting (DV) and willing to work on site with our clients from time to time.

About the role

Join us as a Machine Learning Engineer to deliver bespoke, impactful AI solutions for our diverse clients.

You will be instrumental in bringing machine learning out of the lab and into the real world, contributing to scalable software architecture and defining best practices. Working with clients, and cross-functional teams, you'll ensure technical feasibility and timely delivery of high-quality, production-grade ML systems.

What you'll be doing:

title: Creative Producer
description:
Location: New Media Headquarters, Derry Street, HSK, London, W8 5HY
Position: Full Time / Permanent


About Us

DMG New Media is building the next generation of social-first publishing, creating platform-native brands across news, sport, lifestyle, entertainment and culture for global audiences. Our network reaches hundreds of millions of people across social platforms each month, and we're scaling rapidly across both short-form and long-form video.

This role works across the business, but sits primarily within Metro, where we're building a slate of original, talent-fronted shows. Rush Hour Crush and What I Rent are live now, and we're adding new shows to the slate every quarter. We're looking for a Creative Producer to help build what comes next.

About the role

As a Creative Producer, you'll help build and run Metro's slate of original shows - from the first pitch, through to a pilot, into ongoing series. You'll combine creative instinct with hands-on production skill, working closely with hosts, creators and the wider team to build content that's distinctive, watchable and commercially viable.

Main Responsibilities

  • Pitch and develop original formats and build them into repeatable shows for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and beyond.
  • Own the shows end-to-end: from pitch, to pilot, to a running series - briefing shoots, writing scripts, and keeping every episode consistent in quality and tone.
  • Source and secure talent, locations and kit, and build relationships with hosts and contributors who can carry a format over time.
  • Attend and run shoots, directing camera and cast on-set.
  • Write scripts, and build format structures and hooks for retention on social
  • Take full ownership and accountability for the shows you run, including how they perform.
  • Work closely with creators, hosts and the wider team to keep every show sharp and on-brand - and help connect talent across shows to build a shared audience.
  • Use performance data to understand what's working, and refine formats accordingly.
  • Spot trends and opportunities - cultural, platform, production or format-related.
  • Keep clear, consistent communication on production status across your slate.

Person Specification

  • A track record of pitching and building original social video formats - you can talk an idea through from concept, to pilot, to an ongoing series.
  • Strong instincts for what makes people stop scrolling, and the ability to write copy, scripts and hooks that are genuinely audience-first.
  • Comfortable owning a project end-to-end: briefing and running shoots, managing hosts and contributors, staying on top of every episode across a series.
  • A good eye for talent - you can spot what makes someone watchable, and know how to build the kind of relationship that keeps them invested in a format long-term.
  • Experience creating for high-profile social channels is an advantage (1M+ follower channels, ideally).
  • Comfortable using performance data to judge what's working and adjust a format in response.
  • Experience operating cameras is beneficial
  • Some video editing experience (Premiere Pro) is useful but not essential - production and format skills come first here.
  • Budget management - able to plan and keep a shoot or series within budget.
  • Understanding of legal and editorial guidelines across global markets.
  • Able to manage multiple shows and projects at once, within a busy, fast-moving team.
  • Flexibility to work outside standard hours around shoots, launches and live moments, as the format demands

Our Commitment

We are committed to increasing diversity and maintaining an inclusive workplace culture. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of their ethnicity, race, gender, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability.

We are Disability Confident Committed. Please let us know if you require any recruitment documentation in other formats or if you require reasonable adjustments to be made during the recruitment process. Please be assured that any such information will be held separately to your recruitment application and will not be considered as part of the selection process.

title: Karweimedewerker individueel maatwerk - regio Antwerpen centrum
description: De karweidienst van Familiehulp helpt zorgbehoevende mensen thuis met kleine herstellingen, veilig wonen en meer comfort in huis. Als karweimedewerker zorg je samen met jouw collega’s voor een toegankelijke woning, voer je klusjes uit in en rondom de woning. Je krijgt begeleiding op de werkvloer en werkt in een afwisselende, actieve job binnen de sociale economie. Herstellingen in huis : je vervangt stopcontacten, repareert verlichting, herstelt deuren en kranen , en voert kleine schilder- en behangwerken uit. Veiligheid eerst : je installeert rookmelders en sleutelkastjes , verwijdert tapijten , werkt snoeren weg en voert andere taken uit die vallen helpen voorkomen. Toegankelijkheid verbeteren : je plaatst handgrepen , installeert een hellend vlak en maakt elke ruimte vlot bereikbaar. Winterdienst : je ruimt sneeuw en bladeren om gevaarlijke situaties buiten te vermijden. Tuin en afval: je voert beperkt tuinonderhoud uit en brengt (tuin)afval naar het containerpark, zodat de woning en omgeving netjes blijven.

title: Full stack developer
description:
At Smollan Technologies, we provide a unified, technology-driven suite of products that redefines how businesses handle data. We don’t just build applications; we build cloud-native, high-throughput engines that turn raw unstructured media into predictive intelligence. Our Engineering team is no different. We are moving away from monolithic backends and rigid systems, flipping the switch on next-gen applied AI and event-driven data platforms. By centralising our server-heavy architectures, inference job orchestration, and rich web interfaces within automated cloud workflows, we are transforming complex technical infrastructure into a forward-thinking strategic asset.

Our vision for our Senior Full Stack Developer is to carry day-to-day technical accountability for high-volume distributed services and the operational web applications that expose them. This isn't just about glueing APIs together; it’s about deep-diving into server-side concurrency, designing zero-downtime database schemas, and orchestrating machine learning inference pipelines with deterministic reliability. The ideal candidate is a forward-thinking engineer who is not only fluent in modern Type Script/Node.js and React patterns, but actively excited about integrating applied AI workflows, optimising pipeline unit economics, and driving operational excellence.

We believe that when you hire unique, creative problem solvers and give them flexibility and independence, incredible things happen. Our culture is rooted in a foundation of trust. We foster a diverse, inclusive environment where our people are genuinely cared for, inspired, and empowered to thrive. We are looking for dreamers who love a challenge and want the autonomy to solve it.

What You Will Do API Design & Data Engineering: Architect versioned REST APIs (Open API) secured via OAuth2/OIDC, while managing Postgre SQL schemas, complex query optimisation, indexing strategies, and zero-downtime data migrations. Operational Web Application Development: Build responsive, high-performance web front ends in React and Type Script featuring component-driven design, efficient server-state caching, and clean review workflows over large datasets. Distributed Services & Pipeline Architecture: Design and build asynchronous, event-driven ingestion pipelines on GCP using Node.js/Type Script (Nest JS), handling backpressure, dead-letter replays, and exactly-once write idempotency under heavy load. Inference Orchestration & AI Integration: Orchestrate long-running machine learning inference jobs (LLMs, detection models) behind schema-first contracts, implementing confidence thresholding for human review and tracking cost-per-item telemetry. Observability & CI/CD Delivery: Implement end-to-end telemetry (Open Telemetry, structured logs), build containerised infrastructure via Docker/Ia C, and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines with staged release strategies. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner directly with Machine Learning Engineers on inference contracts, Mobile teams on device APIs, and Product Owners to translate complex operational needs into resilient software solutions.

title: Cyber Security Systems Administrator
description:
About Us

CEA is an Australian Commonwealth company that designs, develops, manufactures and sustains advanced active phased array radar systems. The company’s design principles and commitment to investment in research and development ensures innovative thinking, technological skill, and quality fabrication.

Our programs include the ANZAC and Hunter Class frigates and air defence applications for Army and Air Force, and Range applications. Through our longstanding and ongoing collaboration with Defence, CEA Technologies has undertaken research and development into all aspects of active electronically scanned array technologies. This has resulted in the creation of a highly modular and scalable product suite, which have become integral to a wide range of critical Defence capabilities.

The Position
We are seeking a Cyber Security Systems Administrator to join our growing security team. This is a full-time position based in Canberra, ACT. In this role, you will play a critical part in protecting our organisation's infrastructure and data from evolving cyber threats. You will be responsible for implementing, managing, and maintaining security systems and controls that safeguard our IT environment. This position is strategically important as it bridges technical system administration with proactive security practices, ensuring our organisation maintains a robust and resilient security posture.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Administer, maintain, patch and upgrade CEA’s core security toolsets.

  • Administer the virtualisation platform including cluster health, capacity, VM lifecycle, storage, backup/restore and platform updates.

  • Administer container platform including cluster options, node health, workload deployment, upgrades and registry management.

  • Tune and configure tooling to balance security efficacy against system performance (e.g., scan windows, on-access scan exclusions, allowlist and policy design).

  • Build, harden and maintain the Windows and Linux systems underpinning the security tooling.

  • Administer security tooling workloads on virtualisation and containerisation platforms.

  • Apply and maintain OS and application hardening to the ISM, Essential Eight ML3 and/or NIST SP-800-53 requirements (e.g., patching, hardening baselines, application control).

  • Administer Privileged Access Management solutions to enrol resources, manage roles and access policies, SSO/certificate integration and session recording.

Our Benefits

  • Six weeks of paid annual leave per year

  • Superannuation of 14.0%

  • Free car parking

  • Paid parental, compassionate, defence reserve & voluntary emergency services leave

  • Employee assistance and wellbeing programs

  • Health insurance for defence supporters and their families

  • Salary packaging for novated leasing

  • Opportunities for professional growth and development

Our Ideal Candidate

  • Demonstrated Windows Server and RHEL administration in a security context.

  • Hands-on experience with one or more of; Nessus, Elastic, Trellix, Airlock Digital, Teleport (or equivalent security tooling stack).

  • Working knowledge of Nutanix and/or OpenShift.

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tooling such as Puppet, Ansible, and Terraform.

  • Experience with container orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Familiarity with security frameworks and standards (e.g. ISM, DSPF, NIST, ISO 27001) and incident response best practices.

  • Bachelor degree and/or relevant industry certifications.

  • Desirable certifications: RHCSA/RHCE, Security+, relevant Microsoft and vendor certifications.

  • Desirable experience: Arista and Palo Alto Networks.

Eligibility

  • An Australian Citizen;

  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an AGSVA clearance – Top Secret Positive Vetting .

  • ITAR – This position requires employees to access equipment and data that is subject to U.S International Traffic and Arms Regulation (ITAR). As such, applicants must disclose the following information at the time of application.

    • Place of Birth

    • Countries of current or past citizenship (including any dual citizenship or nationality) and residence,

    • Countries of issue for current and past passports and

    • Other information related to their nationality for security and ITAR compliance purposes.

To find out more about our Citizenship and Nationality requirements, please visit www.cea.com.au

How to apply

Click on the 'Apply Now' button below. Please include a current copy of your resume and complete the screening questions. Applications without these elements will not be considered.

CEA encourages the submissions of early applications as we may review, short-list and/or conduct interviews for this role prior to the closing date.

Diversity, Equality and Inclusion at CEA

CEA is committed to fostering a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we strive to create a culture where all employees are respected and empowered to contribute positively to our organisation, regardless of their cultural background, age, gender identity, neurodiversity, disability, family and carer commitments, religion or sexuality. We welcome applications from veterans, those returning from a career break, people with disabilities and those who identify as Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander.

title: Engagement Associate DACH
description:
We are hiring an Engagement Associate to work closely with our Engagement Managers, strengthening and growing our relationships with leading retailers. You will start close to the ground which means understanding our technology, supporting deployments, and managing day-to-day client operations with the goal of independently owning accounts.

The DACH retail market is one of our most strategically important. Your work will directly shape how Trigo shows up for some of its most significant clients while also engaging with our own senior management early on.


Requirements

What We're Looking For

We care more about how you think and how fast you grow than ticking every box. If you are excited about this role but do not meet every requirement, we would still love to hear from you.

Essential:

  • Native or fluent German speaker, strong English, other languages are a plus.
  • A background bridging business & tech (Business Informatics, Information Systems, Computer Science, or equivalent)
  • Comfortable in technical environments which means being able to understand and clearly communicate issues to engineering teams.
  • High ownership mindset: you take initiative.
  • Eager to learn fast, collaborate across time zones, and embrace an AI-first way of working.
  • Flexibility to travel regularly.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in a client-facing or operational role (internships and student projects count).
  • Familiarity with retail or FMCG environments.
  • Exposure to AI, computer-vision, IoT, or edge computing.
  • Experience with international or cross-cultural teams.


A day in the life

What You'll Do

In your first 12 months:

  • Get on the ground. Visit stores, talk to client staff, and understand how our technology performs in the real world. When issues arise, coordinate resolution with TechOps and R&D. We value faster fixes, fewer escalations.
  • Drive with data. Use analytics tools to surface what is actually happening in data and turn that into clear, evidence-backed recommendations.
  • Shape the product. Spend time with client operations and IT teams to understand where friction exists. Bring gaps and opportunities back with a point of view.
  • Communicate proactively. Manage day-to-day queries, flag issues proactively, and keep stakeholders updated with clarity.
  • Surface insights that drive action. When you find something meaningful in the data, frame it for the right audience.
  • Work AI-first. Experiment with AI tools in your own workflows. Whether analysing data, drafting communications, finding smarter ways to operate. If you spot a better way, we want you to try it.

As you grow into the role (12+ months):

  • Own engagement tasks for our clients.
  • Support rollout planning and expansion coordination across accounts.
  • Run client reporting: operational reviews and senior briefings that benchmark performance and make Trigo's value clear.
  • Use data to identify trends before clients do and position Trigo as the partner that thinks ahead.
  • Feed field insights back to Product and R&D to help shape the roadmap.

Perks and Benefits

We move fast, operate with high trust, and genuinely care about the work. You will be close to the technology, close to the clients, and close to the decisions that shape the company.

Our culture blends startup pace with a sense of directness, curiosity, and ownership. Being AI-first is part of our DNA as we build AI into how we analyse, communicate, and solve problems, and we expect our team to push what is possible with these tools.

There's no 'wait for permission' culture here. If you see something, you say it. If you find a better way, you try it.

﻿What We Offer

  • Competitive salary.
  • Flexible working: Hybrid in London (preferred) or hybrid/remote in Germany (Duesseldorf area)
  • A front-row seat to deploying real-world AI across one of Europe's largest retail markets.
  • Clear growth path to client engagement, with active investment in your development.
  • A small, high-calibre team where your work is visible and your contribution is truly felt.
  • The experience of working across cultures.

description:
Note: To be eligible for this role, you must be based in Medellín, Colombia and able to work from our office three days per week. Working hours are 10:00 a.m. to 6:30 p.m. (Colombia time), Monday to Friday a schedule designed to provide overlap with our teams across multiple U.S. time zones.

About Deckard Technologies

Deckard Technologies is a GovTech data company helping local governments address residential property-related challenges, with a focus on compliance and tax collection. Founded in 2018, we operate globally with offices in the U.S., Colombia, and Australia.

Trusted by over 400 jurisdictions worldwide, our scalable, cost-effective products leverage patented processes and combine best-in-class data collection with intuitive, AI-powered solutions, transforming how local governments monitor and manage properties.

Joining us means you’ll be working with a diverse group of inspiring people from industry experts and extraordinary technology and data operations teams to innovative product leaders in a down-to-earth and supportive culture.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Data Engineer to join our operational office in Medellín, Colombia. In this role, you will be responsible for monitoring database health, overseeing end-to-end data pipeline flows, and developing scalable analytics tools, dashboards, and operational workflows within Snowflake and Sigma Computing.

You will work closely with cross-functional Implementation, Data, and Client Experience teams to ensure data integrity, streamline business intelligence delivery, and build self-service reporting assets that drive customer value.

Key Responsibilities

  • Database Monitoring & Data Flow Quality/Oversight: Proactively monitor SQL and cloud data warehouse pipelines, staging tables, and automated data ingestion to ensure continuous availability, high performance, and data integrity.
  • Sigma BI Development: Design, build, and maintain interactive dashboards, complex data workbooks, and custom internal and external reporting tools within Sigma.
  • Data Transformation & Modelling: Write efficient, robust SQL queries, data models, and transformation scripts to prepare raw, multi-source datasets for BI consumption.
  • Troubleshooting & Anomaly Detection: Quickly identify, isolate, and resolve pipeline bottlenecks, data synchronisation failures, broken schemas, or report calculation discrepancies.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Implementation Coordinators, Program Managers, and Data Engineers to structure client-specific data workstreams, including legacy records and spatial data assets.
  • Documentation & Standards: Document data dictionary definitions, metric logic, workflow automations, and reporting best practices to support team scalability.

Required Skills, Qualifications & Experience

  • Snowflake and Sigma Computing: Demonstrated practical experience working with cloud data warehouses and building dashboards and calculation models in Sigma Computing or deep expertise in platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker, with a strong ability to quickly master Sigma. Experience with cloud data warehouse platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, or Amazon Redshift is valued, with direct Snowflake experience being highly regarded.
  • Experience: 2–4 years of hands-on experience in data engineering, data analysis, BI development, or database monitoring in a production environment.
  • Advanced SQL—Essential: Strong, hands-on SQL capability is essential for this role. Candidates must be proficient in writing and optimising complex queries using CTEs, window functions, joins, and aggregations across cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, or Amazon Redshift.
  • Data Flow & Pipeline Knowledge: Solid understanding of ETL/ELT principles, database schema design, and tracking data lineage from ingestion through to dashboard display.
  • English and Spanish Language Proficiency: A minimum B2 level of English proficiency, both verbal and written, is required, alongside native or fluent Spanish. This role involves regular communication and collaboration with English-speaking colleagues across the United States and Australia.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical mindset with rigorous attention to detail regarding data accuracy and quality assurance.
  • Analytical & Model Literacy: Comfort working with the outputs of predictive and classification models, such as booked-versus-blocked night inference and occupancy estimates. This includes understanding confidence thresholds, precision and recall trade-offs, known failure modes, and representing predicted values as distinct from observed values in dashboards and client-facing reporting.
  • Data Governance & Confidentiality: Sound judgment when handling sensitive client data and public records containing personally identifiable information, including address-level and parcel-level data. Familiarity with access controls, row-level security, and the principle of exposing only the minimum data a given report or user requires.
  • Communication & Data Storytelling: Ability to explain data limitations, methodology, and confidence levels to non-technical partners, Implementation Coordinators, Program Managers, and client stakeholders in clear terms. You’ll be the person who explains what a number does and does not support and translates a schema change or data gap into what it means for a client’s deliverable.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or Information Systems—or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • DBT Experience: Experience working with DBT would be an asset, demonstrating exposure to large-scale, modern SQL pipelines and structured data transformation practices.
  • Familiarity with scripting languages for data automation, such as Python, R, or Bash.
  • Experience with GIS or spatial data layers, such as Esri ArcGIS integrations.
  • Prior experience in a SaaS, civic technology, GovTech, or data-intensive analytics start-up environment.
  • Experience working directly with U.S.-based distributed teams.

As this role works closely with colleagues across the United States and Australia, candidates must have a minimum B2 level of English proficiency and be comfortable participating in meetings, discussing technical matters, and communicating clearly in writing.

At Deckard Technologies, we select candidates solely on merit, experience, and suitability for the role, in line with Article 13 of the Political Constitution of Colombia and Law 931 of 2004. The English-language requirement for this position is directly related to the operational responsibilities of the role and the need to collaborate with English-speaking colleagues across the United States and Australia.

We do not discriminate based on age, sex, race, national or family origin, language background, religion, or political or philosophical opinion.

We welcome applications from persons with disabilities and will make reasonable adjustments to our selection process upon request, in keeping with Law 361 of 1997. Deckard is committed to providing a workplace free from harassment and workplace violence, in line with Law 1010 of 2006 and supported by our Comité de Convivencia Laboral.

Als beveiliger bij een grote overheidsorganisatie in Moerdijk ben jij verantwoordelijk voor zowel de veiligheid als de gastvrijheid binnen het terrein. Met een glimlach zorg je voor een warm welkom en een veilig gevoel.

Hier ga jij werken:

Je gaat werken bij een grote overheidsorganisatie in Moerdijk. Deze organisatie staat bekend om haar professionaliteit en aandacht voor veiligheid, zowel voor haar medewerkers als voor de bezoekers. In deze omgeving vervul jij een belangrijke rol op het gebied van veiligheid, terwijl je ook een gastvrije en behulpzame houding aanneemt richting bezoekers en personeel.

Veiligheidstaken

  • Uitvoeren van openings-, brand- en sluitrondes;

  • Toezicht houden;

  • Bewaken via camerabeelden;

  • Uitvoeren van surveillancerondes;

  • Bedienen van de inbraakinstallatie en panieksignalering;

  • Uitvoeren van beheerderstaken aan de brandmeldcentrale;

  • Ondersteunen van de BHV-organisatie;

  • Melden van calamiteiten.

Hospitality- en beheertaken

  • Je bent gastheer/gastvrouw voor bezoekers;

  • Je beheert sleutels en keycards;

  • Je beheert dienstfietsen en sleutels/accessoires;

  • Je registreert bezoekers en zorgen voor een gastvrije ontvangst;

  • Je controleert op de zichtbaarheid van personeelspassen;

  • Je handelt bij interne meldingen.


Dit ben jij:

Als beveiliger van Eye Watch Security Group ben je altijd vriendelijk én daadkrachtig. Je bent een aanpakker met een glimlach. Ook ben je respectvol, geduldig en sociaal en weet je hoe je conflicten moet voorkomen.

Daarnaast voldoe je aan de volgende eisen:

  • Je hebt minimaal een MBO 2 Beveiliger diploma;

  • Minstens 1 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare beveiligingsfunctie;

  • BHV-certificering is een pre;

  • Je spreekt en schrijft goed de Nederlandse en Engelse taal;

  • Je woont in een straal van 40km van Moerdijk;

  • Je bent opmerkzaam en alert, en kunt zelfstandig werken;

  • Je hebt een goede fysieke conditie en kunt snel ter plaatse zijn bij noodgevallen;

Dit krijg jij van ons:

Frontrunners in beveiliging, want dat zijn wij. Daarom zorgen wij er ook voor dat onze medewerkers passend beloond worden.

  • Een marktconform salaris met uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden (max. €3.450 per maand o.b.v. 38 uur per week);

  • Reiskostenvergoeding en pensioenregeling

  • Mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke groei en ontwikkeling, inclusief trainingen zoals BHV;

  • Een prettige werkomgeving waar zowel veiligheid als gastvrijheid hoog in het vaandel staan.

Solliciteren

Zie jij jezelf als de ideale beveiliger met een gastvrije instelling? Solliciteer dan direct door je CV en motivatiebrief te sturen naar sollicitatie@eyewatchsecuritygroup.net. We kijken ernaar uit om jou te ontmoeten!

Head of Technology

Sydney | Permanent

Lead technology. Lead people. Build exceptional digital experiences.

Experience with Kentico, Umbraco, AI-assisted development, search, identity, accessibility or infrastructure as code would be a bonus.

title: Helpende Intramuraal Oostduin
description:
❤️ Maak elke dag het verschil als Helpende bij Florence!

Wil jij méér betekenen dan alleen goede zorg? Als Helpende (niveau 2) bij Oostduin zorg jij ervoor dat bewoners zich niet alleen goed verzorgd voelen, maar ook gezien, gehoord en thuis voelen.

Van helpen met wassen en aankleden tot samen een gezellig moment beleven: jij bent er voor onze bewoners. Je hebt oog voor wat zij nodig hebben, signaleert veranderingen in hun gezondheid en werkt samen met collega’s aan de beste zorg.

Dit maakt jouw werk bijzonder

  • 🌷 Persoonlijke aandacht voor iedere bewoner

  • 🤝 Samenwerken met betrokken en deskundige collega’s

  • 💚 Een warme werkomgeving waarin jouw talent telt

  • 📚 Ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en door te groeien

  • ✨ Een baan waarin kleine momenten een groot verschil maken

Heb jij een mbo-2 diploma Zorg en Welzijn en ervaring met ADL? Dan ben jij van harte welkom. Ook als je in het tweede leerjaar van Verzorgende IG of mbo-4 Verpleegkunde zit, zijn er mogelijkheden om bij ons te starten.

Jouw zorgtalent. Jouw aandacht. Jouw verschil.
Kom werken bij Florence en maak van goede zorg iets bijzonders.

Dit ga je doen

Als Helpende zorg je voor de dagelijkse ondersteuning van onze bewoners en bied je hen de zorg die ze nodig hebben. Dit betekent dat je helpt bij:

  • Het ondersteunen van bewoners bij dagelijkse activiteiten zoals wassen, aankleden, eten en drinken.

  • Zorgen voor een schone en veilige omgeving voor de bewoners.

  • Geven van emotionele en sociale steun, zodat bewoners zich op hun gemak voelen.

  • Opmerken van veranderingen in de gezondheid van bewoners en dit terugkoppelen naar het zorgteam.

Dit ben jij

‘Op je plek bij Florence’

Bij Florence ben je niet alleen, met een grote groep collega's zoals jij ga je elke uitdaging aan! Zoals alle collega's die werkzaam zijn bij Florence, staat jouw ontwikkeling centraal. Of je nu net je diploma op zak hebt, midden in je zorgopleiding zit of al jaren ervaring hebt: jouw ambitie en talent krijgen bij ons de ruimte om te groeien. Juist omdat Florence zo’n grote organisatie is, vind je altijd een team of functie die bij jou past!

  • Jij hebt een passie voor zorgen en vindt het geweldig om mensen echt te helpen.

  • Een diploma op mbo niveau 2 Zorg en Welzijn? Check. Ervaring met ADL? Dubbel check.

  • Jij maakt het verschil: je zorgt niet alleen, je maakt het gezellig.

  • Je ziet het meteen als er iets verandert in iemands gezondheid – en je onderneemt actie.

  • Student in leerjaar 2 van Verzorgende IG of MBO 4 Verpleegkunde? Met ADL en tilliften afgetekend kun je meteen bij ons aan de slag als helpende!

  • Al een medicatiemodule? Dan start je als helpende 2+. Nog niet? Wij bieden deze intern aan!

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Contract voor bepaalde tijd met uitzicht op vast

  • Je krijgt 8% vakantiegeld én een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%.

  • Ruimte voor vrije tijd: 237,4 vakantie-uren bij een fulltime dienstverband (36 uur).

  • We vergoeden je reiskosten met € 0,23 per kilometer.

  • Voor meer arbeidsvoorwaarden bekijk de CAO VVT.

Je kan altijd in ontwikkeling blijven. Florence heeft een eigen Talentcentrum en hanteert een actief mobiliteitsbeleid.

Dit is jouw werkplek

Woonzorglocatie Oostduin is gelegen in de rustige wijk Benoordenhout in Den Haag. Wij bieden hier deskundige zorg aan mensen met lichamelijke aandoeningen en aan mensen met dementie. Ons multidisciplinaire team werkt nauw samen om deze vaak kwetsbare bewoners de ondersteuning te bieden die zij nodig hebben. Iedere functie speelt hierin een essentiële rol. Het welzijn van onze bewoners staat daarbij centraal, net zo belangrijk als het bieden van de best mogelijke dagelijkse zorg.

Er wordt een afdeling opnieuw geopend wat maakt dat we samen door het hele huis weer gaan bouwen aan stabiele afdelingen waar het fijn is om met elkaar als team te werken!

Lead shift operations and maintenance activities for electrical and mechanical systems in the data center.

Identify safety risks and ensure compliance with all safety, health, and environmental regulations.

Maintain records, reports, and documentation in accordance with ISO and company standards.

Diploma or Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent.

Minimum 5 years’ experience in data center operations, semiconductor, power plant, or critical facility environment.

Strong understanding of electrical distribution systems, UPS, generators, and cooling systems.

Hands‑on experience in preventive/corrective maintenance and shift‑based operations.

Able to lead a team under rotating shifts and perform under pressure.

Proficient in English and Bahasa Malaysia.

Must be willing to work in Ulu Tiram, Johor.

We are sorry that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

description:

Join us in shaping the future of gaming. Are you ready to LEVEL-UP THE GAME?

Focusing on our Sportsbook product, we’re looking for a Data Engineer to help build and evolve our next-generation data platform, powering trusted, scalable, and near real-time data assets across multiple brands and markets.
You’ll work on our Sportsbook Data Platform — a modern, event-driven lakehouse built on AWS and aligned to medallion architecture principles — contributing to the development of high-quality, well-governed data assets that support analytics, trading insight, and machine learning use cases. This platform underpins critical decision‑making across trading, risk, personalisation, and analytics, and plays a key role in scaling and standardising our data ecosystem.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines, supporting ingestion, transformation, and serving layers.

  • Develop and enhance data assets aligned to medallion architecture (bronze, silver, gold), ensuring quality and usability.

  • Transform sportsbook domain data (bets, offers, rewards, digital data) into well-structured datasets for downstream consumption.

  • Contribute to streaming data pipelines (Kafka/Flink or equivalent) to support near real-time data use cases.

  • Apply data quality checks and validation to ensure accuracy and consistency of data assets.

  • Support the implementation of data contracts and schemas for reliable integration between systems.

  • Monitor and troubleshoot pipelines to ensure performance, reliability, and cost efficiency on AWS.

  • Collaborate with analytics, data science, and machine learning teams to deliver data solutions aligned to business needs.

  • Contribute to data governance practices, including documentation, metadata, and dataset discoverability.

What You’ll Work On

  • A modern sportsbook data platform built on AWS, supporting both real-time and batch data processing.

  • Medallion-aligned data layers transforming raw data into curated, business-ready datasets.

  • Data pipelines processing sportsbook events such as bets, pricing, and settlements.

  • Data assets supporting trading analytics, risk monitoring, and customer personalisation.

  • Integration with BI tools, semantic layers, and machine learning platforms.

  • Data governance and metadata tooling to improve transparency and trust in data.

Your Experience

  • 2–4 years experience in data engineering or a related field.

  • Strong SQL skills and a good understanding of data modelling principles.

  • Experience with data transformation tools (e.g. dbt, Spark) and workflow orchestration (e.g. Airflow or similar).

  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms, ideally AWS.

  • Understanding of data pipeline design and ETL/ELT patterns.

  • Exposure to streaming technologies (Kafka, Flink, or similar) is beneficial.

  • Awareness of data quality, testing, and monitoring practices.

  • Ability to work with stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver data solutions.

  • Willingness to learn and grow in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to sports betting, trading, or financial data domains.

  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures.

  • Experience with semantic layers or BI tooling.

  • Exposure to data governance or metadata tooling.

  • Interest in supporting machine learning or analytics workflows.

Why This Role Matters

This role contributes to building the trusted data foundation that powers analytics, trading insight, and machine learning across sportsbook. By delivering reliable and well-structured data assets, you’ll help enable better decision-making and support the continued evolution of our scalable, modern data platform.

We believe talent knows no boundaries. Our hiring process focuses solely on your skills, experience, and potential to contribute to our team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and evaluate each candidate based on merit, regardless of personal characteristics as the age, gender, origin, religion, sexual orientation, neurodiversity or disability.

title: Senior Research Scientist - AI Safety Evaluations
description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the Team

We are the central research and development team within Faculty's broader AI safety charter. Our group focuses on fundamental and applied technical AI safety research, producing rigorous scientific outputs - publications, tooling, technical reports & evaluations - that advance the theory, practice and understanding of AI risks, and directly inform the work of frontier AI labs, government agencies, and national security institutes.

Our research spans fundamental research using black-box and white-box approaches to understand and steer AI systems, to building and advancing safety evaluations which better understand and quantify risks in AI. We care deeply about mechanistic understanding and scientific rigour in measuring risks in AI systems. Current research threads include (but are not limited to) uncertainty calibration, goal drift, misinformation mitigation, steering vectors, robust safeguard measurement and the science of evaluations.

We collaborate closely with the Faculty's wider AI safety team, a group with a well-established track record in capability evaluations and red-teaming for misuse risk across CBRN, cybersecurity, societal and psychosocial harms. That work has been conducted for several leading frontier model developers and national safety institutes, and has been featured in model cards and safety reports from Anthropic, GDM, Meta & OpenAI.

About the role

As a Senior Research Scientist at Faculty, you will lead the development of cutting-edge safety evaluations to quantify AI risks in critical domains like CBRN and Cyber. Joining our high-impact R&D team, you will drive original research that advances safety methodology while collaborating with delivery teams building evaluations and red-teaming for frontier labs. This is a high-agency opportunity to conduct technical AI safety research that produces scientific outputs shaping the future of safe real-world AI deployment.

What you'll be doing

  • Leading the development of novel safety evaluations in high-impact domains such as CBRN and Cyber to quantify emerging risks.

  • Executing original technical research in AI safety evaluation methods, taking ideas from concept to publication.

  • Shaping the R&D agenda by identifying strategic opportunities to advance safety evaluation methodology across Faculty and the broader ecosystem.

  • Contributing thought leadership and deep technical expertise to client delivery projects, evaluation work, and red-teaming for frontier labs.

  • Representing Faculty’s scientific leadership through active external engagement with the global research community, frontier labs, and government stakeholders.

Who we're looking for

  • A track record of owning research end-to-end—from identifying novel problems to publication—driven by scientific curiosity and tenacity.

  • Hands-on experience designing and building AI evaluations or benchmarks, alongside a strong ability to reason about construct validity and mitigate confounds.

  • Expertise in red-teaming, adversarial testing, jailbreaking, indirect prompt injection, and assessing the robustness of model safeguards.

  • Strong foundational skills in experimental design, statistical analysis, and uncertainty quantification, including Bayesian methods.

  • Deep knowledge of language models, generative AI architectures, training methodologies, and safety mitigation techniques.

  • Solid Python proficiency combined with the engineering discipline required to build robust, reproducible research.

Nice to haves

  • Experience in threat and risk modelling.

  • Background or knowledge in high-risk domains such as CBRN or Cybersecurity.

  • A history of high-impact AI research, evidenced by top-tier publications or equivalent practical achievements.

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for a hands‑on DevOps Engineer to operate inside a AWS native banking environment. You will own the build, automation, and operational tooling that delivery teams rely on every day CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, environment provisioning, configuration management, and the developer experience that surrounds them.

This is an engineering role first. You will spend the majority of your time in code and configuration: writing pipelines, building automation, hardening environments, and removing manual toil from the path to production. You will work alongside developers, architects, security engineers, and platform teams to keep delivery flowing reliably inside a regulated, PCI‑DSS environment.

Site Reliability Engineering experience is a strong advantage. You will use it to push the platform further sharper observability, better incident response, lower failure domains, and resilience patterns built into the way services are deployed and run.

What you'll do:

Core DevOps Engineering

  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines that move code from commit to production safely and repeatably across the delivery estate.
  • Automate AWS workload provisioning and configuration deployment using infrastructure as code, with environments that are reproducible, version-controlled, and auditable.
  • Build and operate the deployment automation, release tooling, and environment management that delivery squads depend on day to day.
  • Harden the developer experience repository templates, pipeline templates, deployment patterns, and self‑service tooling that reduce friction without weakening control.
  • Integrate security and compliance controls into pipelines and infrastructure secrets management, access control, change traceability.
  • Translate business and technical requirements into scalable, automated delivery solutions that align to the AWS Well‑Architected Framework.

AWS & Platform Engineering

  • Work hands‑on across an AWS estate, integrating cloud‑native services with on‑premises systems where the banking environment requires it.
  • Build and operate workloads across EC2, RDS (EBS, EKS, ECS, Load Balancing, Secrets Manager, KMS, and Service Catalog.
  • Use AWS CDK as the primary infrastructure‑as‑code tool, with CloudFormation, Ansible, and scripting languages applied where they fit best.
  • Apply networking fundamentals routing, segmentation, security groups, DNS, TLS, and load balancing to design environments that are both secure and operable.
  • Support the operational lifecycle of platform services the wider engineering organisation depends on, including identity, messaging, and application server tiers where present.

Site Reliability Depth

Where SRE skills are present, the role expands to include the following. These responsibilities are not the primary requirement but will materially strengthen the contribution of an engineer who brings them.

  • Identify and reduce failure domains across the platform, designing systems that contain blast radius and recover gracefully from partial failure.
  • Apply SRE principles SLOs, post‑incident learning to improve reliability, performance, and the team's response to production issues.
  • Enhance observability across environments through stronger monitoring, structured logging, useful alerting, and dashboards that surface what matters during an incident.
  • Troubleshoot and optimise low‑latency, Java‑based applications in production, working alongside application engineers to resolve issues at the system
  • Build automation that minimises business impact during maintenance and failures, and that reduces the operational load carried by delivery teams.

Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Contribute as a strong technical voice in a cross‑functional team alongside Architects, Engineers, Business Analysts, Scrum Masters, and Security partners.
  • Mentor engineers across the team on DevOps practice, AWS engineering, automation, and where applicable SRE principles through pairing, code review, and worked examples.
  • Drive collaboration across squads, lifting the standard of automation, observability, and operational discipline beyond the immediate team.
  • Champion delivery excellence secure, automated, observable, and repeatable as the default way of working.

Your Expertise & Qualifications:

Essential Experience

  • 7+ years hands‑on experience in a DevOps or SRE role, with a clear weighting toward DevOps engineering, automation, and CI/CD delivery.
  • Hands‑on experience in AWS environment, preferably in financial services with PCI‑DSS compliant systems.
  • Demonstrable track record implementing CI/CD pipeline automation across functional areas of a delivery organisation.
  • Strong AWS workload automation experience covering infrastructure provisioning and software configuration rollout.
  • Practical experience implementing observability for hybrid and cloud‑based environments.
  • Strong working knowledge of networking principles and protocols.
  • Working understanding of the AWS Well‑Architected Framework and how to apply it in practice.

Advantageous Experience

  • Demonstrable experience with Site Reliability Engineering principles and practices in production environments.
  • Troubleshooting low‑latency, Java‑based applications in an SRE context and infrastructure‑level performance investigation.
  • Experience operating inside an audit‑heavy regulated environment beyond PCI‑DSS change control, evidence capture, segregation of duties.

Ways of Working

  • A hands‑on engineer at heart most effective when the work is in pipelines, code, and configuration rather than in process documents.
  • Pragmatic about automation automates what matters, leaves what doesn't, and knows the difference.
  • Strong collaborator across engineering, security, and operations, with the ability to translate technical decisions into language non‑engineers can act on.
  • Holds the line on operational and security discipline without becoming a blocker to delivery.

Technology and Tooling

Essential

  • AWS Services: EC2, RDS, EBS, EKS, ECS, Load Balancing, Secrets Manager, KMS, Service Catalog.
  • AWS CDK.
  • Observability tooling: AWS CloudWatch, Splunk or AppDynamics, ELK.
  • CI/CD platforms (Harness, Azure DevOps, GitLab, or equivalent).
  • Operating Systems: Linux and Windows Server.

Preferred

  • Python scripting.
  • AWS CloudFormation.
  • Bash scripting.

Optional

  • Zabbix monitoring.
  • WebLogic 14c.

Certifications (Beneficial)

  • AWS Certified SysOps Administrator (CloudOps Engineer).
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.

Other information applicable to the opportunity:

  • Location: Sandton
  • Work Policies: Hybrid - 3 Days in office (Client Based)

Why work for us?

Want to work for an organization that solves complex real-world problems with innovative software solutions? At iOCO, we believe anything is possible with modern technology, software, and development expertise. We are continuously pushing the boundaries of innovative solutions across multiple industries using an array of technologies.

You will be part of a consultancy, working with some of the most knowledgeable minds in the industry on interesting solutions across different business domains.

Our culture of continuous learning will ensure that you will have all the opportunities, tools, and support to hone and grow your craft.

By joining IOCO you will have an open invitation to developer inspiring forums. A place where you will be able to connect and learn from and with your peers by sharing ideas, experiences, practices, and solutions.

Vuonna 2023 Tokmanni-konsernin liikevaihto oli 1 392,7 miljoonaa euroa ja vertailukelpoinen liikevoitto 98,8 miljoonaa euroa. Tokmanni Group Oyj:n osakkeet on listattu Nasdaq Helsingin pörssilistalle. Meille tokmannilaisille on tärkeää, että toimimme vastuullisesti ja tehokkaasti ympäristöstä ja ihmisistä välittäen. Kannustamme sekä autamme henkilöstöämme kehittämään osaamistaan ja panostamme hyvään yhteishenkeen. Avaamme jatkuvasti uusia myymälöitä ja rekrytoimme uusia osaajia. Etsimme joukkoomme erilaisilla osaamistaustoilla varustettuja henkilöitä monenlaisiin työtehtäviin. www.tokmanni.fi https://tyopaikat.tokmanni.fi/

Hei!

Nyt on maailman paras ostaja hankkinut hyllyt täyteen laatutuotteita ja meillä on tarjolla työpaikkoja asiakaspalveluhenkisille ja vauhdikkaasta työstä nauttiville työkavereille! Haluatko sinä mukaan ystävälliseen porukkaamme?

Kassa-myyjänä pääset yhdessä työkavereidesi kanssa varmistamaan asiakkaillemme mukavan ja mutkattoman asiointikokemuksen Tokmannin myymälässä.

Monipuolinen työpäiväsi sisältää asiakaspalvelua kassalla ja myymälässä, tuotteiden hyllytystä, tuotteiden esillelaiton suunnittelua ja toteutusta sekä myymälän viihtyisyydestä huolehtimista. Tässä tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään erityisesti pukeutumisen sekä kodin ja sisustamisen osastoilla. Tärkeä osa työtäsi on myymälässämme asioivien asiakkaidemme auttaminen erilaisissa kysymyksissä, ja aina autamme myös toisiamme, kun tiimissä tarvitaan apua.

Työ alkaa mahdollisemman pian ja työaika on 30 h/vko. Sinulla on meillä työskennellessäsi myös mahdollisuus tehdä osa sopimuksesi tunneista tai lisätunteja työskentelemällä lähimyymälöissäsi. Täytämme tehtävän heti, kun löydämme sopivan työkaverin joukkoomme, joten toimithan pian!



Voit olla etsimämme työkaveri, jos olet täysi-ikäinen ja sinulla on:

- Iloinen asiakaspalveluasenne
- Hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja yhteistyökyvyt sekä sosiaalista pelisilmää
- Halu toimia liikkuvassa ja vauhdikkaassa työssä
- Oma-aloitteinen ja asioita tehokkaasti loppuun saattava työskentelytyyli
- Mahdollisuus työskennellä vaihtelevissa työvuoroissa arkisin ja viikonloppuisin
- Halu tehdä työsi hyvin, ylpeyttä omasta ammattitaidostasi sekä kiinnostusta oman ammattitaidon kehittämiseen - Kyky palvella asiakkaitamme suomenkielellä; hyvä englannin kielen taito lasketaan eduksi

Kassa-myyjän työssä vastaanotetaan ja siirrellään painaviakin tuotteita kumarrellen ja kurkottaen, joten työssä tarvitaan hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja liikkuvuutta.

Kaupallinen koulutus ja kokemus kaupan alalta katsotaan eduksesi, mutta tärkeintä meille on positiivinen asenteesi sekä aito kiinnostus kaupan alaa ja myymälätyöskentelyä kohtaan.Tarkkailethan sähköpostiasi hakemuksen jättämisen jälkeen ja muista kurkata myös roskapostikansio, joskus rekrytointiviestimme saattavat vahingossa päätyä sinne.



Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?
- Yhdessä tekemistä ja onnistumista
- Avointa, kannustavaa ja mukavaa työyhteisöä
- Ihmisistä ja ympäristöstä välittämistä
- Kilpailukykyistä palkkaa ja henkilöstöetuja
- Valmennus- ja koulutusmahdollisuuksia
- Uusia haasteita ja urapolkuja
- Kehittymiseen kannustamista virheitä pelkäämättä
- Monipuolisia ja vaihtelevia työtehtäviä
- Työhyvinvointia ja -turvallisuutta
