Als Servicemonteur Elektrotechniek:

Ben je iedere dag ergens anders bezig. De ene dag los je een storing op in een kantoorgebouw, de volgende dag voer je grootonderhoud uit of pak je kleinere elektroklussen op. Je werkomgeving zijn utiliteits- en kantoorgebouwen in de branches: overheid, onderwijs, gemeente, retail, bouw en zorg.

Je maakt deel uit van een serviceteam waar collega’s elkaar helpen en kennis delen. Zelf ga je op pad in de regio Tilburg-Breda, doorgaans binnen circa 45 minuten van huis. Bij de klant zoek je uit wat er aan de hand is en zorg je dat het wordt opgelost. En kom je er bij een lastige storing niet direct uit? Dan is er altijd een collega die met je meedenkt!

Jouw werkzaamheden:

• Het opsporen en oplossen van elektrotechnische storingen;

• Uitvoeren van onderhoudswerkzaamheden;

• Werken aan kleine elektrotechnische projecten en aanpassingen;

• Controleren en testen van installaties;

• Contact houden met klanten op locatie;

Je werkzaamheden en bevindingen administratief bijhouden.

Jij past bij TES als je:

• In bezit bent van een mbo-diploma Elektrotechniek;

• Minimaal twee jaar ervaring hebt als elektromonteur;

• Het leuk vindt om storingen uit te pluizen en problemen op te lossen;

• Graag zelfstandig werkt en houdt van klantcontact;

• Verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor je werk en administratie.

Wij zijn TES Groep:

Een full-service installatiebedrijf met ongeveer 170 medewerkers. Vanuit verschillende disciplines werken wij aan elektrotechnische totaaloplossingen voor uiteenlopende opdrachtgevers. Van ontwerp en realisatie tot service, onderhoud en inspectie: TES is betrokken bij de volledige levenscyclus van installaties.

Wij werken onder andere voor overheden, onderwijsinstellingen, gemeenten, retail, bouwbedrijven en zorginstellingen. TES besteedt veel aandacht aan de mens én diens individuele ontwikkeling: opleidingen, ontwikkeling, doorgroei en het delen van kennis. Samen brengen we techniek tot leven!


Klaar voor je volgende stap?

Bij TES werk je niet alleen aan installaties, maar ook aan je eigen ontwikkeling. Zo kun je bijvoorbeeld doorgroeien naar eerste servicemonteur en inspecteur.

Met volop mogelijkheden voor technische opleidingen en specialistische certificeringen zoals SCIOS Scope, KNX, brandmeld- en beveiligingstechniek (MBV/TBV), NEN 3140 en NEN 1010 blijf jij bouwen aan je toekomst!

Zie jij jezelf al op pad gaan naar de volgende storing? Solliciteer dan direct of neem contact op met Sanne Becht van Forp, via 06 58 88 46 48 of sanne@forp.nl. Twijfel je of deze functie bij je past? Bel of app Sanne gerust even, een cv is niet direct nodig.

title: Research Engineer in Quantum Computing for Finance - EDHEC Quantum Institute H/F (Postdoctoral Level)
description:
Founded in 1906, EDHEC is now ranked among the top 10 business schools in Europe. With campuses in Lille, Nice, Paris, London and Singapore, and over 90 nationalities represented across its campuses, EDHEC is a truly international institution directly connected to the business world.

With a network of more than 60,000 alumni across 143 countries, EDHEC educates committed leaders capable of addressing the challenges of a rapidly changing world. Driven by its core values of excellence, innovation and entrepreneurship, the School has developed a strategic model based on research that delivers tangible value to society, businesses and students.

This culture is reflected in the work of the EDHEC-Risk Climate Impact Institute, the EDHEC NewGen Talent Centre, the EDHEC Infrastructure & Private Assets Institute, and the recently established Management in Innovative Health Chair.

The School operates as a genuine ideas laboratory and plays a pioneering role in digital education through EDHEC Online, the first fully online degree-granting learning platform.

Together, these strengths make EDHEC a centre of knowledge, experience and diversity, dedicated to preparing the next generation of managers to excel in a rapidly evolving world.

EDHEC in numbers:

  • 9,400 students enrolled in academic programmes
  • More than 20 degree programmes, from Bachelor to PhD level
  • 175 professors and researchers
  • 13 specialised research centres and chairs



Ce qui suit couvre tout ce que vous devez savoir sur cette opportunité, ainsi que ce qui est attendu des candidats.


EDHEC Business School is recruiting a Research Engineer in Quantum Computing for Finance - EDHEC Quantum Institute (M/F). This is a full-time permanent position (CDI) based on the Nice campus.



The EDHEC Quantum Institute (EQI) is a pioneering initiative of EDHEC Business School dedicated to translating quantum innovation into tangible value for business and society. Structured around applied research, education, innovation, and outreach, the Institute builds bridges between quantum science, industry, and economic decision-making, with a particular focus on finance and financial services. EQI is recruiting a Research Engineer at postdoctoral level to conduct applied research on quantum computing and quantum-inspired methods for finance. Under the direct supervision of Professor Lionel Martellini, Director of the Institute, the successful candidate will work closely with industrial partners from the financial sector and the quantum technology ecosystem. The role combines rigorous research, algorithm development, experimental benchmarking, and industry-oriented proof-of-concept design.



Main Responsibilities

  • Conduct applied research on quantum and quantum-inspired approaches to portfolio optimization, asset and signal selection, risk analytics, derivatives pricing, Monte Carlo simulation, and machine learning.
  • Translate economically relevant finance use cases into precise computational problems and determine whether their structure is genuinely suitable for quantum methods.
  • Design, implement, and benchmark algorithms using classical baselines, quantum-inspired solvers, quantum annealers, simulators, and gate-based quantum processors, as appropriate.
  • Assess solution quality, computational scaling, data-loading requirements, hardware constraints, error sensitivity, and end-to-end resource needs against the best available classical alternatives.
  • Collaborate with financial institutions and quantum technology providers to define research questions, milestones, proof-of-concept protocols, deliverables, and success criteria.
  • Develop reproducible research code and contribute to academic papers, technical reports, industry white papers, research proposals, and shared experimental workflows.
  • Present findings to specialist and executive audiences and support the supervision of interns, graduate students, or junior researchers when required.


Profil

  • PhD in quantum computing, quantum information science, computer science, applied mathematics, operations research, physics, financial engineering, or a closely related field; postdoctoral or equivalent research experience preferred.
  • Strong foundations in at least two of the following: combinatorial optimization, numerical linear algebra, probability and stochastic simulation, machine learning, algorithm design, or computational finance.
  • Demonstrated ability to implement and evaluate advanced algorithms in Python; experience with Qiskit, PennyLane, Cirq, D-Wave Ocean, or comparable frameworks is highly desirable.
  • Clear understanding of the distinction between theoretical speedup, hardware-level performance, and end-to-end practical advantage, with a commitment to evidence-based assessment and avoidance of quantum overclaiming.
  • Knowledge of financial applications is desirable. Candidates from quantum science or computer science must be willing to acquire the necessary finance expertise; candidates from finance must demonstrate substantial quantum computing competence.
  • Strong research record evidenced by publications, working papers, open-source software, conference contributions, or technically demanding industrial projects.
  • Ability to work autonomously and collaboratively in interdisciplinary teams; excellent written and spoken English. xtajcwe French is an advantage but is not required.

title: Staff Designer, Marketplace Product
description:
Brief info about Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information about the position

Vinted is Europe's largest secondhand fashion platform. The Marketplace team owns the core experience: how people discover, list, buy, and sell.

We're hiring a Staff Product Designer to raise the design bar and bring strategic clarity to some of the most complex problems in the product. You'll join the Marketplace product design leadership team and be part of the craft leadership group, alongside a fellow Staff Product Designer, Staff Design Technologist, and Senior Product Designers from across domains.

In this position, you’ll

  • Be accountable for projects that land measurable impact. You define what the right work is. You don't wait for it to be scoped for you.
  • Raise the capability of ICs in your area. You make this happen through pair work, critique, and direct coaching.
  • Help other functions start thinking like designers. As a result of your impact, PMs and engineers actively reference design principles in their own decisions. You earn this through osmosis, not training decks.
  • Drive how design standards evolve. You own the bar and raise it as the business, tech, and user context changes.
  • Make AI-powered ways of working real for the team. You experiment, systematise, and communicate. You also reason clearly about what AI changes for users, not just for internal workflows.
  • Turn ambiguous signals into investable opportunities. You are expected to build the case and move senior stakeholders to commit, not just surface options.
  • Produce work that is above the current team bar. Others calibrate to it.
  • Earn the trust of senior leaders. You’ll do this through sound judgment, clear narratives, and the confidence to help them make big bets on design.

About you

  • Strong proven experience (typically 10+ years) of product design for consumer-scale digital products. Marketplace experience is a strong plus.
  • A portfolio that shows taste, judgment, and shipped impact.
  • You move work forward without being asked. You're as comfortable doing as directing.
  • Hands-on with AI in your actual workflow: design, prototyping, and automation. You use it, not just discuss it.
  • Sharp eye for quality. You know when the last 1% matters and when it doesn't.
  • Steady when the work gets slow, contested, or unglamorous.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity. You know when to go deep and when to ship.
  • A strong point of view and the ability to adjust it.
  • You've changed how an organisation works, not just what it shipped.

Work perks

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

At Revlon, we create beauty innovations for everyone that inspire confidence and ignite joy every day.

Breaking beauty boundaries is in our company’s DNA. Since its game-changing launch of the first opaque nail enamel in 1932 (and later, the first long-wear foundation), Revlon has provided consumers with high-quality product innovation, performance, and sophisticated glamour. Elizabeth Arden made waves as a woman-led beauty company in the 1920s. In 1931, Almay became the original hypoallergenic, fragrance-free beauty brand.

Today, Revlon resiliently continues its legacy as a leading global beauty company. Our diverse portfolio—which consists of some of the world’s most iconic brands and product offerings in color cosmetics, skincare, hair color & care, personal care, and fragrances—is sold around the world through prestige, professional, mass, and direct-to-consumer retail channels. These brands include Revlon, Revlon Professional, Elizabeth Arden, Almay, American Crew, CND, Cutex, Mitchum, Sinful Colors, Creme of Nature, Christina Aguilera, John Varvatos, Juicy Couture, Ed Hardy and more.

title: Data Strategy & Analytics Specialist
description:
_A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche._

This role is based in the Real-World & Clinical Data Strategy (RWCDS) team which drives data excellence and analytics to power enhanced decision-making and evidence-generation within Roche Product Development. We develop and implement data strategies that unlock the value of clinical, operational, and real-world data to accelerate evidence generation, decision-making, and innovation across PD and beyond. By embedding FAIR principles, advancing data governance, and enabling data productization, RWCDS ensures that data is not only findable and usable, but also a driver of scientific rigor, regulatory readiness, and AI-powered transformation. Through deep partnerships with internal functions and external collaborators, we shape a future-ready data ecosystem that supports personalized healthcare and efficient drug development.

**The Opportunity:**

The **Data Strategy & Analytics Specialist** contributes to the design and execution of data strategies and analyses that enable decision-making and insight generation across a therapeutic area or molecule portfolio. Working under the Data Strategy & Analytics Lead, you will partner with cross-functional teams—translating scientific protocols into robust analytical code, cohort extractions, and reproducible pipelines using multi-modal real-world data and clinical assets. You will also contribute to the translation of scientific and business needs into analytical frameworks and data-driven solutions. This role demands strong core data science skills, analytical execution, and a growth mindset to continuously elevate team standards.

- You execute data transformations, cohort extractions, and descriptive/observational analyses leveraging real-world (EHR, Claims, etc.), clinical trial data for secondary use, and operational multi-modal domains
- You translate analytical or study requirements into cohort definitions, derived variables, and analysis-ready datasets.
- You follow state-of-the-art coding best practices, version control, unit testing, and structured QC routines to guarantee fully reproducible analytical pipelines.
- You summarize and visualize exploratory analytical outputs, cohort characteristics, and study results to communicate findings effectively to project teams.
- You partner seamlessly with RWD Scientists and cross-functional study leads during study framing and protocol development, providing active feedback on data availability, feasibility, methodology, and execution.
- You actively contribute well-documented code snippets, analytical templates, and learnings to the internal team repository.
- You assist in identifying fit-for-purpose real-world data (RWD) sources, performing data quality evaluations, terminology mappings, and schema transformations for secondary data use.
- You partner with study teams and central data engineering functions to gather analysis requirements, specify derived variables (e.g., ADaM, ARDs), and shape clinical trial datamarts for secondary use.
- You collaborate with central data engineering and governance teams to guide multi-modal data integration, applying common data models (OMOP, CDISC) and structured mappings across clinical trial and real-world assets.
- You collaborate with internal partners to analyze data structures, document data lineage, and maintain structured, compliant, and accessible data assets to support long-term data strategy and reusability.
- You safely leverage modern AI coding tools and LLM assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot) to accelerate scripting, query building, and data extraction while maintaining scientific rigor and code quality.

**Who you are:**

- You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Informatics, Life Sciences, Computer Science, or a related field
- You have 2+ years of experience working with structured data in a research or healthcare setting
- You have solid working knowledge of R or Python, as well as SQL
- You understand data dictionaries, mappings, or metadata tagging
- You are familiar with data systems used in clinical or operational settings
- You demonstrate capacity for independent thinking and ability to make decisions based upon sound principles
- You exhibit excellent strategic agility including problem-solving and critical thinking skills, and agility that extends beyond the technical domain
- You demonstrate respect for cultural differences when interacting with colleagues in the global workplace
- You possess excellent verbal and written communication skills, specifically in the areas of presentation and writing, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in clear language

**Preferred Qualifications:**

- Working knowledge of descriptive statistical methods and epidemiological concepts used in observational healthcare research (e.g., cohort identification, censoring, time-to-event concepts).
- Prior experience in cardiovascular, renal, or metabolic (CVRM) therapeutic areas.
- Familiarity with clinical terminologies and coding systems, including ICD, SNOMED CT, RxNorm, CPT, and HCPCS.
- Exposure to real-world data common data models (e.g., OMOP CDM) or CDISC standards (SDTM, ADaM).
- Familiarity with software engineering best practices (Git, unit testing) and AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot).

**Location:**

- This position is based in Boston, Massachusetts. Relocation benefits are not available for this posting

_The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Massachusetts is $89,400.00 - $166,000.00 USD Annual.  Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law.  A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance.  This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below._

description:
Our vision is to give everyone the belief they can make their move. We aim to make moving simpler, by giving everyone the best place to turn to and return to for access to the tools, expertise, trust, and belief to make it happen.

We’re home to the UK’s largest choice of properties and are the go-to destination for millions of people planning their next move, reading the latest industry news, or just browsing what’s on the market.

Reporting to: Data Engineering Manager

The Role

Millions of people visit the Rightmove website every month. We have a huge amount of data about how people use the site, and what this means to our customers.

You’ll be joining our growing Data Engineering & Infrastructure team, a collaborative, high-performing group of engineers that uses this data to build the infrastructure that powers the UK’s favourite property site.

In this role, you will take ownership of the systems and infrastructure that ingest, process, and serve data across Rightmove. You will be responsible for the infrastructure, tooling, and engineering practices that power our data ecosystem, including data ingestion, orchestration, storage, and the developer experience for data producers and consumers.

You will bring strong hands‑on expertise to our GCP‑based data platform, design reusable patterns and tools, write robust Python and SQL, and deploy infrastructure with Terraform, while influencing the standards and technical decisions that the wider data engineering team works to.

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will be a technical leader and multiplier within the data platform team. You will own the infrastructure, frameworks, and internal tooling that power Rightmove’s data ecosystem. You will contribute to the technical direction for how data is ingested, processed, and served across the business, and consistently apply and promote engineering best practices that raise the quality of the team’s work.

Join an inclusive and collaborative engineering culture where you'll work alongside talented engineers, tackle complex technical challenges, and continue to grow your skills. You'll leverage a modern GCP stack and apply your data engineering expertise to build products and services used by millions across the UK every day.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Define the technical approach to our most complex and ambiguous data challenges, setting direction where others would wait for clarity, making high‑quality architectural decisions, and ensuring the right trade‑offs are made for the long‑term health of the platform
  • Own the end-to-end technical leadership of cross‑functional projects, from shaping requirements with product owners and domain teams through to delivery. Take accountability for outcomes, not just the engineering contribution
  • Design and build data platform infrastructure and internal tooling, contributing to the architectural direction for how teams across Rightmove work with data
  • Own the design and evolution of reusable batch and real‑time data ingestion and processing frameworks, ensuring they are reliable, scalable, and serve the needs of teams across the business
  • Manage infrastructure, security and code deployment with Terraform and CI/CD pipelines
  • Optimise performance, scalability, and cost efficiency of our data platform
  • Champion engineering best practices across the team, including testing, documentation, and observability, share knowledge and support others through code reviews and technical discussions, helping raise the bar and embed standards in how the team works
  • Partner with engineers, data scientists, and analytics teams to enable self‑service data workflows, acting as a technical enabler and setting the patterns others follow

We're Looking For Someone Who

  • Has a strong track record of delivering significant impact in data engineering or data platform engineering, with deep experience building and operating large‑scale, cloud‑based data platforms
  • Thrives in ambiguity, able to define the problem, identify the right technical approach, and drive complex cross‑functional projects to completion without needing fully formed requirements
  • Is a strong Python and SQL engineer, with mastery of software engineering fundamentals, and is able to raise the standard across the team
  • Has deep, hands‑on experience with GCP (or comparable cloud platforms) and managing infrastructure as code with Terraform, and can influence how the team approaches cloud engineering
  • Has a strong track record of designing, building, and operating production‑grade data pipelines and real‑time processing frameworks at scale
  • Has built and managed CI/CD pipelines for data and infrastructure, and can lead the team in adopting reliable, automated deployment practices
  • Has a track record of raising the technical bar across the team through introducing better practices, leading technical reviews, and driving engineering improvements that outlast individual projects
  • Has knowledge of GDPR and data security best practices
  • Understands data storage, data modelling principles, best practices and tools (e.g. dbt)
  • Communicates with clarity and confidence, able to lead design discussions, articulate technical trade‑offs to non‑technical stakeholders, and build alignment across teams
  • Is curious, self‑directed, and proactive, identifying problems before they are assigned, and drives improvements to the platform without being asked

About Rightmove

Our vision is to give everyone the belief they can make their move. We aim to make moving simpler by giving everyone the best place to turn to and return to for access to the tools, expertise, trust and belief to make it happen.

We're home to the UK's largest choice of properties, and are the go‑to destination for millions of people planning their next move, reading the latest industry news, or just browsing what's on the market.

Despite this growth, we’ve remained a friendly, supportive place to work, with employee #1 still working here! We’ve done this by placing the Rightmove Hows at the heart of everything we do. These are the essential values that reflect our culture, and include:

We believe in careers that open doors and help our team develop by providing an open and inclusive work environment, offering ongoing training opportunities, and supporting charity fundraising events. If all this has caught your eye, you may well be a Rightmover in the making… People are the foundation of Rightmove - We’ll help you build a career on it.

title: Junior Data Engineer
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Junior Data Engineer to join our technology team. You will develop, test, maintain and support defined data engineering components and solutions, with guidance from experienced engineers. You will build practical experience across data pipelines, integrations, data quality and operational support while demonstrating increasing independence and delivering accurate, fit-for-purpose outcomes.

What You’ll Be Trusted With

Data Engineering & Solution Delivery

Develop, test, maintain and support defined data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, integrations and datasets. Assist with the design and implementation of data solutions in line with approved architecture, governance and OMIG engineering standards. Clarify requirements with the Product Owner, stakeholders and team members, and deliver assigned work within agreed iterations. Demonstrate increasing independence while seeking guidance when requirements, standards or technical approaches are unclear.

Engineering Quality & Standards

Produce maintainable code that follows approved coding, source-control, testing and documentation standards. Keep development changes source controlled in accordance with the agreed Git workflow. Resolve review feedback timeously and apply lessons from previous reviews to future work. Validate data accuracy and contribute to reliable, fit-for-purpose outcomes.

Agile Delivery & Collaboration

Participate fully in Agile events and the release train, maintain accurate Jira records and keep assigned work current. Communicate progress, blockers, risks, dependencies and support needs timeously. Work constructively with business stakeholders, software engineers and data consumers to resolve clearly defined issues.

Risk, Governance & Control

Apply required security, access, data-governance, change-control and evidence requirements to assigned work. Identify and elevate control gaps, non-compliance or uncertainty before implementation. Follow approved release, change and recovery processes.

Operational Reliability & Support

Monitor and support assigned solutions in line with documented support and escalation procedures. Respond to incidents within agreed processes, document findings and assist with troubleshooting and root-cause analysis. Contribute to preventative improvements, monitoring and support documentation.

Learning & Continuous Improvement

Broaden technical capability through structured learning, coaching and practical application. Contribute to documentation, knowledge sharing, automation and practical improvements to team processes and solutions. Remain open to constructive feedback and demonstrate growing independence in delivery, testing, troubleshooting and production support.

Who you are

As production volumes increase and new production lines come online, we need to automate more of the testing process - from controlling test equipment and collecting measurements to storing, analysing, and visualising the data. You will help us build that automation.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you will work at the intersection of battery testing, software, hardware and production. You will develop automated test solutions, integrate equipment and instruments, and make sure the data we generate is reliable and traceable.

What you will own

  • Develop and maintain automated battery tests for cells, modules and packs.

  • Automate manual testing processes, from test execution and data collection to analysis and reporting.

  • Integrate and control test equipment such as battery cyclers, power supplies, loads, DAQ systems and climate chambers.

  • Write and maintain Python or LabVIEW software and work with protocols such as CAN, SCPI or Modbus.

  • Define and implement tests for capacity, cycling, voltage, impedance testing, imbalance and other battery characteristics.

  • Support end-of-line testing, including pass/fail limits, traceability and test cycle time.

  • Build and maintain test data storage and pipelines, ensuring results can be linked to individual batteries and serial numbers.

  • Analyse test results and improve test reliability, repeatability and throughput as production scales.

  • Work closely with hardware, production and engineering teams to turn testing needs into reliable automated solutions.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field.

  • 3+ years of experience in test automation, automated testing, production testing, laboratory automation or a similar engineering environment.

  • Experience working with test data and databases, including structuring, storing and retrieving data generated by automated tests.

  • Strong programming experience in Python or LabVIEW.

  • A good understanding of lithium-ion cells and battery packs - including capacity, voltage, internal resistance, state of charge/health, ageing and thermal effects.

  • Experience with battery testing, such as capacity testing, cycling, DCIR, OCV, resistance, voltage and imbalance measurements.

  • Experience integrating software with test instruments, measurement equipment or production machinery.

  • Experience with CAN, SCPI, Modbus or similar communication protocols.

  • Good technical problem-solving skills and the ability to turn a manual testing process into a reliable automated solution.

  • Comfortable working hands-on with hardware, software and test equipment.

  • Experience scaling automated testing in a high-volume or ramping-up manufacturing environment.

Additional information

  • Working language: English. Our team spans 10+ nationalities.

  • Work authorization: EU right to work required.

  • Interview process: Intro call with Recruiter → Technical interview day with Hiring Manager + team (60 + 45 min, on-site) → Offer.

What we offer

  • 8% holiday allowance, travel reimbursement, and pension via PMT

  • A startup culture with team outings and events

Yksikössämme on elokuussa vähintään viisi ryhmää 1-5-vuotiaille (Jänikset, Karhut, Metsähiiret, Ahmat ja Sopulit) sekä kaksi esiopetusryhmää (Pöllöt ja Ketut). Tulet työskentelemään Karhuissa 3-5-vuotiaiden lasten erityisopettajana.

Työkavereinasi ovat pedagogisesti taitavat työntekijät (varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja ja varhaiskasvatuksen lastenhoitaja). Ryhmässä on sensitiivinen, selkeä ja kuvin strukturoitu toimintakulttuuri. Muiden ryhmien kanssa tehdään tiivistä yhteistyötä, ja auttaminen yli ryhmärajojen kuuluu yhteisömme voimavaroihin.

Koulumestarin päiväkoti on yhteistyökykyinen, kehittämismyönteinen ja keskusteleva yhteisö, jossa lapsen kasvuun, kehitykseen ja oppimiseen halutaan keskittyä. Hyvä kasvatusyhteistyö huoltajien kanssa on meille tärkeää. Kehitämme pedagogiikkaa opettajien, lastenhoitajien ja sosionomien pedagogisissa tiimeissä. Koulumestari muodostaa yhteisen kokonaisuuden Mikkelän päiväkodin kanssa, jota luotsaavat johtaja yhdessä apulaisjohtajan kanssa. Meille johtajille tärkeää laadukkaan pedagogiikan lisäksi on työntekijöiden hyvinvointi.

Varhaiskasvatuksen erityisopettajan työ on monipuolista ja innostavaa. Vastaat tiimisi kanssa Karhujen ryhmän pedagogisesta suunnittelusta, toteutuksesta, arvioinnista ja kehittämisestä. Työnne tarkoituksena on tukea lapsen osallisuutta ryhmän toimintaan, kokea onnistumisia ja mahdollistaa inkluusion toteutumista lapsiryhmässä. Havainnointi, dokumentointi ja toiminnan jatkuva arviointi sekä kehittäminen kuuluvat työhönne kiinteästi.

Käsittelemme hakemuksia ja haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana. Teemme valinnan heti kelpoisen, tehtävään soveltuvan henkilön löydyttyä. Haethan tehtävää mahdollisimman pian!

Tämä työpaikka on esteetön.

Varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan kelpoisuus. Lisäksi suoritettuna erityisopetuksen tehtäviin ammatillisia valmiuksia antavat opinnot.

title: Data Engineer
description:
About Us

We are the Information Intelligence Group (IIG) of CACI UK, a specialist technical consultancy providing bespoke solutions to solve complex operational problems. Due to some exciting growth within our business, we are interested in speaking with an experienced Data Engineer to join us.

Role Location

You can work from any of our 5 offices in the UK (including Bristol, Cheltenham & London) or from home, you decide. The role will involve occasional travel to meet customers.

About The Role

As a Data Engineer at CACI IIG, you join a community of dedicated engineers who deliver cutting edge solutions for our public sector customers across Central Government, Defence, National Security and Critical National Infrastructure. You will collaborate closely with our clients to design and maintain robust, scalable data pipelines that guarantee data availability, accuracy, and performance for analytics and operational decision-making. In addition, you’ll help shape the data engineering roadmap by driving research, defining technical strategy, aligning with business priorities, and influencing key decisions.

This role will be focussed on the delivery of high priority projects where you will be supporting our customers across the full project lifecycle from initiation to conclusion. Working with a broad range of technical tools, you will be support with compliance to data governance, standards and qualify frameworks.

Key Responsibilities Will Include

  • Interpret and validate data requirements, gather and analyse large-scale structured datasets, and perform profiling within data environments to ensure accuracy and completeness.
  • Design and implement ETL frameworks to ingest, transform, validate, normalize, and cleanse data, ensuring it meets business and technical needs.
  • Apply data quality controls and prepare datasets for visualisation, implementing data models and manage storage solutions like Amazon S3, Azure Blob Storage, BigQuery, or Snowflake.
  • Support the development of data management standards and policies, including techniques for data synthesis and anonymisation to maintain compliance and security.
  • Develop robust data models to support analytics and reporting within secure environments.
  • Delivering performance optimisation through the monitoring and tuning of data workflows for speed, cost efficiency, and reliability.
  • Establish and refine best practices in data engineering, while contributing to advanced analytics and visualization strategies through research, evaluation of emerging technologies, and presentation of findings to stakeholders.

The Fit

The ideal candidate will have a background of working with industry best practices for data management, security, scalability, and awareness of Data Standards, Interoperability, Data Governance, and Data Sharing across security domains. We are looking for someone who is passionate about technology, enjoys problem-solving, and has a collaborative mindset.

Additional Skills Include

  • Proven experience as a Data Engineer within complex environments.
  • Strong knowledge of data management principles, including data modelling, integration, and governance.
  • Ability to assess existing data management systems and recommend improvements.
  • Experience working with Snowflake.
  • Familiarity with modern data architectures (e.g., cloud-based, distributed systems).
  • Proficiency in SQL, Python, and data pipeline tools (e.g., Apache Airflow, Spark).
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and big data technologies.
  • Awareness and evidence of Data Analytics and Visualisation.

Due to the industries we work in, we require the successful candidate to be able to obtain high level security clearance. To qualify for this, you must be a British citizen and have lived permanently in the UK for the last 5 years.

Why work for us?

Benefits

IIG has the culture and feel of a small business, paired with the benefits of our position in a much larger organisation. The Data Engineer role is an excellent opportunity, and CACI reward their staff well with a competitive salary and impressive benefits package which includes:

  • Flexi-time: 37.5 hour weeks to structure how you want.
  • Hybrid working: Work from one of our offices or from home - you choose
  • L&D: Budget for conferences, training courses and other materials.
  • Social: Fantastic culture with monthly social events.
  • Future You: Matched pension and health care package.

As a Data Engineer, career development and ongoing training is a key part of your growth. You will be expected to take significant ownership of your career and proactively take the steps which you need to achieve the goals set for yourself.

We take great pride in taking care of our talent, providing a highly dynamic, inclusive and team-led environment where everyone can thrive.

Equal Opportunities

CACI is proud to be an equal opportunities employer. Embracing the diversity of our people, we are on a journey to build a truly inclusive work environment where no one is treated less favourably due to ethnic origin, age, gender, veteran status, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marital status, and disability or health condition, actively working to pre vent discrimination.

As a Disability Confident employer, we will;

Our people are unique, and we encourage and support them to be confident in contributing to our inclusion journey.

title: Head of Legal @ AI Chip DeepTech Venture, Dresden / Berlin
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.


About the Venture

We build brain-inspired computing hardware designed to tackle problems that conventional computing handles badly or not at all. Our technology has its roots in leading European research and is now a commercial system, being deployed by research institutions, supercomputing centres and companies internationally.

We are a deep-tech company moving from research-led development into a much larger commercial operation. We are scaling our hardware deployments, expanding our international customer base and building the organisation and infrastructure to support the next phase of growth.

We recently closed fresh funding, are around 70 employees in size and based out of our Dresden HQ.

About the Role

This is our first legal hire.

Legal currently sits largely with the managing directors. Your mandate is to build the legal function, establish clear decision rights and create the infrastructure that allows the company to scale without unnecessary friction.

You will own legal end to end, from corporate and commercial through to export control, IP and product regulation. The remit is broad because we sell sophisticated, regulated hardware internationally and are moving faster than our processes have historically allowed.

This is a role for someone who enjoys both the legal and operational sides of the job: not simply answering questions, but building the frameworks, processes and decision-making structures that prevent the same questions from coming up repeatedly.

What you'll do

  • Own corporate governance across our German GmbH and US entity: shareholder and board matters, financing rounds, related-party and conflict-of-interest questions.

  • Lead commercial contracting across hardware sales, licensing, research collaborations, cloud and service agreements, and NDAs. Build the templates and playbook so that standard cases can be handled efficiently.

  • Take ownership of export control and dual-use matters, including EU Dual-Use Regulation, German licensing requirements, US export-control exposure, sanctions and restricted-party screening.

  • Lead our cybersecurity and product compliance agenda, including NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and related incident-reporting and conformity requirements.

  • Cover product safety and market access for the hardware itself, including CE marking, EMC, RoHS, REACH and product liability.

  • Manage our IP portfolio: patents, freedom to operate, trade secrets, licensing, technology rights and trademarks.

  • Manage compliance obligations connected to public funding, including grant conditions, record keeping and audit readiness.

  • Work with People & Culture on employment matters, including contracts, terminations, employee participation structures, immigration. Data protection and GDPR sit here too.

  • Oversee open-source licence compliance and software supply-chain obligations together with engineering.

  • Build the delegation layer: signing authority, approval thresholds, decision rights and clear ownership, so that routine hiring, procurement and commercial decisions do not automatically converge on the managing directors.

  • Decide what we keep in house and what goes to external counsel, then manage those firms and the associated budget.

About You

You are comfortable being the only lawyer in the building, and you see that as an opportunity rather than a risk. You enjoy the operational side of legal work as much as the technical side.

You are direct, commercially minded and comfortable making judgement calls. You know where your own limits are and are happy to bring in specialists when the question warrants it.

  • Qualified German lawyer (Volljurist), with fluency in EU regulation.

  • In-house experience at a semiconductor, hardware or deep-tech company, ideally in a start-up or scale-up environment rather than exclusively in a large corporate legal department is strongly preferred.

  • Experience with export control and dual-use questions in a business that actually ships internationally, including an understanding of the difference between licensing and per-transaction screening.

  • Comfortable across a wide surface: corporate, commercial, IP, employment and regulatory. You do not need to be the deepest expert in each area, but you need to know what good looks like and when to escalate.

  • You have built structure inside a company before: templates, approval frameworks, signing authority or something equivalent that outlived your involvement.

  • Familiarity with hardware product regulation, CE marking, RoHS and REACH, or with the evolving EU cybersecurity regime is a strong plus.

  • German and English at working fluency, both written and spoken.

  • Based in or willing to relocate to the company's location in either Dresden or Berlin.

Why Join

You would be shaping the legal function of a company with direct access to the managing directors.

The subject matter is unusually interesting: brain-inspired computing, advanced hardware, international technology sales, export-controlled technology, research partnerships and a regulatory environment that is evolving in real time.

The work environment is flexible and inclusive, and we offer a competitive salary with relocation support for the right person. If you want to build something meaningful rather than maintain something that already exists, this is that kind of role.

title: Sairaanhoitaja, Tyks Psykiatria, Loimaan psykoosityöryhmä
description:
Haemme Loimaan psykoosityöryhmään sijaisuuteen sairaanhoitajaa ajalle 2.11.26 - 10.10.27. Ensisijainen sijoituspaikka työsuhteen alussa on Loimaa.

Tehtäväsi

Tarjoamme monipuolisen ja mielenkiintoisen työn avohoidon moniammatillisessa työryhmässä. Sairaanhoitajan tehtäviin kuuluu vakaviin mielenterveyden häiriöihin sairastuneiden potilaiden omahoitajana toimiminen, hoidon tarpeen arviointiin, tutkimiseen ja hoitosuunnitelman laatimiseen osallistuminen, hoitosuhdetyöskentely, perhetyö, lääkehoidon toteuttaminen ja seuranta sekä yhteistyö potilaan, hänen läheistensä ja viranomaisverkoston kanssa.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme uudelle työntekijälle monipuolisen ja haasteellisen työn sekä tiiviin perehdytyksen ja hyvät koulutusmahdollisuudet ammattitaidon kehittämiseen ja ylläpitämiseen.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Odotamme sairaanhoitajalta hyvää yhteistyötaitoa, joustavuutta ja sopeutumiskykyä sekä kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti. Arvostamme kiinnostusta kehittää omaa ammattitaitoa sekä psykoosipotilaiden hoitoa. Kokemus psykoosipotilaiden hoidosta ja/tai muu psykiatrisen hoitotyön kokemus sekä alan lisäkoulutus ovat eduksi tehtävän hyvälle hoitamiselle.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain (559/1994) mukainen sairaanhoitajan laillistus.

Lisäksi edellytämme hyvää suullista ja kirjallista suomen kielen taitoa. Eduksi katsomme ruotsin kielen taidon.

Työaika on 37,75 h/viikko. Koeaika on 6 kuukautta. Haastattelut järjestetään mahdollisimman pian hakuajan päättymisen jälkeen.

title: AI Product Engineer, Deployed
description:
Our Mission

Rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve.

About Brain Co.

Brain Co. builds AI-native operating systems for large, regulated institutions. Each system is built for a specific industry, powered by agents that push real workflows forward. Underneath it all is Atlas, our proprietary platform that keeps customers in control, secure by design, and never locked into one model.

Why Now

Brain Co. is entering its next phase of production deployments on a national scale with an elite team built from Palantir, Google, Meta, and Nvidia, and a growing footprint across government, insurance, health, and financial services.

Joining now means shaping both the company and a new category of applied AI. Every project here ships to production and is expected to create measurable customer value and impact.

You'll work alongside exceptional peers on some of the hardest problems in applied AI. It’s the kind of work you'll still be proud of in ten years from now.

About The Role

As an AI Product Engineer, Deployed at Brain Co., you will play a pivotal role in building and deploying state-of-the-art software solutions to automate various real-world problems. You will work directly with the customer to develop the product spec and building from zero. From designing robust front-end interfaces to developing scalable back-end systems, you will turn research breakthroughs into practical solutions for various nation states. This role is your opportunity to make a significant impact by making AI technology both accessible and influential.

In This Role, You Will:

  • Innovate and Deploy: Design, develop, and deploy advanced software solutions that integrate AI to tackle real-world problems, particularly in automating complex, manual processes in government and industrial sectors. Utilize modern web frameworks, microservices architecture, and cloud computing to build applications that apply AI to intricate optimization challenges.

  • Make a Big Impact: Interact directly with key customer stakeholders to apply pioneering AI solutions while working alongside experienced ex-founders, government officials/ministers, AI researchers, and engineers. Understand complex business challenges and deliver software solutions powered by AI. Join a dynamic team where ideas are exchanged freely, and creativity flourishes. You will wear many hats: software development, product management, sales, and interpersonal skills.

  • Optimize and Scale: Build scalable data pipelines, integrate industrial sensor networks, optimize application performance and reliability, and prepare systems for production. Engage in projects including but not limited to optimizing the world's most advanced energy production systems, modernizing core government workflows, or improving patient outcomes in advanced public healthcare systems.

  • Learn and Lead: Stay abreast of the latest developments in software engineering and AI. Participate in code reviews, share knowledge, and set an example with high-quality engineering practices. Mentor junior engineers and lead by example.

  • Make a Difference: Monitor and maintain deployed applications to ensure they continue delivering value across various governments worldwide. Work directly with customer engineers and SMEs to develop and tune applications that optimize their workflows and deliver tangible upside. Your work will directly impact how AI benefits individuals, businesses, and society at large.

You Might Thrive In This Role If You:

  • Are eager to travel to customer locations globally for 6+ months and work directly with SMEs and end-users

  • Minimum 2+ years of experience and an appetite for working directly with the customer to develop the software spec and build from zero

  • Experience with front-end and back-end technologies, microservices, and cloud platforms

  • Experience with modern web tooling such as React, Typescript, RESTful APIs, and database management systems

  • Possess a strong foundation in software design principles, data structures, and algorithms

  • Exhibit excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with a proactive approach to challenges

  • Enjoy working collaboratively with cross-functional teams

  • Thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities or deadlines may compete.

  • Eager to own problems end-to-end and willing to acquire any necessary knowledge to get the job done

  • Hold a Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field

Nice to Have:

  • Experience working on on-site engineering projects or in client-facing roles (Forward-Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Integration Engineer, Sales Engineer, Customer Engineer)

Benefits

  • Competitive salary

  • Paid Maternity and Paternity Leave

  • Daily Lunches

  • Commuter benefits

  • Unlimited PTO

Why Join Us

  • Ship quickly, iterate constantly and see your work deployed at global scale

  • Collaborate with industry veterans from Tesla, DeepMind, Databricks, and more

  • Accelerate your career with ownership based on impact, not tenure

  • Earn competitive compensation + meaningful equity in a high-growth company

  • Thrive in a culture built on speed, curiosity, and impact

If you want to see your work deployed at scale with real impact, Brain Co. is the place to build.

title: Eerste Verantwoordelijke Verzorgende Oostduin
description:
❤️ Maak elke dag het verschil als EVV’er bij Oostduin!

Wil jij méér betekenen dan alleen goede zorg? Als Eerst Verantwoordelijke Verzorgende bij Oostduin zorg jij ervoor dat bewoners zich niet alleen goed verzorgd voelen, maar ook gezien, gehoord en thuis voelen.

Van helpen met wassen en aankleden tot samen een gezellig moment beleven: jij bent er voor onze bewoners. Je hebt oog voor wat zij nodig hebben, signaleert veranderingen in hun gezondheid en werkt samen met collega’s aan de beste zorg.

Dit maakt jouw werk bijzonder

  • 🌷 Persoonlijke aandacht voor iedere bewoner

  • 🤝 Samenwerken met betrokken en deskundige collega’s

  • 💚 Een warme werkomgeving waarin jouw talent telt

  • 📚 Ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en door te groeien

  • ✨ Een baan waarin kleine momenten een groot verschil maken

Heb jij een Verzorgende IG niveau 3 of Verpleegkundige niveau 4 diploma en ben je geschoold tot EVV’er? Dan ben jij van harte welkom bij Florence!

Jouw zorgtalent. Jouw aandacht. Jouw verschil.
Kom werken bij Florence en maak van goede zorg iets bijzonders. Samen met collega’s bouwen we aan een fijne werkplek, waarin ieders expertise wordt benut en ruimte is om van elkaar te leren.

Dit ga je doen

Een Eerst Verantwoordelijk Verzorgende (EVV-er) verricht de volgende werkzaamheden:

  • Verantwoordelijk voor het opstellen van het Zorgleefplan;

  • Het coördineren van de dagelijkse gang van zaken op de afdeling;

  • Het bieden van de dagelijkse zorg, welzijn en activiteiten, op basis van de afspraken in het zorgleefplan;

  • Het begeleiden van bewoners, familieleden, leerlingen, stagiaires en vrijwilligers;

  • Het overdragen van informatie en deelnemen aan verschillende overleggen;

  • Een bijdrage leveren aan de instandhouding van het leef-, woon- en werkklimaat op de afdeling.

Dit ben jij

‘Op je plek bij Florence’

Bij Florence ben je niet alleen, met een grote groep collega's zoals jij ga je elke uitdaging aan! Zoals alle collega's die werkzaam zijn bij Florence, staat jouw ontwikkeling centraal. Of je nu net je diploma op zak hebt, midden in je zorgopleiding zit of al jaren ervaring hebt: jouw ambitie en talent krijgen bij ons de ruimte om te groeien. Juist omdat Florence zo’n grote organisatie is, vind je altijd een team of functie die bij jou past!

Verder staan voor deze functie de volgende functie-eisen centraal:

  • Afgerond diploma Verzorgende niveau 3 of Verpleegkundige niveau 4;

  • EVV geschoold

  • Betrokken, empathisch en positief ingesteld;

  • Affiniteit en ervaring met de doelgroep PG;

  • Communicatief, collegiaal en sociaal vaardig;

  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift;

  • In het bezit zijn van een BHV certificaat of bereid zijn om deze te behalen.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Contract voor bepaalde tijd met uitzicht op vast

  • Een teamleider die jou ondersteunt en faciliteert, zodat jij het werk kunt doen waarvoor je bent opgeleid

  • 8% vakantiegeld en een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%;

  • 237,4 vakantie uren op basis van een fulltime dienstverband (36 uur);

  • Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden conform CAO VVT.

  • Je kan altijd in ontwikkeling blijven. Florence heeft een eigen ontwikkelcentrum en hanteert een actief mobiliteitsbeleid.

Dit is jouw werkplek

Woonzorglocatie Oostduin is gelegen in de rustige wijk Benoordenhout in Den Haag. Wij bieden hier deskundige zorg aan mensen met lichamelijke aandoeningen en aan mensen met dementie. Ons multidisciplinaire team werkt nauw samen om deze vaak kwetsbare bewoners de ondersteuning te bieden die zij nodig hebben. Iedere functie speelt hierin een essentiële rol. Het welzijn van onze bewoners staat daarbij centraal, net zo belangrijk als het bieden van de best mogelijke dagelijkse zorg.

Er wordt een afdeling opnieuw geopend wat maakt dat we samen door het hele huis weer gaan bouwen aan stabiele afdelingen waar het fijn is om met elkaar als team te werken!

title: Managing Consultant – Data Engineer | Adelaide
description:
Join a growing South Australian practice and have a genuine hand in shaping what comes next.

Altis is growing in South Australia, and we're looking for a Managing Consultant who wants more than a delivery role.

You'll work with clients to solve complex data problems, lead modern data and analytics solutions and help build the capability, reputation and client relationships of our Adelaide team.

This role combines technical delivery, consulting and leadership. You'll remain close to the work while having the opportunity to influence how our South Australian practice develops.

What you'll do

  • Lead end-to-end Data & Analytics engagements.
  • Design and deliver modern data platforms and engineering solutions.
  • Work across Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric and broader cloud ecosystems.
  • Turn complex client challenges into pragmatic and scalable solutions.
  • Lead and mentor consultants.
  • Provide trusted technical and advisory support to clients.
  • Contribute to solution shaping, proposals and new opportunities.
  • Help develop Altis' presence and capability in the South Australian market.

What you'll bring

We're looking for someone with strong Data & Analytics foundations and experience working directly with clients.

Your background may include:

  • Data engineering, analytics engineering or data architecture
  • Snowflake, Databricks and/or Microsoft Fabric
  • Modern ELT/data integration patterns
  • Data modelling and data quality
  • Cloud data platforms
  • Technical delivery leadership

  • Consulting or advisory environments

Just as importantly, you'll be commercially curious, collaborative and comfortable having constructive conversations with clients about what will actually deliver value.

Why Altis?

For more than 25 years, Altis has focused on one thing: helping organisations create better outcomes through data.

We're Australian-owned and technology-agnostic, which means our consultants can focus on solving the right problem rather than selling a particular platform.

At Altis you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Work across varied and challenging Data & AI engagements
  • Learn from experienced specialists across consulting, engineering, analytics and AI
  • Build your capability through ongoing learning and career development
  • Work in a collaborative environment where you're encouraged to challenge ideas and contribute your own
  • Work flexibly through our hybrid model
  • Access health and wellbeing support for you and your family

  • Access paid parental leave and our reward and recognition program

Our values — Be Curious, Own It, Lead with Heart and Discover a Way — shape how we work with our clients and with each other.

Your next move doesn't need to tick every box

If the role sounds like the direction you want your career to take but you don't meet every requirement listed, we'd still encourage you to apply.

Different experiences and perspectives make our teams stronger.

If you need adjustments or support at any stage of our recruitment process, let our Talent Acquisition team know and we'll work with you.

Ready to see your career differently? We'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
The role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our product team in Aarhus.

This is not a role where you only write code. You are a systems developer. A real part of your time goes into discovery, meaning analysis and design: understanding the problem, shaping the solution, and deciding what is worth building. The rest goes into delivery.

We work AI-augmented. Modern AI tools are a natural part of how we design, write and review software, so more of the typing is handled for you. That makes the harder, more valuable work the judgement: what to build, how it fits together, and whether it holds up as the platform grows. We use AI to move faster, and we believe people are what make sure we build the right things.

Your work will reach hundreds of thousands of people across the Nordics: job seekers navigating labour market reforms, employment professionals adapting to new digitalisation strategies, and the institutions managing that change. Talking with the people who use the platform may be part of the job, so that what you build stays grounded in real needs.

What you will work on

Candeno serves municipalities, unemployment funds, and educational institutions across Denmark, Norway, Sweden, and Finland. The platform has three sides: candidates navigating the labour market, advisors guiding them through digitalisation and compliance workflows, and companies recruiting talent. One platform, many contexts.

We are actively building and improving core parts of the platform. You will:

Discovery (analysis and design)

  • Work with product managers, designers and stakeholders to understand real user problems before we commit to building. AI helps us move fast, so the harder work is knowing what is worth building.

  • Explore options, weigh tradeoffs, and decide what to build and how.

  • Contribute to architecture and system design that keep the platform scalable and maintainable.

Delivery (development and operations)

  • Design, build and maintain robust, scalable features across the platform.

  • Write clean, maintainable code, using AI tools where they help and applying judgement to what they produce.

  • Review code and designs, test and debug complex issues, and give constructive feedback.

  • Operate what you build: CI/CD, containers and cloud, and refactor as the platform grows.

Quality and craft

  • Meet security standards and protect user data in a data-sensitive sector.

  • Share knowledge and mentor other engineers on craft and good practice. This is technical mentoring, not people management.

Who we are looking for

You are a senior engineer who is as comfortable in the problem as in the code. Your foundation is strong delivery, and your edge is at the front of the process: you know how to find the right problem before jumping to a solution, and how to do it at a pace that keeps up with a team that ships.

You will need:

  • 5+ years building software, ideally SaaS.

  • Strong with PHP and Laravel, and with JavaScript and React.

  • Experience with containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes) and running services in the cloud.

  • A considered approach to AI in your workflow. You use modern AI coding tools well, and you review what they produce critically.

  • Strong system and product thinking. You can take part in discovery, not only delivery.

  • Clear communication. You can explain a technical tradeoff to a PM, a designer, and another engineer, and make it feel simple.

  • A degree in computer science, engineering or similar, or an equivalent proven track record.

The kind of person who does well here:

  • Curious about the problem, not only the code.

  • Ownership mindset. You follow a problem all the way through.

  • Comfortable making decisions without a perfect foundation, and honest about the tradeoffs when you do.

  • Direct. You share work early, give feedback clearly, and push back when something is not right.

What the first six months look like

After one month

You understand the platform architecture, our discovery and delivery process, and the team. You have taken ownership of your first delivery tasks and you are part of discovery conversations and team ceremonies.

After three months

You are leading delivery of key features and contributing actively to discovery, helping shape solutions and technical direction for upcoming work. AI tools are a fluent part of your daily work.

After six months

You show leadership in system design and architecture decisions and influence technical direction. You own discovery for meaningful pieces of work, from problem to buildable plan, and you mentor other engineers on craft and good practice.

Working at Candeno

We are a scale-up. That means real ownership, real impact, and a product that is still being shaped by the people who work on it.

We are based in Aarhus, and this is an on-site role. The team is small, cross-functional, and works closely together. You will have real ownership of your work and close proximity to product, design and the rest of engineering.

We are direct and focused on doing the right thing for users. We share work early and expect you to do the same.

What we offer

  • Pension scheme and health insurance

  • 5 extra days off after 2 years of seniority (10 in total)

  • Daily lunch from Meyers Madhus

  • A shared milestone programme that celebrates successes big and small

  • An active social life: team events, clubs, and an engaged social committee

Before you apply

This is a fully on-site role in Aarhus with no remote option. You must already have the right to work in Denmark and be able to be in our office every working day from your start date. We do not offer visa sponsorship or relocation support. Applications that do not meet these conditions will not be considered, so please only apply if all of them apply to you.

The process

  • A short screening call

  • A first interview, a deeper conversation about your experience and the role

  • A case interview, a practical brief sent in advance

No cover letter. You will answer three short questions when you apply.

About Candeno

Candeno is a Nordic employment technology company based in Aarhus. We build the platform that connects candidates, advisors, and companies across municipalities, unemployment funds, and educational institutions in Denmark, Norway, Sweden, and Finland. Our work sits at the intersection of public sector compliance and modern product thinking, and we take both seriously.

title: Tuntiopettaja päätoiminen, valmistava opetus, määräaikainen, Kartanon koulu
description:
Tule tekemään kanssamme tulevaisuuden Järvenpäätä! Rakennamme sujuvaa arkea 1 600 ammattilaisen voimin. Täällä kaikilla on mahdollisuus oppia ja kehittää omaa työtään. Me Järvenpäässä innostumme valmentavasta työotteesta, yhteisöohjautuvuudesta, oppimisen mahdollisuuksista sekä joustavasta työkulttuurista.

Haluatko tehdä työtä, jossa oppilaan kohtaamisella ja tuella on oikeasti merkitystä? Tule Kartanon kouluun mukaan rakentamaan turvallista, joustavaa ja oppimismyönteistä koulupolkua!

Haemme PÄÄTOIMISTA TUNTIOPETTAJAA (valmistava opetus) Järvenpään kaupungille Kartanon yhtenäiskouluun.

Pääset tukemaan 7.–9.-luokkalaisten oppilaiden oppimista ja suomen kielen kehittymistä perusopetuksessa Kartanon yhtenäiskoululla. Oppilaat ovat siirtyneet valmistavasta opetuksesta yleisopetukseen ja tarvitsevat edelleen tukea opetuskielen hallinnassa, opiskelutaidoissa ja oppiaineiden opiskelussa.

Työ sisältää oppilaiden ohjaamista, pienryhmä- ja samanaikaisopetusta sekä yhteistyötä koulun muun henkilöstön kanssa. Tehtävässä vahvistat oppilaiden akateemista kielitaitoa, opiskelutaitoja ja valmiuksia edetä opinnoissaan.

Työn tavoitteena on tukea oppilaiden yhdenvertaisia mahdollisuuksia koulunkäyntiin, jatko-opintoihin sekä aktiiviseen osallisuuteen kouluyhteisössä ja yhteiskunnassa.

Miksi tulisit meille Järvenpäähän?

Pääset tekemään vaikuttavaa työtä nuorten kanssa heidän koulupolkunsa tärkeässä vaiheessa. Näet konkreettisesti, kuinka oppilaiden kielitaito, opiskelutaidot ja itseluottamus vahvistuvat sekä kuinka he etenevät opinnoissaan.

Tarjoamme merkityksellisen työn monikulttuurisessa toimintaympäristössä, mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa pedagogista osaamistasi sekä osaavan ja yhteistyötä arvostavan työyhteisön tuen.

Tehtävä on määräaikainen lukuvuodelle 2026–2027 (19.10.2026-5.6.2027). Määräaikaisuus perustuu valmistavan opetuksen ja sen jälkeisen tuen oppilasmäärien vuosittaiseen vaihteluun.

Kartanon koulussa pidetään tärkeänä oppilaan arvostavaa kohtaamista ja vahvuuksien huomaamista. Kartanon yläkoulu on tiivis yhteisö, joka tukee uusia työntekijöitä ja arvostaa yhdessä oppimista. Tervetuloa mukaan osaavaan joukkoomme!

Tutustu toimintakulttuuriimme: https://www.jarvenpaa.fi/itseohjautuvuus

Mitä odotamme Sinulta

Edellytämme perusopetuksen opettajan kelpoisuutta. Suomi toisena kielenä (S2) -osaaminen luetaan eduksi.

Arvostamme:

- kokemusta monikielisten oppilaiden opetuksesta
- kielitietoisen pedagogiikan hallintaa
- opetuksen eriyttämisen taitoa
- kokemusta valmistavan opetuksen tai maahanmuuttotaustaisten oppilaiden opetuksesta
- hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja
- kehittävää ja joustavaa työotetta.

Valmistavasta opetuksesta perusopetukseen siirtyvien oppilaiden tukeminen edellyttää ymmärrystä kielen merkityksestä oppimisessa sekä kykyä rakentaa oppilaiden yksilöllisistä tarpeista lähteviä ratkaisuja. Perusopetukseen valmistavassa opetuksessa korostuvat opetuskielen oppimisen tukeminen, opiskelutaitojen vahvistaminen sekä oppilaan sujuva integroituminen perusopetukseen.

Tässä on tilaisuutesi tehdä työtä, jolla todella on merkitystä – ja tulla mukaan yhteisöön, joka arvostaa osaamistasi.

Järvenpäässä lapsen on hyvä kasvaa ja oppia! Me huomaamme hyvän, tunnistamme vahvuudet ja annamme tilaa lapsen omille mielenkiinnon kohteille. Tule tekemään tulevaisuuden Järvenpäätä – tule meille opettajaksi!

Haluatko kuulla lisää?

Tässä rekrytoinnissa käytämme anonyymiä hakua:
Ensimmäisessä käsittelyvaiheessa hakijan henkilö- ja liitetiedot piilotetaan.
Haastatteluun kutsuttavat valitaan osaamisen, koulutuksen ja kokemuksen perusteella.
Anonymiteetti puretaan vasta haastatteluvaiheessa.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä: hr@jarvenpaa.fi. Kirjoitathan viestiin selkeästi, mistä työtehtävästä on kysymys, esimerkiksi linkki hakuilmoitukseen.
Hakuaika päättyy 6.10.2026 klo 15.00
Suunnitellut haastattelut pidetään to 8.10.2026 iltapäivällä.
Lähetä hakemuksesi sähköisesti Järvenpään kaupungin rekrytointijärjestelmän kautta.

Tervetuloa tekemään vaikuttavaa ja merkityksellistä työtä kanssamme – odotamme innolla hakemustasi!

Kelpoisuusvaatimukset

Tehtävän kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on ylempi korkeakoulututkinto ja perusopetuksessa toimivan opettajan kelpoisuus opetustoimen henkilöstön kelpoisuusvaatimuksista annetun asetuksen nro 986/1998 mukaisesti sekä S2 - osaaminen luetaan eduksi. Asetuksen 9§:n mukaisesti perusopetusta antavalla opettajalla tulee olla suomen kielen erinomainen suullinen ja kirjallinen taito. Kelpoisuus tulee olla saavutettuna ennen hakuajan päättymistä. Kelpoisten hakijoiden puuttuessa huomioimme myös muut hakemukset.

Palvelussuhteen ehdot

- Koeaika on puolet määräaikaisuuden kestosta.

- Opettajien palkkauksessa on käytössä työn vaativuuden arviointiin perustuva palkkiojärjestelmä

description:
Tehtävänkuvaus

Logistiikkapäällikkönä vastaat datakeskushankkeiden materiaalivirroista ja toimitusketjun hallinnasta. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä projektijohdon ja tuotannon kanssa varmistaen, ettei logistiikan toimivuuden.

Tarjoamme
Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen roolin kasvavalla toimialalla, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan suurten hankkeiden onnistumiseen ja toimimaan dynaamisessa projektihallinnan keskiössä.

Työtehtävät

Tehtävä sisältää kokonaisvaltaista logistiikan suunnittelua, toimitusketjun valvontaa sekä käytännön koordinointia työmaaympäristössä materiaalien ja laitteiden saapumisen varmistamiseksi.
- Laatia työmaan logistiikkastrategia ja yksityiskohtaiset logistiikkasuunnitelmat
- Seurata kriittisten laitteiden, kuten UPS-laitteiden ja generaattoreiden, toimituksia
- Koordinoida työmaan kulkureitit, purkualueet ja materiaalien sisäiset siirrot
- Hallita Just-in-Time-toimituksia ja varmistaa materiaalien saatavuus asentajille
- Organisoida vastaanottotarkastukset, varastointi ja inventointi
- Koordinoida raskaat nostot, erikoiskuljetukset ja sisäänvientireitit
- Johtaa logistiikkatiimiä ja varmistaa turvalliset materiaalien käsittelytavat

Etsimme

- Vahva kokemus vastaavasta roolista rakennus- tai teollisuushankkeissa
- Sujuva suomen ja englannin kielen taito (suullinen ja kirjallinen)
- Edistynyt kyky johtaa logistiikkatiimejä ja alihankkijoita
- Erinomaiset koordinointi-, resurssinhallinta- ja neuvottelutaidot
- Kyky työskennellä paineen alla ja hallita kiireellisiä aikatauluja

Arvostamme, jos sinulla on
- Ymmärrys taloteknisistä (MEP) järjestelmistä
- Kokemus datakeskusympäristöistä tai suuren mittakaavan teollisuusprojekteista

Menestyäksesi roolissa olet:
- Stressinsietokykyinen
- Tavoitteellinen
- Sosiaalinen
- Järjestelmällinen
- Vastuuntuntoinen
- Itsevarma

Rekrytointiprosessimme

Academic Work hoitaa tätä hakua asiakkaansa puolesta, jonka toiveena on kaikkien tehtävää koskevien kysymysten osoittaminen Academic Workille.

Hakijoita haastatellaan jatkuvasti ja mikäli olemme edenneet jo rekrytointiprosessissa pidemmälle, saatamme sulkea haun ennen lopullisia valintoja. Valintaprosessiin sisältyvät luonteenpiirteitä sekä kognitiivista kykyä mittaavat testit. Testit toimivat työkaluina oikean tekijän löytämiseksi tehtävään sekä takaavat tasa-arvoisen ja oikeudenmukaisen arvioinnin.

title: Senior Data Consultant - Data Engineer (Snowflake) | Adelaide
description:
Build modern data solutions and help shape a growing Adelaide team.

We're growing our South Australian practice and looking for a Senior Data Consultant who enjoys solving real business problems with modern data technology.

You'll work directly with clients across the design and delivery of modern data platforms, bringing strong engineering foundations together with consulting and advisory skills.

Snowflake capability is particularly important for this role, while experience with Databricks, Microsoft Fabric and emerging AI-enabled delivery approaches will give you plenty of opportunity to expand your toolkit.

What you'll work on

  • Design and deliver modern data and analytics solutions.
  • Build scalable, well-governed data platforms and pipelines.
  • Apply strong data engineering and modelling practices.
  • Translate business challenges into practical technical solutions.
  • Work directly with client stakeholders.
  • Contribute to the growth of our South Australian practice.

  • Share your knowledge and support other consultants as they develop.

What you'll bring

We're looking for strong foundations rather than an impossible technology checklist.

Ideally you'll have:

  • Strong Snowflake capability
  • Data engineering and data modelling experience
  • SQL and contemporary data transformation/integration experience
  • Experience with Databricks and/or Fabric is highly regarded
  • Understanding of data governance and scalable solution design

  • Experience working directly with clients or business stakeholders

Exposure to enterprise AI solutions or AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor or Snowflake Cortex is a bonus.

Most importantly, you should be curious about where the data profession is heading and capable of judging when new technology genuinely improves an outcome rather than adopting it simply because it's new.

Why Altis?

For more than 25 years, Altis has focused on one thing: helping organisations create better outcomes through data.

We're Australian-owned and technology-agnostic, which means our consultants can focus on solving the right problem rather than selling a particular platform.

At Altis you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Work across varied and challenging Data & AI engagements
  • Learn from experienced specialists across consulting, engineering, analytics and AI
  • Build your capability through ongoing learning and career development
  • Work in a collaborative environment where you're encouraged to challenge ideas and contribute your own
  • Work flexibly through our hybrid model
  • Access health and wellbeing support for you and your family

  • Access paid parental leave and our reward and recognition program

Our values — Be Curious, Own It, Lead with Heart and Discover a Way — shape how we work with our clients and with each other.

Your next move doesn't need to tick every box

If the role sounds like the direction you want your career to take but you don't meet every requirement listed, we'd still encourage you to apply.

Different experiences and perspectives make our teams stronger.

If you need adjustments or support at any stage of our recruitment process, let our Talent Acquisition team know and we'll work with you.

Ready to see your career differently? We'd love to hear from you.

  • Strong knowledge of data integration and ETL processes
  • Experience building and managing data pipelines using Dataflow, Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, or similar technologies
  • Experience migrating data connectors and integrating data from multiple enterprise systems
  • Knowledge of data lakehouse architectures and modern data platforms
  • Experience with data analysis and data modeling practices
  • Understanding of database technologies and data management principles
  • Experience working with large-scale datasets and distributed data processing solutions
  • Knowledge of data governance, data quality, and data classification requirements
  • Experience collaborating with architecture, engineering, and governance teams
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based data engineering best practices

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting manufacturing, industrial, or operational technology environments
  • Experience working within regulated environments handling sensitive information
  • Knowledge of analytics platforms such as Looker
  • Experience with data migration and modernization programs
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled platforms and data architectures supporting AI solutions
  • Experience supporting multi-workstream and distributed delivery models
  • Knowledge of advanced GCP Big Data and Database services
