title: Principal Designer
description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

In Product and Design, we bring together product managers, product designers and service designers in a central team covering the breadth of Faculty’s Applied AI division. In partnership with our Business Units, we form multidisciplinary teams and work with data scientists, engineers and delivery colleagues to create durable AI-powered software solutions for clients across a variety of industries.

Both product management and design are critical disciplines to create impact with AI. While data science and machine learning offer a powerful means to build insight and predictive capability, those insights are often consumed within a complex operational environment where human and organisational factors determine whether solutions are adopted and ultimately successful.

Closing the gap between the outputs of a model and the outcomes desired by our clients requires us to go beyond data and technology to address the human side – product and design are critical to this.

About the role

As a Principal Designer at Faculty, you will own and develop design as a core discipline within Applied AI while delivering high-impact work as a senior leader. You will shape our capabilities across both product and service design, defining progression frameworks and embedding modern practices. Operating as a trusted partner to executive-level clients, you will bridge the gap between technical AI capabilities and real-world commercial outcomes. This high-leverage position balances strategic client delivery with building an entrepreneurial design function from the ground up.

What you'll be doing

  • Owning and developing the product and service design disciplines at both individual and organisational levels across Applied AI.

  • Delivering high-leverage, billable client engagements by anchoring project deliverables, shaping work, and setting up strategic accounts.

  • Building influential executive relationships across client product, technology, and business leadership teams to drive meaningful outcomes.

  • Defining comprehensive skill frameworks to directly inform talent acquisition, career progression, and team development.

  • Partnering with business development teams during early project stages to identify product opportunities and structure multidisciplinary teams effectively.

  • Advocating for the value of design across Faculty and client organisations to integrate human-centred design into AI-driven products.

Who we're looking for

  • You bring proven leadership experience shaping design capabilities and building highly effective teams in dynamic environments.

  • You possess strong consulting craft and client-facing confidence, capable of framing complex problems and navigating enterprise contexts.

  • You have deep expertise in product or service design, with a strong emphasis on user experience, product architecture, and human-centred solutions.

  • You hold a thoughtful, pragmatic perspective on data and AI-powered products, including how modern tools enhance the design process.

  • You carry an entrepreneurial mindset, driven to articulate and champion the commercial value of design to diverse stakeholders.

  • You thrive when balancing hands-on strategic project delivery with long-term capability building and team mentorship.

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Data Security Engineer
description:
BAT is evolving at pace into a global multi-category business. Our purpose is to create A Better Tomorrow™ by Building a Smokeless World. To achieve our ambition, we are looking for colleagues who are ready to join us on this journey! Tomorrow can’t wait, let’s shape it together!

BAT DBS has an exciting opportunity for a Data Security Engineer in Selangor, Malaysia

ROLE SUMMARY:

What are the key objectives and expectations from this role?

  • The Data Security Engineer is responsible for defining, implementing, and managing data protection practices across the BAT, with Microsoft Purview serving as the organization's primary Data Protection Platform. This role collaborates with application teams to classify sensitive information and ensure compliance with data security policies. Bringing tools like Microsoft Purview and some complementary data security tools into use, the engineer improves data visibility, governance, and protection in both structured and unstructured environments.
  • This is a specialist engineering role: approximately 60% of the required technical knowledge must be in Microsoft Purview (including administration, configuration, and the underlying knowledge validated by the Microsoft Certified: Information Security Administrator Associate certification, exam SC-401), 20% in data protection principles more broadly and emerging trends and standards (e.g., Post-Quantum Cryptography), and 20% in engineering-side cybersecurity concepts spanning Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, and related platforms.

What is the direct impact of this role on the team or organization?

Reports to: Data Security Manager

Number of Direct Reports: NA

Core Relationships: Data Privacy/Legal, IT Application Owners, Cloud/Identity Engineering (M365, Azure, Entra ID), Enterprise Architecture, Compliance & Risk, and Security Operations teams

Geographic Scope: Global

Travel Required: N/A

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Compose, build, and maintain data security solutions, including Data Loss Prevention (DLP), information protection, and data posture management, primarily bringing to bear Microsoft Purview (DLP, Information Protection, Insider Risk Management, Data Lifecycle Management, and Data Security Posture Management (DSPM)).
  • Define and enforce data classification and protection standards in alignment with organizational policies.
  • Implement and optimize configurations for Microsoft Purview and other data security tools to ensure maximum effectiveness.
  • Solve complex data security issues and provide timely resolutions.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to strengthen the organization’s overall security posture.
  • Monitor and improve data governance practices to maintain compliance with regulatory and internal requirements.
  • Continuously assess and enhance data security strategies to address emerging threats and technologies, including evolving data protection standards such as Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC).
  • Act as the team's subject-matter expert on Microsoft Purview, maintaining deep, current expertise aligned to the Microsoft SC-401 (Administering Information Security in Microsoft 365) certification.
  • Apply working knowledge of engineering-side cybersecurity concepts across Microsoft 365, Azure, and Entra ID (e.g., identity and access management, conditional access, secure workload configuration) to strengthen data protection controls end-to-end.

What are we looking for?

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in data security and data protection engineering, with strong expertise in Microsoft Purview.
  • Good understanding of data protection, information governance, compliance frameworks, and experience working with both structured and unstructured data environments.
  • Advanced Microsoft Purview expertise, including Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Information Protection, Insider Risk Management, Data Lifecycle Management, and Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), aligned with SC-401 certification knowledge.
  • Broad knowledge of data protection guidelines, industry trends, and emerging standards, including Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC).
  • Strong cybersecurity engineering experience across Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, and related cloud and identity platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Purview as the primary data protection platform, as well as other DLP and data security solutions, coupled with excellent solve and problem-solving skills.
  • Good communication, collaboration, and partner management skills to work effectively across multi-functional teams.
  • SC-401 (Microsoft Certified: Information Security Administrator Associate) certification required, with additional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or equivalent considered advantageous; experience in cloud security, hybrid environments, and regulatory standards including GDPR, HIPAA, and PCI-DSS is highly desirable.

What we offer you?

  • We offer a market leading annual performance bonus (subject to eligibility)
  • Our range of benefits varies by country and includes diverse health plans, initiatives for work-life balance, transportation support, and a flexible holiday plan with additional incentives
  • Your journey with us isn't limited by boundaries; it's propelled by your aspirations. Join us at BAT and become a part of an environment that thrives on internal advancement, where your career progression isn't just a statement – it's a reality we're eager to build together. Seize the opportunity and own your development; your next chapter starts here.
  • You'll have access to online learning platforms and personalized growth programs to nurture your leadership skills
  • We prioritise continuous improvement within a transformative environment, preparing for ongoing changes

WHY JOIN BAT?

We’re one of the few companies named as a Global Top Employer by the Top Employers Institute – certified in offering excellent employee conditions.

Collaboration, inclusion and partnership underpin everything we do here at BAT. We are looking forward to enabling every individual to thrive, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, skills, experience, education, socio-economic and professional background, veteran status, perspectives and thinking styles. We know that embracing talent from all backgrounds is what makes us stronger and best prepared to meet our business goals.

We see the career breaks as opportunities not obstacles. Through The Global Returners program, we support professionals looking to restart their careers after an extended absence from the workforce (e.g. time out caring for family, parental leave, national service, sabbatical and/or starting an own venture).

Come bring your difference and see what is possible for you at BAT. Learn more about our culture and our award winning employee experience here.

If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations to help you perform at your best during the recruitment process, you are encouraged to notify us. We are fully committed to support you by making appropriate arrangements for you to demonstrate your full potential.

title: Software Development Engineer II - Full Stack
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.


Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the Team

Expedia Technology teams partner with our Product teams to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.

The Search Results and Recs experience team owns the UI layer for Expedia Group brands and B2B experiences across web, iOS, and Android. As a Software Development Engineer II, Full-Stack, you will build React-based user interfaces, backend capabilities, APIs, and reusable platform components. You will contribute to configurable experiences that help brands make changes using no-code or low-code tools updates for every layout or content adjustment.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop React-based user interfaces and backend capabilities.

  • Build, integrate, and contribute to API design decisions.

  • Own features from understanding requirements through delivery, with support from teammates and product management.

  • Collaborate with product management, backend and domain service teams, platform teams, and brand teams.

  • Create reusable and configurable components and platform capabilities.

  • Contribute to improvements across Expedia Group web, iOS, Android, and B2B experiences.

  • Improve clickstream data collection and content management for banners and product cards.

  • Contribute to the Vrbo product-card redesign and BEX redesign.

  • Support the rollout of server-driven UI, enabling card layouts to be updated through configuration.

  • Migrate traffic from legacy systems to the new platform.

title: Muottitimpuri, Turku
description:

Tehtävän kuvaus

Työ sisältää tuotannossa käytettävien muottien valmistusta alusta loppuun. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää kykyä lukea ja tulkita kuvia, sekä tarkaa ja oma-aloitteista työskentelyotetta. Edellytämme aikaisempaa kokemusta vastaavanlaisista tehtävistä.

Tehtävä on vakituinen ja työt alkavat heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Jos seuraavat asiat ovat hallussa, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö

Hakeaksesi tätä työpaikkaa, sinulla tulee olla:

* Usean vuoden kokemus rakennusteollisuudesta - etsimme ammattilaista, jolta asiat sujuvat eikä tarvitse olla vahtimassa
* Voimassa oleva työturvallisuuskortti- jos ei ole, niin asia on hoidettava kuntoon ennen töiden aloitusta.
* Hyvä suomen kielen taito - työnjohtokieli on suomi.
* Korkea työmoraali – työ on itsenäistä ja vastaat itse työnjäljestäsi.
* Sosiaaliset taidot kunnossa – tulet toimeen ihmisten kanssa tiukoissakin paikoissa.

Vision työntekijälupaus

Oli visiosi työelämästä kirkas tai vasta hahmottumassa, me autamme molemmissa tapauksissa. Varmistamme, etta tyosopimukset ja varusteet ovat kunnossa, ja että ammattilaisena saat osaamistasi vastaavan palkan. Olemme tukena ja turvana, jos sellaista tarvitset. Meille on tarkeaa, etta viihdyt tyossasi.

Visiolaisena saat tässä tehtävässä:

* Osaamisesi mukaan määräytyvän palkan.
* Vakituisen työsuhteen.
* Palkanmaksun kaksi kertaa kuukaudessa.
* Perehdytyksen työhön.
* Jokaiseen tyotehtavaan soveltuvat tyovarusteet.
* Paivittaisen tuen tyoasioissa.

Onko meillä yhteinen visio? — Näin teet työpaikkahakemuksen

Haastattelemme jo hakuaikana potentiaalisia hakijoita, joten mikäli koet olevasi etsimämme työntekijä, niin nyt on aika jättää hakemus. Tee se ohessa olevan linkin kautta!

Voit parantaa omia mahdollisuuksiasi tulla valituksi, kun:

* liität hakemukseesi ansioluettelon (CV) tai kirjaat aikaisemmat työpaikkasi kuluneelta viideltä vuodelta,
* kerrot, miten aiemmissa työpaikoissa opitut asiat tukevat sinua pärjäämään hakemassasi uudessa tehtävässä.

Näin saat lisätietoa tehtävästä

Jos haluat lisätietoja tehtävästä, voit lähettää rekrytoinnista vastaavalle henkilölle sähköpostia otsikolla "Haettu työ" osoitteeseen Kristian Tikka / kristian.tikka(at)visiohr.fi / 0503746385. Olemme tavoitettavissa ma-pe klo 09.00-16.00.

Tsemppiä hakemuksen tekoon!

Visio — Aidosti läsnä alueellasi

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut on valtakunnallisesti paikallinen. Tunnemme paikalliset työmarkkinat ja olemme aidosti läsnä alueellasi. Jos haet Varsinais-Suomessa työpaikkaa, siinä auttavat sinua Turusta käsin Jukka, Mikko, Kristian ja Marko.

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut

Visio Varsinais-Suomi on osa Visio Henkilostoratkaisut -konsernia, joka on vuonna 2020 perustettu kotimainen henkilostopalvelualan yritys. Pelaamme reilua pelia ja tarjoamme toita niin raudanlujille ammattilaisille, kuin sellaiseksi kehittyville. Yhdistämme työntekijät ja työnantajat niin, että molemmat löytävät juuri tarpeisiinsa sopivan ratkaisun. Yhteistyo perustuu kaikkien kolmen tahon keskinäiseen luottamukseen.

title: Menekinedistäjä, PKS/Uusimaa (keikkatyö)
location: Espoo, Helsinki, Hyvinkää, Järvenpää, Kerava, Mäntsälä, Tuusula, Vantaa, Finland
description:
Cloetta Suomi Oy on osa Cloetta-konsernia, joka on Pohjoismaiden johtava makeistalo. Cloettan tuotekehitys pohjaa aina suomalaisten makumieltymyksiin ja tarpeisiin kansainvälisen Cloettan makeisosaajien verkoston tukemana. Cloettalaisia on Suomessa 230, joista yli puolet työskentelee eri puolella Suomea vastaten Cloettan tuotteiden myynnistä ja esillepanosta eri myyntikanavissa. Cloetta on ksylitolituotteillaan terveiden hampaiden asialla. Xylitol-Jenkki ja Läkerol Dents ovat vaikuttaneet suun hyvinvointiin jo vuosikymmenien ajan. Muita Suomessa tunnettuja brändejä ovat Mynthon, Sisu, Läkerol, Leijona, Tupla, Royal, TV Mix ja Aakkoset. Cloetta Suomi Oy:n irtomakeisbrändejä ovat Karkkikatu, Candyking ja Parrots. Cloetta tuo hymyn herkkuhetkiisi!

Etsitkö lisätienestiä esimerkiksi opintojen tai toisen työn ohelle? Haemme nyt Cloetta Suomi Oy:lle keikkailevia menekinedistäjiä! Tarjolla mukava työ, jonka parissa pääsee toimimaan osana työyhteisöä, jossa työtä tehdään intohimolla ja ammattiylpeydellä.

TYÖNKUVAUS: Menekinedistäjänä työskentelet Cloettan asiakkailla jälleenmyyntipisteissä, jotka koostuvat pääsääntöisesti päivittäistavarakaupoista. Työnkuvaasi kuuluvat tuotteiden purkaminen, hyllyttäminen ja myyntipisteiden siisteydestä huolehtiminen asiakasrajapinnassa sekä tuotetilauksien tekeminen. Työ on luonteeltaan vaihtelevaa ja monipuolista ja voit päivän aikana vierailla useammassakin jälleenmyyntipisteessä. Työpisteet sijaitsevat pääosin pääkaupunkiseudulla, mutta työskentelyalue kattaa koko Uudenmaan.

Työvuorot sijoittuvat pääsääntöisesti ma-la klo 6–16 välille (tarpeen mukaan myös klo 16 jälkeen). Työtä on tarjolla vaihtelevasti 0–5 vuoroa viikossa, joten kanssasi solmitaan keikkatyösopimus.

Etsimme parhaillaan uusia menekinedistäjiä erityisesti loppuvuoden kampanjatarpeisiin. Perehdytys tehtävään järjestetään jo ensi viikolla (vko 36), ja toivomme hakijoilta mahdollisuutta työskennellä kampanjavuoroissa viikolla 37 perjantaina ja lauantaina.

Työpisteet sijaitsevat pääosin pääkaupunkiseudulla, mutta työvuoroja voi olla myös muualla Uudenmaan alueella. Kampanjan jälkeen työvuoroja on tarjolla keikkaluonteisesti ympäri vuoden, joten tehtävä sopii erinomaisesti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai muun työn rinnalle.

TARJOAMME SINULLE: Cloettan menekinedistäjänä pääset tekemään töitä kaupan herkullisimpien tuotteiden parissa! Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen, vaihtelevan sekä haasteita tarjoavan työn, jossa yksikään työpäivä ei varmasti ole samanlainen. Tulet saamaan kattavan perehdytyksen tehtäviisi ja huippu työkaverit.

TOIVOMME SINULTA: Etsimme tekijöitä, jotka nauttivat aikaan saamisesta ja kokevat pääsevänsä pienen aikapaineen alla parempiin suorituksiin. Toivomme sinulta positiivista asennetta ja asiakaslähtöistä ajattelutapaa eikä priorisointitaidoistakaan ole haittaa.

Lisäksi menestyäksesi tehtävässä tarvitset:

* Hyvää suomen kielitaitoa
* Itseohjautuvuutta ja asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä
* Puhelinta työssä käytettävään mobiilisovellukseen
* Omaa autoa

Aiempi kokemus päivittäistavarakaupassa tai menekinedistäjänä työskentelystä katsotaan eduksesi.

Palkkaus riippuen aiemmasta kokemuksestasi n. 13,66-15 €/h + kilometrikorvaukset, osapäivärahat yms.

Liitä oheisen linkin kautta meille CV:si ja palkkatoiveesi. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa HR-asiantuntijamme Emma Liukkonen, emma.liukkonen@rtkhenkilostopalvelu.fi <mailto:emma.janhonen@rtkhenkilostopalvelu.fi> / puh. 044 412 4189

RTK-Henkilöstöpalvelu auttaa työntekijöitä ja työnantajia löytämään toisensa nopeasti ja suoraviivaisesti. Tunnemme työelämän tarpeet erinomaisesti, mikä mahdollistaa erinomaisen osumatarkkuutemme. Näin autamme asiakkaitamme menestymään muuttuvassa työelämässä.

Olemme työntekijöillemme luotettava ja joustava työnantaja, joka valvoo etuasi ja on läsnä ja tukena arjessasi. Tuemme työntekijöittemme omaehtoista virkistystoimintaa tarjoamalla Edenred liikunta- ja kulttuurietua. Lisäksi työntekijät saavat käyttöönsä laajan henkilöstöetuohjelman ja aina uusia työtarjouksia tarpeen tullen.

title: Software Engineer - Platform Engineer
description:
Electrum is a next-generation payment software technology company.

Since 2012, we've delivered trusted, enterprise-grade, cloud-native software to optimise financial transaction processing. Our deep expertise has established us as a respected partner in high-volume, low-value payment schemes, enabling clients to deliver services to millions of South Africans daily.

At Electrum, we are grounded in impact – designing solutions that matter, acting with urgency, and continuously learning as we scale. We believe in creating together – working side by side with our clients and teams to build meaningful, lasting solutions. We prioritise making it safe – encouraging open communication, smart risk-taking, and trust so that creativity and alignment thrive. And we back empowered strong teams – hiring brilliant people, collaborating hard, and holding each other to high standards while leading with empathy and kindness.

When you join the Electrum team, you’ll get to:

  • Be part of the entire journey — from the spark of an idea to the final product launch.
  • Grow your skills through world-class training and hands-on learning every day.
  • Receive mentorship and guidance from industry leaders who are invested in your success.
  • Work in a dynamic, innovative workplace where collaboration and creativity thrive.
  • Tackle real-world customer challenges and see the impact of your work firsthand.
  • Explore plenty of opportunities to grow your career and expand your expertise.
  • Gain valuable experience in a leading FinTech environment , contributing to meaningful, high-impact projects.

The Role
Are you a strong Java Developer looking to take your career to the next level by stepping into Platform Engineering? Electrum is seeking a Platforms Engineer with deep software development expertise in Java to design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and resilient platforms that power the development, deployment, and operation of applications across the organisation. In this role, you'll enable engineering teams by leveraging your core Java background to automate infrastructure, optimize CI/CD pipelines, and ensure platform reliability and performance. We are looking for an experienced Java Software Engineer first and foremost we will up skill you on the platform engineering tools and practices. If you thrive in complex environments and are motivated to bridge the gap between application development and platform reliability, this role is for you.

Tooling / Stack

  • Kubernetes & Containerisation: Using Kubernetes, Istio, ArgoCD, Helm & CI/CD to build & deploy & manage containerised workloads.
  • Monitoring and Logging: Using tooling such as Prometheus, Loki, Grafana & ELK to monitor Kubernetes resources and Java workloads.
  • Source Control & CI/CD: Making use of GitHub & Github Actions for version control & CI/CD.
  • Operating Systems: Making use of Ansible and AWS tooling to manage unix environments (Red Hat Enterprise Linux).
  • Building, Collaboration & Communicating the IDP: Strong communication skills within a team environment with an ability to effectively document processes and mentor engineers on best practices and platform use.
  • A Grasp of Backend Development: Hands-on experience in designing, developing, and deploying highly maintainable backend services using Java, and experience in writing scripts to solve ad-hoc problems.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: An intermediate understanding of AWS/Cloud services and best practices, e.g. the AWS Well-Architected Framework
  • Infrastructure as Code (AWS & Terraform): Experience using the AWS CDK & Terraform to write and manage infrastructure.
  • Architecture and Design Patterns: Familiarity with common design patterns and architectural principles, including Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Event-Driven Architecture (EDA), and distributed computing architecture.
  • Computer Networking: Knowledge/experience of core networking concepts, i.e. configuring computer networking policies, ip allocations, routing, dns, preferably with experience with AWS networking, i.e. VPCs, Subnets, NAT Gateways, Internet Gateways, Peering, VPC PrivateLink, Global Accelerators, Load Balancing etc.
  • Database Management: Expertise in designing, optimising, and maintaining relational databases (e.g., MySQL, SQLite, PostgreSQL), including experience with event pipelining, i.e. using Apache Kafka.

Beneficial Experience

  • Experience with Kubernetes & Containerisation (Istio, ArgoCD, Helm) and managing containerised workloads.
  • Experience with CI/CD Pipelines & Source Control (GitHub & GitHub Actions, GitOps workflows).
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) experience using AWS CDK or Terraform.
  • Public Cloud Environments: 2+ years designing, operating, or rightsizing AWS/Cloud infrastructure (AWS Well-Architected Framework, VPCs, Subnets, NAT Gateways, Load Balancing).
  • Monitoring & Logging: Tooling such as Prometheus, Loki, Grafana, & ELK to monitor Kubernetes resources and Java workloads.
  • Operating Systems: Using Ansible and AWS tooling to manage Unix/Linux environments (Red Hat Enterprise Linux).
  • Agile / Scrum methodologies.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Engineering.
  • 3+ years of strong software development experience in Java, with hands-on experience designing, developing, and deploying maintainable backend services.
  • Proven experience working as a Developer within a software development team building and running enterprise Java applications.
  • Strong desire to learn, adopt, and drive Platform Engineering best practices.

Why Join Electrum?

  • We believe in a People First approach, ensuring a culture where you can thrive and make a real difference

Your Career & Culture

  • Career Growth: Delivering world-class financial software is challenging, but your effort will earn you hands‑on experience with products used by millions, accelerating your career.
  • Strong Teams : We keep teams small, focused, and collaborative to maximize impact.
  • Transparency : We openly discuss strategy, finances, and salaries. Mistakes are viewed as l earning opportunities that we actively discuss.
  • Autonomy : We trust you . You're expected to seek out the data needed for informed decisions and manage your own time—knowing when to focus and when to recharge.
  • Shared Vision : You'll have the power to shape the vision of how we build the future of financial services.

Practical Perks

  1. Here's how we support our culture:
  • Flexible Work: Office-first environment with flexible hours .
  • Generous Leave: Starting at 20 days per year.
  • Office Perks (Cape Town): Fully-stocked kitchen and daily catered lunch .

Social Life: Regular team activities like hikes, getaways, and dinners.

title: Coordinator Enterprise Solutions
description:
Coordinator Enterprise Solutions

Lead enterprise platforms. Deliver modern solutions. Shape digital transformation.

This is a rare opportunity to join a progressive metropolitan council at a pivotal point in its technology transformation journey. With a new four-year Digital and Technology Strategy now established and a significant capability uplift underway, the foundations have been laid. The next step is execution.

As Coordinator Enterprise Solutions, you will provide operational leadership for Council's enterprise technology platforms, including Microsoft 365, Power Platform, enterprise integrations, Artificial Intelligence, solution development, automation and enterprise architecture. Reporting to the Head of Data and Enterprise Solutions, you will lead a multidisciplinary team focused on ensuring Council's enterprise platforms are reliable, secure, integrated and continually evolving to meet organisational needs.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can translate business requirements into the practical architecture of technology solutions, strengthen platform governance and drive continual improvement across Council's enterprise systems. You will work closely with business stakeholders, project teams and technology partners to maximise business value, user adoption and customer experience.

About Us

Glen Eira City Council is a great place to work. We have high-performing teams who deliver more than 120 services. Our Employee Engagement Survey results continue to show our people understand their goals, have a strong customer service culture, and are proud to work here. We also know that our community highly values the work we do, because we have some of the highest Community Satisfaction Survey scores of any council in the state.

We strive to be a contemporary, future focused organisation. We are high performing, values based, customer-focused and strive for innovation. In fact, we're in the top ten per cent of most engaged aligned councils, according to our most recent Employee Engagement Survey.

Our municipality is located in Melbourne's south-east suburbs, approximately 10 kilometres from Melbourne's central business district. Glen Eira has a vibrant and diverse community which is proud of its cultural heritage. It is home to more than 141,000 people and significant Melbourne icons such as Ripponlea, the Caulfield Racecourse Reserve, Yarra Yarra Golf Course, the Jewish Holocaust Museum and much more.

The Opportunity

You will play a pivotal role in leading the operational management, support and continual improvement of Council's enterprise architecture and applications, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, collaboration platforms, integration services and digital solutions. This includes developing platform roadmaps, strengthening governance processes, leading technical solution design and supporting the responsible adoption of AI-enabled capabilities, including Microsoft Copilot and intelligent automation.

Working across the organisation, you will partner with stakeholders to architect and deliver secure, scalable and modern enterprise solutions that improve collaboration, productivity, information sharing and service delivery. You will also lead, mentor and develop a team of enterprise platform specialists, developers and solution engineers.

About You

You are an experienced enterprise technology leader with strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Power Platform, enterprise integration, automation and cloud-based enterprise platforms.

You have demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams, building capability, improving platform performance and embedding effective standards, documentation and support procedures within a complex technology environment.

You bring sound judgement, strong stakeholder engagement skills and the ability to influence outcomes across all levels of an organisation, while balancing strategic platform direction with practical delivery.

To be successful, you will bring:

  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise applications, Microsoft 365 and enterprise platform teams within a complex technology environment
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Power Platform, enterprise integration, automation and cloud-based enterprise platforms
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams, including coaching, mentoring, performance management and capability development
  • Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks, DevOps, Agile delivery and platform engineering practices
  • Ability to lead technical solution design for enterprise applications, integrations, automation and digital workplace initiatives
  • Highly developed stakeholder engagement, communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence outcomes across the organisation
  • Experience working within Local Government or another highly regulated environment will be highly regarded
  • Relevant tertiary qualifications, with architecture, cloud or data governance certifications highly regarded.

Why Apply?

This is an opportunity to help shape the future of Council's enterprise technology environment and make a genuine impact on organisational performance. You'll contribute to a clear strategic roadmap, lead a capable team and help deliver modern, secure and integrated digital solutions across the organisation.

If you are excited by the challenge of strengthening enterprise platforms, improving integration and automation, and leading practical digital solutions that support better outcomes for Council and the community, we would love to hear from you.

To request a candidate information pack and to apply, please refer to the McArthur website www.mcarthur.com.au, reference J10031 in the job search bar.

For any queries or to have a confidential conversation, please contact Danielle Jupp on (03) 9828 6565.
